characters.native_name: ミリウス・ゼルムスキー
characters.energy_system: Titan Shifting Powers (The Nine Titans), ODM Gear & Thunder Spears
characters.description: One of the graduates from the 104th Training Corps. He was a part of the 34th squad sent to support the rear vanguard during the invasion of Trost. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Dimo Reeves
characters.energy_system: Titan Shifting Powers (The Nine Titans), ODM Gear & Thunder Spears
characters.description: Dimo Reeves is a merchant that leads the company that's named after him. He's stationed in Trost District.

characters.name: Jurgen
characters.energy_system: Titan Shifting Powers (The Nine Titans), ODM Gear & Thunder Spears
characters.description: A member of the Scout Regiment and a participant of the 57th Exterior Scouting Mission.

characters.name: Dieter
characters.energy_system: Titan Shifting Powers (The Nine Titans), ODM Gear & Thunder Spears
characters.description: A member of the Scout Regiment and participated in the 57th Exterior Scouting Mission.

characters.name: Peer
characters.energy_system: Titan Shifting Powers (The Nine Titans), ODM Gear & Thunder Spears
characters.description: A member of the Scout Regiment

characters.name: Gunther no Haha
characters.energy_system: Titan Shifting Powers (The Nine Titans), ODM Gear & Thunder Spears
characters.description: Gunter's mother. Appears in episode 22.

characters.name: Zoku 2
characters.energy_system: Titan Shifting Powers (The Nine Titans), ODM Gear & Thunder Spears
characters.description: He is one of a trio of men who killed Mikasa's father and mother before kidnapping their daughter Mikasa Ackerman in the year 844.

characters.name: Dennis Aiblinger
characters.native_name: デニス・アイブリンガー
characters.energy_system: Titan Shifting Powers (The Nine Titans), ODM Gear & Thunder Spears
characters.description: Military Police Officer stationed in the Stohess District.

characters.name: Waltz
characters.energy_system: Titan Shifting Powers (The Nine Titans), ODM Gear & Thunder Spears
characters.description: He is a member of the Military Police Regiment who serves as Nile Dawk's aide

characters.name: Darius  Baer Walbrunn
characters.native_name: ダリウス・ベーア＝ヴァルブルン
characters.energy_system: Titan Shifting Powers (The Nine Titans), ODM Gear & Thunder Spears
characters.description: A team leader of the Scout Regiment who participated in the 57th expedition beyond the Walls.

characters.name: Gunther Sofu
characters.energy_system: Titan Shifting Powers (The Nine Titans), ODM Gear & Thunder Spears
characters.description: Gunther's grandfather.

characters.name: Eld no Haha
characters.energy_system: Titan Shifting Powers (The Nine Titans), ODM Gear & Thunder Spears
characters.description: Eld's mother. Appears in episode 22.

characters.name: Toshinori Yagi
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 220 cm (7'2") __Quirk:__ One for All All Might is the No. 1 Hero and the "Symbol of Peace." In his hero form, All Might is a very tall and over-muscular man whose design resembles the american hero comics. His hair spikes on top of his head and his whole body has more shadows than a normal human being. However, in his true form, he is an overly-skinny man who spits a lot of blood out of his mouth and his clothes appear loose.

characters.name: Shouta Aizawa
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height: __183 cm (6') __Occupation:__ Pro Hero, Teacher __Affiliation:__ U.A. High School __Quirk:__ Erasure Aizawa's hero name, Eraserhead, was coined by Present Mic when they were younger. Using the binding cloth, Aizawa has a unique fighting style that allows him to immobilize his enemies. He is known to expel students that don't meet his standards, however it should be noted that he did not expel anyone from Class 1-A. Aizawa is extremely vocal, able to voice his opinions very easily. Although seeming emotionless and reserved, he has a soft spot for his students and genuinely cares for them.

characters.name: Eijirou Kirishima
alt_names: Gouken Hero: Red Riot (剛健ヒーロー 烈怒頼雄斗)
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") __Quirk:__ Hardening Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Eijiro is a boisterous and outgoing guy with a fondness for manliness, often using the terms "manly" and "unmanly" to describe things and people he does or doesn't like, respectively. Eijiro is very honest and kind-hearted, having a straightforward way of thinking and following a specific code of chivalry that motivates him to live without regret. He is determined and selfless, bravely putting the safety of others before himself. He is also a big fan of Crimson Riot, a retro hero from whom he takes inspiration, including personal values and his hero name. Although Eijiro may not be as hot-blooded and competitive as Katsuki Bakugou, he does not shy away from comparing himself to him, with Izuku stating that the two have managed to develop a relationship between equals. As a result, Eijiro is notably one of the few people that Katsuki holds in higher esteem. Eijiro's Quirk gives him the power to harden and sharpen any or all parts of his body, causing his flesh to become jagged and rock-like. There is a limit to how much damage his hardened body can withstand, which causes the Hardening itself to slowly dissipate, and Eijiro to lose stamina from struggling to keep his Quirk active.

characters.name: Himiko Toga
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm __Quirk:__ Transform Himiko Toga is a villain affiliated with the League of Villains and part of its Vanguard Action Squad. She originally joined the group as a means to get closer to Stain. Himiko is a very cheerful girl, to the point of smiling even after having presumably killed someone, displaying apparent sadistic tendencies. She has a very twisted perception of love and friendship Himiko's Quirk Transform grants her the ability to transform into a physical lookalike of another individual, as well as copy their voice. She can only transform into people whose blood she has ingested. The more blood she drinks, the longer she has access to that person's form. For example, 1 cup of blood allows her to transform for a total of 18 hours. She can even switch between the appearances of multiple people if she drinks the blood of more than one person.

characters.name: Ochako Uraraka
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 156 cm (5'1") __Quirk:__ Zero Gravity Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School Ochako is an outgoing, lively person who thinks about everything positively, though she is objective enough to see flaws and virtues. She gets excited over little things very easily. Ochaco has been described by other students as "the most laidback girl" among her class, being very bubbly and kind of an airhead at times. She is often incredibly blunt without being aware of it. She is on good terms with everyone and is particularly close friends with several class members, including Izuku, Tenya Ida, and Tsuyu. Ochaco's Quirk gives her the power to manipulate gravity upon touching solid things with the pads on her fingertips. The targets lose their gravitational pull, effectively making them weightless. She is able to activate or cancel her Quirk's effects by closing her fingers together, and is shown to be careful with her hands in order to avoid accidental quirk activation.

characters.name: Dabi
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 176 cm (5'9¼") __Quirk:__ Blueflame Dabi is a villain affiliated with the League of Villains and a member of the organization's Vanguard Action Squad. Dabi is a stoic, aloof, confident, and focused individual who rarely shows emotion. While rather crude and violent, he's also shown to be quite cautious. Overall, Dabi is a highly enigmatic individual who trusts no one, preferring to do things alone and in his way. He also gives off the impression of knowing more about certain people than he lets on. Dabi's Quirk grants him the ability to generate and control highly destructive blue flames from his body. He has very well-developed control of his flames and can project them far from himself and in large amounts. However, Dabi's body has a low tolerance for his flame, and he will get burned if he uses them for prolonged periods.

characters.name: Tomura Shigaraki
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 175 cm (5'9) __Quirk:__ Decay Leader of the League of Villains and protégé of All For One. He was raised by his master, All For One, with the goal of killing All Might, and ultimately destroying the society he represents. Tomura is a very twisted, malevolent, and maliciously warped young man, who is considered to be the polar opposite of Izuku Midoriya. He doesn't care for his or almost anyone else's life, having no qualms about performing evil deeds like murdering innocent people. Tomura was initially perceived to be a "man-child": arrogant, selfish, dependent, and demanding, becoming angry if things didn't go his way and likening reality to some sort of video game. Unlike his mentor, Tomura lacked subtlety, preferring to eliminate problems through force. Much like a child, Tomura seemed unable to cope with his own feelings, instead lashing out and abusing both others or himself, tearing at his own neck when he becomes frustrated. Initially, Tomura seemingly caused destruction just for the sake of it and felt directionless about the League's path forward after Stain's arrest. It would take a fateful meeting with Izuku in a mall for him to develop an epiphany and become aware of his true convictions: to crumble hero society through All Might's death. Tomura's Quirk allows him to disintegrate whatever he touches with all five fingers. It will take effect whether the target is organic or not. The disintegration spreads quickly and will spread through the victim's whole body if they don't amputate the decaying body part. His Quirk can even spread beyond what he's touching, allowing him to disintegrate large groups of enemies instantly.

characters.name: Denki Kaminari
alt_names: Stun Gun Hero: Chargezuma (スタンガンヒーロー・チャージズマ)
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 168 cm (5'6") __Quirk:__ Electrification Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Denki is a friendly, social, and energetic boy who enjoys hanging out with others. He is rather casual when interacting with other people, including the generally unfriendly Katsuki Bakugou. Denki's Quirk Electrification allows him to store and discharge electricity. While he can also discharge this energy over a distance, Denki has little to no control over it, meaning it will go everywhere indiscriminately. Denki is also able to absorb and neutralize electricity and other lightning-based Quirks. Whenever Denki exceeds his wattage limit, he loses his ability to discharge energy, with his entire personality changing into that of a giggling idiot for a certain period until he reverts to normal. In this state, he is always giving thumbs-ups as a way to let others know that he is okay.

characters.name: Tsuyu Asui
alt_names: Rainy Season Hero: Froppy (梅雨入りヒーローフロッピー)
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Affiliation:__ U.A. High School __Quirk:__ Frog Tsuyu is a very straight-forward girl that always says what's on her mind and what she thinks about others. She prefers to be called by her first name.

characters.name: Mirio Togata
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 181 cm (5'11") __Occupation:__ Student __Affiliation:__ U.A. High School __Quirk:__ Permeation He is third-year student at U.A. High School and is part of The Big 3 _(the strongest three hero students in all of Japan)_. Before Izuku Midoriya, Mirio was the top candidate for All Might's successor and inheritor of One For All. His Quirk, Permeation, gives him the ability to become intangible, letting him pass through any tangible matter; he can phase through walls and/or the ground, as well as let enemy attacks pass through him harmlessly.

characters.name: Kyouka Jirou
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm (5'1") __Quirk:__ Earphone Jack __Affiliation:__ U.A. High School __Fighting Style:__ Medium Ranged + Support Combat Kyoka is a petite, fair-skinned girl with a slender build. She has triangular, lazy-looking onyx eyes with notably long lower eyelashes, and rather small eyebrows. Kyoka has a pragmatic, unenthusiastic and teasing personality that is mostly shown to those she finds irritating. Kyoka is not always like this though, as she does enjoy socializing with others, in which case she is usually nice and friendly. Kyoka's Quirk (Earphone Jack) allows her to plug the jacks that hang from her earlobes into all sorts of things and channel the sound of her heartbeat into them; causing havoc inside the plugged objects. It's also used to catch sounds and vibrations from her surroundings.

characters.name: Tamaki Amajiki
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 177 cm (5'10") __Quirk:__ Manifest Third-year student in Class 3-A at U.A. High School and part of The Big 3 (the strongest three hero students in all of Japan). Tamaki is extremely shy, aloof, depressed, "intimidating", and introverted, especially around big audiences. He gets nervous very easily when talking to other people. If his anxiety gets the best of him, Tamaki will often face away and lean into a wall to hide his face from others. While his physical abilities and Quirk are outstanding, Tamaki is socially awkward and lacks confidence in his powers. Despite his timid heart, Tamaki can show flashes of bravery. Even though he's always been a shy and reserved boy, Tamaki was able to hone his skills and climb the ranks into one of U.A.'s Big 3. Mirio Togata is a big inspiration for Tamaki. Tamaki's Quirk Manifest grants him the ability to manifest the physical characteristics of anything he's eaten; for example, if he eats takoyaki, he can transform his fingers into octopus tentacles. Additionally, anything Tamaki manifests is significantly stronger than normal. The more of a substance Tamaki eats, the stronger his manifestation will be. He can only manifest the traits of substances still in his system and loses access to those traits once the substance is fully digested. He must resupply his Quirk daily and decide what foods to eat beforehand.

characters.name: Fumikage Tokoyami
alt_names: Shikkoku Hero: Tsukuyomi (漆黒ヒーロー ツクヨミ)
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm __Quirk:__ Dark Shadow Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Fumikage is reserved, serious, and focused, albeit noble and valiant. Though not talkative, Fumikage will directly ignore questions or requests that seem in some way pointless. During combat, Fumikage is known to be fierce and dependable, with his strength and capabilities rarely being questioned. Fumikage is fond of darkness and other related concepts, considering himself a "creature of the dark" and employing archaic-sounding speeches that paint him slightly creepy or dramatic. Fumikage's Quirk "Dark Shadow" allows him to manifest a sentient shadow monster from his body that he can materialize and contract freely. Dark Shadow's energy is limited and can be drained by bright light. Dark Shadow retracts into Fumikage's body when it runs out of energy. The shadow entity's personality, strength, defense, and control depend on the lack of light. In bright light, Dark Shadow is weaker and smaller but still has considerable strength and defense and is easier to control, but in total darkness, Dark Shadow's size and parameters are drastically enhanced. It is powerful enough to rip out and cut down multiple full-grown trees easily. However, Dark Shadow is more difficult to control in the dark, causing it to rampage based on its own free will.

characters.name: Momo Yaoyorozu
alt_names: Bonbatsu Hero Creati (万物ヒーロークリエイティ)
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 173 cm (5'8") __Quirk:__ Creation Vice class representative of Class 1-A at U.A. High School. She was admitted to the school through official recommendations. Momo is a very prudent, dedicated person who acts as a natural leader. She is generally level-headed and calm in dangerous situations, but she isn't above falling into a panic. Momo can be blunt with her comments about people's mistakes and miscalculations, tending to be very direct and wishing to help her peers improve enough to become great heroes. Momo's Quirk gives her the ability to create any non-living material/object from her exposed skin by transforming the molecular structure of her fat cells. In order to create something, she needs to understand the molecular structure of which the material/object is made.

characters.name: Hitoshi Shinsou
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 177 cm (5'9½") __Quirk:__ Brainwashing Student at U.A. High School, attending Class 1-C of the Department of General Education. Hitoshi is a stoic and straightforward person with an innate ability to spark conversation with anyone despite holding a reserved and quiet attitude most of the time. He is shown to be rather clever, knowing just the right words to manipulate others into replying to his comments, allowing him to activate his Quirk. He does not mind doing something underhanded to claim victory in a fight. Due to having his Brainwashing Quirk perceived as evil throughout his life, Hitoshi has been somewhat feared by those aware of his power and has been discriminated against solely because of the Quirk he was born with. This persecution led him to become resentful of those who had Quirks more associated with hero work. Regardless of his drawbacks, however, Hitoshi desires to become a Pro Hero more than anything. Hitoshi's Quirk Brainwashing allows him to put someone in a state where they are forced to obey whatever he commands. He can only activate this power when his target verbally responds to something he says. Brainwashing must be intentionally activated and will not take effect if Hitoshi doesn't want it to. Using a megaphone or anything that makes his voice artificial will not allow his Quirk to activate, as the said devices would transform his voice into an electronic signal.

characters.name: Mina Ashido
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm (5'3") __Quirk:__ Acid Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Mina is a cheerful and easygoing girl who usually displays a smile. Highly social and excitable, she loves to hang out with her friends and is shown to become very upset when denied an opportunity to be at a gathering. She possesses a strong fashion sense and likes to go shopping. Due to her athleticism and energy, Mina enjoys and is very skilled at dancing. Mina is extremely courageous and is viewed as an ideal personality for hero work. Mina's Quirk Acid allows her to produce a corrosive liquid from her body. She can control the solubility and viscosity of this corrosive liquid. There is a limit to how long she can produce the corrosive liquid until her skin gradually loses its natural resistance to it. Overusing her Quirk or pushing it too far can also be fatal, as it dehydrates her body very fast. Mina can use her acid offensively, but has shown utility with it as well, such as melting handholds for herself to climb with. She is also known to secrete a non-corrosive version of the acid from her feet in order to slide around.

characters.name: Jin Bubaigawara
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 178 cm (5'10") __Quirk:__ Double Villain affiliated with the League of Villains, and part of its Vanguard Action Squad. Jin has an incredibly unique personality: explosive, and lively with a very comedic demeanor. He enjoys assuming dramatic poses and eccentric facial expressions. Jin constantly contradicts himself, making a statement in one voice and immediately saying the opposite in another. This juxtaposition iss part of a mental instability that Jin embraces as a villain. He believes understanding your own identity is the most essential aspect in life, an understanding he lost during the 9-day conflict with his own clones that left him unsure whether he was the original or not. Now, if his mask is removed, he panics and threatens to "split" until he put his mask back on to become "whole". Jin's Quirk allows him to create an exact duplicate of anything, living or not. To duplicate something, he needs to know its precise measurements and characteristics. The clones he makes do not disappear; instead, they disintegrate into a mud-like substance after taking a certain amount of damage. The duplicates are less durable than the original, and the second duplicate is even less durable than the first. When Jin creates duplicates of a person, he has no control over the clones because they have their own autonomy, personalities, and abilities that are utterly identical to the original.

characters.name: Enji Todoroki
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 195 cm (6' 4¾") __Occupation:__ Pro Hero __Quirk:__ Hellflame Endeavor is a tall man with a muscular physique. He has short and spiky, red hair with bright blue eyes. His beard and mustache appear to be made of fire, but when he turns off his flames on his face voluntarily, his stubble shows.

characters.name: Tenya Iida
alt_names: Turbo Hero: Ingenium (ターボヒーロー・インゲニウム)
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 179 cm (5'10") __Quirk:__ Engine Class representative of Class 1-A at U.A. High School Tenya may look severe, but he's actually just a very serious person, who takes everything, even the most insignificant thing, seriously. A testament to his generally hyperactive and intense behavior, Tenya often exhibits plenty of peculiar tics, such as moving his arms around in strange chopping patterns or sometimes twitching his body uncontrollably. Tenya is very humble, willing to admit to his mistakes, apologize for rude behavior, and improve in areas he lacks. Being part of the highly-esteemed Ida Family of Heroes, Tenya is proud of his lineage and works hard to meet his expectations. He greatly admires his older brother, Tensei (also known as the Turbo Hero: Ingenium), and aspires to become a similar hero. Tenya's Quirk Engine gives him car-like engines in each of his calves, giving him incredible running speed and extreme kicking power. Tenya needs to fuel his engines by drinking orange juice. Tenya's engines have multiple gears; it is currently unknown how many, but it has been implied that there are more than three.

characters.name: Kai Chisaki
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 179 cm (5'10") __Quirk:__ Overhaul Kai Chisaki, also known by the villain name Overhaul, is the Yakuza Captain of the Shie Hassaikai. Overhaul is a mysophobic, antisocial sociopath obsessed with returning the world to the way it was before the Quirk phenomenon. Due to a combination of an old theory claiming Quirks derived from rats and his own mysophobia, Overhaul believes that Quirks are actually a plague on humanity, having infected people with "syndromes" of heroism and villainy. He looks down upon those that use their abilities for either purpose, referring to acts of heroic sacrifice or petty crime as "sicknesses". Overhaul is extremely determined to his ambition of eradicating Quirks, not only due to his own personal phobias, but also because such a thing would allow the yakuza to reclaim the power they once held over society. Kai's Quirk "Overhaul" grants him the ability to disassemble anything he touches, as well as reassemble it in any configuration he desires, effectively giving him full control over matter. Kai can disassemble people to kill them or reassemble them to heal their wounds. He can also do this to himself and even merge his body with others, even allowing him to use their Quirks

characters.name: Nejire Hadou
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 164 cm (5'4") __Occupation:__ Student __Quirk:__ Wave Motion (ability to convert body's vitality into energy that can discharge as blast waves) She is third-year student at U.A. High School and is part of The Big 3 _(the strongest three hero students in all of Japan)_. Nejire is very enthusiastic, affable and cheery, and is always seen moving. She shows great interest in people's unique physical features and is easily distracted by them. She seems to like knowing more than others, but not in a proud way, as she just enjoys explaining things to people and sharing her knowledge. Despite her happy-go-lucky personality, Nejire is fierce in battle. When the situation calls for it, Nejire can be very calm and focused. Her curiosity never seems to extend to the enemy and she always maintains her focus on taking them down.

characters.name: Mei Hatsume
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm (5'2") __Quirk:__ Zoom Mei is a smart, off-setting, and assertive girl, often making those around her uncomfortable. She loves creating gadgets, which she refers to as her "super cute babies". Mei has a habit of "going straight to the point" and is very shameless and opportunistic when it comes to advertising her inventions. While talking to people, she has a habit of getting awkwardly close to them, which usually causes them to back away from her but she still moves up to them.

characters.name: Neito Monoma
alt_names: Phantom Thief (ファントムシーフ)
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 170cm __Quirk:__ Copy Student in Class 1-B at U.A. High School. Neito has a rather complex personality since it differs depending on who he is addressing; he is particularly mocking, loud, and sarcastic with Class 1-A, but outside of these interactions, he is a calm, kind, and intelligent person. He envies Class 1-A with a passion over how they became the center of attention among U.A.'s first years because of the U.S.J. Incident. Truthfully, he only wants his class to stand out as they do, and he vents this feeling by throwing countless taunts towards his rivals, gloating over Class 1-B's successes and disparaging 1-A for their failures. Neito's Quirk is Copy, which allows him to duplicate and use another person's Quirk after coming into physical contact with the user. He can hold four Quirks simultaneously and maintain copied powers for ten minutes. After the time limit runs out, he loses the copied Quirk until he once again touches the original user.

characters.name: Chizome Akaguro
alt_names: Hero Goroshi: Stain (ヒーロー殺しステイン)
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 182 cm (6'0) __Quirk:__ Bloodcurdle Villain and former vigilante that was notorious for having killed many Pro Heroes. He attacks and kills heroes who he believes do not fit his definition of a "true hero." Chizome is a cruel, unforgiving, and merciless man with a sense of duty to cleanse society of false heroes. He believes that those who become Heroes for fame or money are unworthy of being called the name and only All Might is a true hero. Due to his strong ideology, he took it upon himself to become the Hero Killer: Stain to stain his own hands with blood to purge fake heroes and change the current society. Despite his extremist views and beliefs, Stain did have genuine ideals about heroism, which he stood by firmly. He did not hesitate to save people he deemed worthy of being called Heroes, did not like killing without reason, and would even give advice to his enemies. Stain acknowledged that what he did was morally wrong but believed that for society to be put on the right path, someone must be what he was, suggesting that he saw himself as a martyr. Stain's Quirk "Bloodcurdle" allows him to paralyze his target upon tasting a sample of their blood. The amount of time a victim remains paralyzed depends on their blood type; in ascending order from shortest to longest duration, they are: O, A, AB, and B. The maximum amount of time that anyone can be paralyzed is eight minutes. _In My Hero Academia: Vigilantes:_

characters.name: Nemuri Kayama
alt_names: Juu-hachi Kin Hero: Midnight (18禁ヒーロー ミッドナイト_
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 175 cm (5'9") __Quirk:__ Somnambulist Pro Hero. She also works as a Modern Hero Art History teacher at U.A. High School. Nemuri is a very playful and flirtatious person with an unpredictably serious and temperamental side to her. She gets angry whenever someone interrupts her or insults her. She is especially sensitive about her age. Despite her flirtatious personality, Nemuri was intelligent, perceptive, and articulate. While she comes off as a hero who enjoys her fame derived from her beauty and sex appeal, Nemuri has demonstrated true heroism and bravery, willing to fight on the front lines and put her life at risk for others. Nemuri's Quirk "Somnambulist" allows her to put nearby people to sleep by exuding a sleep-inducing aroma from her body. Her Quirk works better on males than females.

characters.name: Hanta Sero
alt_names: Taping Hero: Cellophane (テーピンヒーロー セロファン)
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 177 cm (5' 9¾") __Quirk:__ Tape Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Hanta is amicable and has proven to be one of the more sociable members of Class 1-A. He can sometimes be loud and showy, often trying to impress his peers with his Quirk. He is often the only person to call his classmates out when they act crazy. He is pretty humorous and usually makes jokes with his classmates. However, when push comes to shove, Hanta is a brave hero-in-training who wishes to prosper on his own while helping others do the same. Hanta's Quirk is that he has tape dispenser-like organs in his elbows, from which he can shoot long cellophane tape-like strips; he can also retract them. They appear to be somewhat sturdier than regular tape. Overuse of his Quirk will cause his skin to dry out. He can use his tape to wrap people, swing long distances, and create traps, among other applications.

characters.name: Yuu Takeyama
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 162 cm (5'4") (Normal form); 2062cm (67'8") (Transformed) __Quirk:__ Gigantification __Occupation:__ Pro Hero Pro Hero. Her Quirk allows her to grow to a gigantic size. She cannot variate between her base-height and the gigantified height achieved via her Quirk, making her only able to be either her normal height of 162cm (5 feet 4 inches) or her enlarged height of 2,062cm (67 feet 8 inches) tall.

characters.name: Mirai Sasaki
alt_names: Sir Nighteye (サー・ナイトアイ)
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 200 cm (6'6¾") __Birthplace:__ Tokyo, Japan __Quirk:__ Foresight A Pro Hero and Mirio Togata's mentor. He was formerly All Might's sidekick and was considered to be the brains behind All Might's hero operation before opening his own hero agency. Sir Nighteye is a lean but muscular man with a clean, well-kept appearance. Unlike most Pro Heroes, he seems to prefer plain office clothes (a plain white suit with gold buttons, a white dress shirt, and a red tie with white dots) instead of an elaborate hero costume. Sir Nighteye maintains a stoic and intimidating presence, with a cold and sharp glare, but that is only the side of his personality that he shows in public. He greatly values humor and actually requires people to make him laugh before he acknowledes them. Nighteye believes that humor and energy are vital elements for the future of society and punishes subordinates that fail to display those qualities.

characters.name: Yuuga Aoyama
alt_names: Kagayaki Hero: Can't Stop Twinkling (輝きヒーロー)
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: **Height:** 168 cm (5'6") **Quirk:** Navel Lazer Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Yuuga appears to be vain and prideful, thinking of himself as superior to the rest of his classmates, especially regarding his Quirk. He exhibits flamboyant mannerisms, is fond of posing, and likes to grab the attention of those around him despite frequently getting ignored by his peers. He also plays up his French heritage, occasionally implementing French words into his sentences. Yuuga's Quirk allows him to shoot a powerful sparkling laser cannon from his navel. It is so powerful, it can blast through two meters of solid concrete. If he fires the laser for more than 1 second at a time, he will suffer intestinal distress.

characters.name: Tooru Hagakure
alt_names: Stealth Hero: Invisible Girl (ステルスヒーロー インビジブルガール)
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 152 cm (5'0") __Quirk:__ Invisibility Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Tooru is a bubbly, cheery, and easygoing girl who does most things with an upbeat attitude. She is very socially eager and likes shopping, and her room suggests that she likes plushies and other cute things. Tooru's Quirk is that her body is completely invisible. In addition to the stealth capabilities granted to her by her invisible body, Tooru can refract light that passes through her, allowing her to intensify the light into a blinding flash. She has further refined this application of her Quirk, achieving the ability to manipulate and redirect light-based attacks, such as Yuuga Aoyama's Navel Laser.

characters.name: All For One
characters.native_name: オール・フォー・ワン
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Quirk:__ All For One __Occupation:__ Villain __Fighting Style:__ Close Range and Long Range All For One is the true leader and benefactor of the League of Villains. Once Japan's most powerful villain and All Might's arch-nemesis, his true motives are unclear and his true identity unknown. His current goal is to raise Shigaraki to become his eventual successor.

characters.name: Hizashi Yamada
alt_names: Voice Hero: Present Mic (プレゼント・マイク)
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 185cm (6'1") __Quirk:__ Voice Pro Hero. He also works as an English teacher at U.A. High School and as a radio talk show host. Yamada maintains the eccentric persona of a radio host. He often poses when he talks and maintains a certain level of excitement or volume, regardless of the situation. Though he tends to be a jovial individual, Hizashi is capable of great rage when it comes to his friends and colleagues. Yamada's Quirk "Voice" allows him to increase the volume of his voice, giving him an ability that is similar to a sonic scream. The sound from his Quirk is strong enough to cause people's ears to bleed from far away. The only known weakness of this Quirk is that the loud sounds do not travel well underground, making this Quirk ineffective against anything that is underground or separated from him by layers of earth.

characters.name: Minoru Mineta
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 108 cm (3' 6½") __Quirk:__ Pop Off __Affiliation:__ U.A. High School __Fighting Style:__ Medium Ranged Support Minoru Mineta, also known as the Fresh-Picked Hero: Grape Juice, is a student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School, training to become a Pro Hero.

characters.name: Mezou Shouji
alt_names: Shokushu Hero: Tentacole (触手ヒーロー テンタコル)
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 187 cm (6'2") __Quirk:__ Dupli-Arms Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Shouji is friendly and gentle, and he will work nicely with anyone. He is not the type to hold grudges, showing no ill will towards those that harm him unwillingly. Shouji is entirely selfless and willing to risk his life for anyone. He can be empathetic and understanding, but still shows a sense of maturity and responsibility that prevents him from acting under emotional impulses. He is very protective of his classmates, especially if they are hurt or injured. He is also quite thick-skinned, as he said he is used to being feared due to his appearance. Shouji's Quirk grants him a set of tentacles alongside his arms. He can transform the tips of these tentacles to replicate other parts of his body (ex: mouth, ears, eyes). The duplicated body parts are more efficient than the originals; as a result, Mezo is able to hear better, see-through more angles at a time, and they grant him much higher degrees of strength. He uses these arms to talk most of the time through duplicate mouths, rather than his actual mouth.

characters.name: Camie Utsushimi
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 161 cm (5'3") __Affiliation:__ Shiketsu High School (Second-Year Student) __Quirk:__ Glamour Camie seems to be very talkative, especially when learning more about people who pique her interest. She was thrilled upon seeing Shoto Todoroki for the first time, delighted at the fact that she would both meet a handsome man as well as undergo training. According to Inasa Yoarashi, she has impressive "interaction techniques" because she asked for Todoroki's contact info. She also tends to speak in a unique way and incorporates a strange type of slang in it, which tends to confuse those around her. According to herself she also loves children. Camie's Quirk allows her to create both visual and auditory illusions for a short period of time.

characters.name: Itsuka Kendou
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 166 cm (5'5") __Quirk:__ Big Fist Class representative of Class 1-B at U.A. High School, Itsuka is a spirited girl who is thoughtful of others. She does not hesitate to criticize even her classmates if she feels what they are doing is not correct. Due to Itsuka's cheerful personality, she can bring all of Class 1-B together, thus making her the "big sister" of Class 1-B. Itsuka's Quirk Big Fist grants her the ability to enlarge both of her hands to a gigantic size. With the increased size comes enhanced striking power and gripping capabilities.

characters.name: Nana Shimura
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: Shimura Nana was the seventh user of the One For All Quirk, All Might's mentor, and a close friend of Gran Torino.

characters.name: Mashirao Ojiro
alt_names: Butou Hero: Tailman (武闘ヒーローテイルマン)
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 169 cm (5'6") __Quirk:__ Tail Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Mashirao has a very calm and noble attitude and a profound sense of dignity, which prevents him from accepting results he doesn't feel he earned with his own abilities. He is also described as a hard worker. Along with a strong sense of dignity, Mashirao can be described as sheepish and bashful, not very often enjoying the spotlight and being easily embarrassed. A recurring joke is that others view Mashirao as "plain," which profoundly upsets him. Mashirao's Quirk is that he has a long, powerful, sturdy tail. His tail effectively functions as a third arm that he can use to grab things. Furthermore, it's attack power is strong enough to break objects made of metal, he can wrap it around enemies, and it can support Mashirao's body weight. Mashirao is incredibly adept at using his tail, combining it with his knowledge of martial arts to engage enemies in close-range combat, performing fast and acrobatic moves. His tail can also increase his speed and mobility by whipping it down against the ground to use it like a springboard. (Source: My Hero Academia Wiki)

characters.name: Sorahiko Torino
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 128 cm (4'2") __Affiliation:__ Yuuei (Retired) __Quirk:__ Jet A retired hero who is one of All Might's colleagues and his former homeroom teacher. He was the one who taught All Might to control One For All during the his early days, and his training was so intense that All Might fears him to the point he subconsciously tried to forget about him until Grantorino sent his recommendation for Izuku to help him improve One For All, becoming his work place mentor. His Quirk is "Jet," allowing him to take in air through the sole of his foot to allow him to jump higher.

characters.name: Kurogiri
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Affiliation:__ League of Villains __Quirk:__ Warp Gate Kurogiri has a level-headed personality, which often serves to ground Tomura Shigaraki's immaturity. He is intensely loyal to both All For One and Tomura. He is very polite and well-spoken, even to enemies.

characters.name: Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu
alt_names: Real Steel (リアルスティール)
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 174cm (5'9") __Quirk:__ Steel Student in Class 1-B at U.A. High School. Tetsutetsu is defined by his very hotheaded and outspoken personality. He is confident, stubborn, and straightforward in his motivations and actions. He tends to be very vocal about his intentions and has a one-track mind, often looking for the simplest solution to problems to solve them most directly. Tetsutetsu's direct personality shows through his tenacious and upfront fighting style during battles. Tetsutetsu's Quirk allows him to turn his body into steel. This power grants Tetsutetsu both augmented defensive abilities to withstand attacks and the increased strength of his unarmed physical attacks.

characters.name: Kouji Kouda
alt_names: Fureai Hero: Anima (ふれあいヒーロー アニマ)
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 186 cm (6'1") __Quirk:__ Anivoice Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Contrary to his strong and powerful appearance, Kouji is very timid and quiet. He rarely speaks and prefers using sign language to communicate with his classmates. He hates violence due to his kind-hearted nature. Kouji appears to greatly enjoy the company of animals, as his Quirk allows him to interact with animals in ways others cannot. He owns a small rabbit as a pet. Kouji's Quirk "Anivoice (生き物ボイス, Ikimono Voice)" gives him the ability to command any creature in the animal kingdom by speaking to them. Whatever command he gives, the animal will carry it out. However, he cannot exert control if they cannot hear his command. The target must also be a real animal and not merely animal-like. Kouji can also exchange information with the animals to find the locations of various people and potential enemies faster. Kouji has been shown to use the Quirk effectively with flocks of birds to create a smokescreen of animals and to attack an opponent, along with his use of insects to distract and attack his opponents. He has now also overcome his fear of bugs, so he often uses bugs to swarm opponents with numbers.

characters.name: Tsunagu Hakamada
alt_names: Fiber Hero: Best Jeanist (ファイバーヒーロー ベストジー二スト)
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 190cm (6'3") __Quirk:__ Fiber Master Pro Hero, ranked in the top 4. He is the recipient of the "Best Jeanist" award for eight consecutive years. Tsunagu is an elegant man with flamboyant tendencies. He believes very strongly that people with influence must maintain a positive appearance both physically and socially. Tsunagu often uses metaphors referencing jeans, denim, and various other sewing and fabric-based phrases, often inspiring his recruits with speeches, telling them to keep their life straight like their jeans. Tsunagu takes the role of being a hero very seriously. He is selfless, brave, and charismatic, and he aims to spread a sense of a peace to all people, no matter how dire the situation. Tsunagu's Quirk "Fiber Master (ファイバーマスター)" allows him to freely manipulate the threads in any nearby piece of fabric. He has power over all types of cloth, but his Quirk works best with denim and is less effective on sweats. Fiber Master also works on other types of fiber not related to fabric, such as carbon fibers. He primarily uses this power to restrain his targets, either by using their own clothing against them, or simply unravels portions of his own clothing into strings.

characters.name: Atsuhiro  Sako
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: Mr. Compress's Quirk allows him to "compress" anything in a spherical area into a small marble without actually damaging it. The weight of the target is reduced alongside them, making them very easy to carry. If used on a person, it effectively entraps them, terminating the fight instantly and allowing Mr. Compress to abduct them without difficulty. The Quirk can also be used on select body parts, maiming the target.

characters.name: Nezu
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 85 cm __Quirk:__ High Spec Nezu, also known as Mr. Principal is a Pro Hero and the principal of U.A. High School. He is an extremely rare case of an animal who manifested a Quirk. He can be very long-winded at times when explaining or educating.

characters.name: Fuyumi Todoroki
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: The only daughter of Eiji and Rei. Fuyumi is the younger sister of Touya and the older sister of Natsuo and Shouto. Fuyumi is a hard working girl, often making meals for the family and works as a teacher at an unnamed school. Unlike her family members, she doesn't resent her father and just wishes they could all be a happy family, though she realizes such a thing is unlikely. Upon hearing Shouto gains friends, however, Fuyumi gets quite excited over it and is happy for him. In the past, Fuyumi took care of Shouto after their mother went to a hospital and never came back. To this day, her wish that she could have done something for Shouto still lingers within her.

characters.name: Inasa Yoarashi
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: **Height:** 190 cm (6'3") **Affiliation:** Shiketsu High School (First-Year Student) **Quirk:** Whirlwind Inasa is an energetic and enthusiastic young man who expresses himself with vigor. He's very loud, oddly polite, and values passion over anything else. Inasa believes that all heroes have "hot spirits" that enable them to motivate and help others. He disapproves of heroes who do not embody the spirit of passion, which is why he has negative feelings about Endeavor and his son.

characters.name: Kinoko  Komori
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: Kinoko Komori is a student in Class 1-B, and is training to be a Pro Hero. Her quirk, Mushroom, allows her to spread spores that sprout mushrooms wherever they land, including inside of people's bodies.

characters.name: Inko Midoriya
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm (5'3'') Izuku Midoriya's mother. Her quirk allows her to pull small objects towards her.

characters.name: Setsuna Tokage
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: Setsuna Tokage is a student in Class 1-B at U.A. High School, and is one of four students admitted through recommendations; one being her fellow 1-B classmate Juzo Honenuki, as well as rival Class 1-A students Shouto Todoroki and Momo Yaoyorozu.

characters.name: Emi Fukukado
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 5'5 __Quirk:__ Outburst Pro Hero and a teacher of 2nd year, Class 2 at Ketsubutsu Academy High School.

characters.name: Mitsuki Bakugou
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: Mitsuki Bakugou is Katsuki Bakugou's mother and the wife of Masaru Bakugou.

characters.name: Tomoko Shiretoko
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: Her Quirk allowed her to observe and monitor up to 100 people at a time, including their location and weak points.

characters.name: Shinya Kamihara
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 170 cm (5'7") __Quirk:__ Foldabody: Shinya's Quirk allows him to make his body and limbs extremely thin and long, effectively allowing him to transform himself into a razor sharp string. He is able to transform faster than the speed of sound. Shinya is a calm and focused individual, who is able to maintain a level head even when in a crisis situation, and encourages his teammates when they begin to panic. He is proven to be quite intelligent and is good at analyzing situations and strategy. He is the former Number 5 Pro-Hero, and is currently Number 4.

characters.name: Ibara Shiozaki
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 167 cm (5'6") __Quirk:__ Vine Student in Class 1-B at U.A. High School. Ibara is a very modest and courteous person. Although graceful and soft-spoken, she is not afraid to make her pure intentions known. She seems highly religious due to her talking about heaven and divine beings in passing on multiple occasions, and her ultimate moves having somewhat religious names such as "Faith's Shield" and "Crucifixion". Ibara's Quirk "Vine" (Tsuru) gives her hair-like vines that grow on her head. She can lengthen and manipulate the vines, allowing her to attack, defend and grapple. She also can detach them at will. The vines will grow back, provided her head receives proper sunlight and water.

characters.name: Shino Sousaki
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: Telepath: This Quirk allows Shino to utilize a mental transmission and send telepathic messages directly into people's minds. Shino, has displayed the ability to send a message to tens of people at a time. She can send messages, but she can't receive them

characters.name: Sirius
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: Sirius is a pro hero and sidekick of Selkie.

characters.name: Ryuuko Tsuchikawa
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 167cm (5'6") __Quirk:__ Earth Flow Ryuko Tsuchikawa also known as Pixie-Bob, is a Pro Hero and a member of the Wild, Wild Pussycats. She is a very hyperactive and loud person with little regard for how she may come off to other people and also is very self-conscious about her age. Ryuko's Quirk allows her to freely manipulate the earth for a variety of effects.

characters.name: Kuugo Sakamata
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: Gang Orca is the current No. 11 Pro Hero, dropping from his previous No. 10 place. He took part in the assault on All For One and the League of Villains at Kamino Ward, and later served as a makeshift villain during the Provisional Hero License Exam.

characters.name: Yui Kodai
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: Yui Kodai is a student in Class 1-B of U.A. High School. She is a quiet girl, but nevertheless cares about her fellow classmates.

characters.name: Pony  Tsunotori
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Quirk:__ Horn Cannon Pony is a timid girl. As a foreigner, she does not have much knowledge of the language in Japan. She is shown to be rather naive and innocent in personality, learning nasty phrases from Neito Monoma without realizing what those words mean, as shown when Neito tells Pony unkind phrases to tell Class 1-A. Pony is a thoughtful and diligent person. She is the one who made her team not lose against Class 1-A because of her strategy and perseverance. She is highly observant and seems to be a careful person. Despite this, she made some unkind comments towards Mezo Shoji in their battle, calling him an "octopus" and saying she doesn't like looking at him. Pony's Quirk allows her to send her horns flying and remotely control them at will. She is able to control up to four horns that are sent flying. She has also been shown to be able to balance on them as they carry her around, much like Hawks' wings. When Pony gets angry, she starts speaking in her native language: English.

characters.name: Shuuichi Iguchi
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 174 cm __Occupation:__ Villain __Affiliation:__ League of Villains (formerly), Paranormal Liberation Front (Lieutenant of Brown Regiment) __Quirk:__ Gecko Shuuichi is a villain affiliated with the League of Villains and part of its Vanguard Action Squad. He is completely obsessed with the ways of Stain to the point where he copies his clothing and weaponry style, aiming to follow the same ideals as him and make his dreams come true.

characters.name: Rikidou Satou
alt_names: Sweets Hero: Sugarman (甘味ヒーローシュガーマン)
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 185 cm (6'1") __Quirk:__ Sugar Rush Student in Class 1-A at U.A. High School. Rikidou is interested in sweets and baking, a valuable skill due to his Quirk. He is surprisingly talented at making sweets. Rikidou's Quirk Sugar Rush allows him to increase his strength five-fold for three minutes. To activate his Quirk, he needs to consume 10 grams of sugar. When converting sugar into strength, his cognitive functions gradually drop, making him sleepy afterward. For every additional 10 grams of sugar he ingests, he extends the time of increased strength by another three minutes.

characters.name: You Shindou
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 176 cm (5'9") __Affiliation:__ Ketsubutsu Academy High School __Quirk:__ Vibrate A second year at Ketsubutsu Academy. His quirk, "Vibrate," allows him to create large tremors similar to earthquakes, but firing off strong attacks leaves him immobile.

characters.name: Kouta Izumi
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 107cm (3'5") Kota Izumi is the nephew of Shino Sosaki and the son of the hero team Water Hose.

characters.name: Kaoruko Awata
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: Quirk: Bubble (バブル Baburu) With this Quirk, Kaoruko can make bubbles filled with an aroma that she had smelled at least once before. She can make both sweet-smelling bubbles and foul-smelling ones. When she’s too nervous, she produces very unpleasant-smelling bubbles that are self-destructing She is a dedicated hero as well as Sir Nighteyes sidekick

characters.name: Snipe
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Quirk:__ Homing Snipe is a Pro Hero and a member of the teaching staff at U.A. High School. Snipe has the appearance of a stereotypical western cowboy Snipe's Quirk allows him to lock on to any target he can see within six hundred meters and make any projectile he releases chase after said target

characters.name: Shinji Nishiya
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Height:__ 168 cm (5'6") __Quirk:__ Arbor Pro Hero. Underneath his helmet, he has puffy red leaf-like hair, though his face has remained unseen since he has only been shown while wearing his mask. Shinji is a very serious and focused person when it comes to being a hero in his hero duties; however, he easily feels down when someone takes his glory or credit. Shinji's Quirk "Arbor" (樹木, Jumoku) allows him to enlarge and control his wooden body parts into strong tree branches. These branches are excellent for binding.

characters.name: Naomasa Tsukauchi
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: Naomasa Tsukauchi is a police detective in the Police Force. Naomasa is a tall man with short black hair and black eyes. As a member of the police force, he is normally seen in his uniform. He wears a signature tan overcoat and a matching hat. He also sports a black suit underneath with matching slacks and dress shoes. Detective Tsukauchi is an earnest, hardworking individual who has earned the right to be a close friend of All Might. Enough so, that he was even entrusted with the truth about One For All and the latter's true form. He appears to have a close relationship with All Might, as he even leaked sensitive information to the hero just because he felt it was the right thing to do.

characters.name: Chiyo  Shuuzenji
alt_names: Recovery Girl (リカバリーガール)
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: __Quirk:__ Heal __Occupation:__ Pro Hero, Nurse Chiyo has a very kind and compassionate personality, where she treats everyone kindly, though she does have a strict and reproaching attitude towards those that have done something foolish. She's mostly like this with All Might for not teaching Izuku how to use his Quirk properly or with Izuku for using his Quirk recklessly.

characters.name: Ken Ishiyama
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: Cementoss is a Pro Hero as well as a teacher at U.A. High School. During the U.A. Sports Festival, he acted as the proctor for the 1-on-1 fights in case things got out of hand. He also faced off against Eijiro Kirishima and Rikido Sato in their Final Exam.

characters.name: Reiko Yanagi
characters.energy_system: Quirks (Emitter, Transformation, Mutant) & One For All / All For One
characters.description: Reiko is a quiet and emotionless teenager who often shows an odd body posture.

characters.name: Hisoka Morow
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: __Height: __187 cm Notorious for his cruel and deceitful fighting ability, Hisoka has proven to be deadly. His deviousness and volatility have caused many opponents to have difficulty anticipating his next move, and this has led to him winning many battles. Using Shu powered poker cards as his primary weapon, he throws them with ease and deadly accuracy. He is very intrigued by Gon and the potential this young boy has to become an adept and powerful adversary. Hisoka, ever looking for a strong opponent, is willing to aid, or at least not defeat prematurely, someone that could develop into a future opponent.

characters.name: Leorio Paradinight
characters.native_name: レオリオ・パラディナイト
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: __Height:__ 193 cm (6'4") Prior to the hunter exam, Leorio's close friend died to a curable illness, and Leorio was unable to save him due to his lack of money and knowledge. Because of this. he aims to become a doctor in order to help those without the money to pay for treatment. In order to cover his tuition for medical school, he decides to take the hunter exam, where he meets Gon, Killua, and Kurapika. Leorio is also talented at bargaining, being able to haggle shopkeepers to no end. He often seems brash and rude, but overall he cares deeply for his friends. Leorio is an emitter, although learning nen did not come easily to him.

characters.name: Chrollo Lucilfer
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: __Height:__ 177 cm __Occupation:__ Leader of the Phantom Troupe __Nen Type:__ Specialization Chrollo Lucilfer is a calm, young man, coming across as intelligent and charismatic. He seems to be a born leader, able to hold the Genei Ryodan (Phantom Troupe) together despite the volatile personalities that make up the group. He is also an incredibly skilled fighter.

characters.name: Feitan Portor
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: A mysterious member of the Phantom Troupe, Feitan is attired in what one would expect from a bandit - dark clothes with a skullhead scarf that covers his mouth. Feitan seldom speaks, but when he does, there's usually a word missing. Feitan's first language most likely isn't Japanese, but he has shown to be rather proficient in the Chinese language. He is one of the original members hailing from Meteor City.

characters.name: Isaac Netero
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: __Nen type:__ Enhancement None other than the Chairman of the Hunter Committee, and the final authority over the entirety of the Hunter Exam. He has enough administrative power to grant anyone the Hunter's license if he decides to do so, and enough combat power to playfully avoid attacks of the main heroes single-handedly when they challenge him. All examiners, even the most despotic ones, obey his orders without talking back. He was said to be the strongest Nen user in the world 50 years ago, but he comments that he is already past his prime at his current age and that his subordinates might be stronger than him now (yet his direct subordinates disagree). Netero is also revealed to be older than Zeno Zoldyck (Killua's Grandfather), who is said to be 67 years of age. At one point, Zeno says that when he was still a young boy, Netero was not only already old, but he is the only person alive who has fought with Maha (Zeno's) grandfather. Various stated times would put Netero over the three digit mark. He is able to use attacks faster than the speed of sound. He also uses the hyakushiki kannon which is also known as the 'Hundred Style of Buddha'. This utilizes nen to make the attacks seem as if they had come from another side and or dimension, simply because they move so fast. In the manga he is also shown fighting chimera ants and is heading towards the destined fight with the King. His assistants Morau and Novu note that he was the strongest Nen user 50 years ago, and show great respect for his abilities.

characters.name: Shizuku Murasaki
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Shizuku is member number 8 of the Phantom Troupe. She has been described as being a natural airhead, seeing as how some of her actions do not point towards her being very bright. Shizuku is quite forgetful; once she forgets something, she won't remember it. Her opponents are often fooled by her unassuming and blurred appearance—but this has often proved to be fatal for them once she enters in combat. Shizuku is also left-handed. __Nen Ability:__ Deme-chan (Blinky): Shizuku uses her nen to create a self-styled "living" vacuum cleaner she names "Deme-chan" that is able to consume any inanimate matter under her command. This has proven very useful in many occasions for cleaning up evidence that the members leave behind, especially blood and dead corpses. She also uses the razor-sharp teeth on the "mouth" as a weapon when in combat. Anything sucked up into her vacuum cleaner cannot be retrieved, except for the last material that was sucked in.

characters.name: Neferpitou
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: __Nen Type:__ Specialization A cat-humanoid Chimera Ant and the firstborn of the Chimera Ant King's three Royal Guards. Neferpitou is very loyal to the King, just like the rest of the Royal Guards that would sacrifice themselves for him. Neferpitou gets distracted easily, loves to play a lot and that makes them the most curious of the three Royal Guards. Hence their cat-like appearance, Pitou is a cat Chimera Ant who loves to play with their opponents like a cat would with their prey. Despite their cheerful and playful manner, Pitou has a sadistic and terrifying personality as well. Unlike Menthuthuyoupi and Shaiapouf, Neferpitou does not seem to mind much in regards to Meruem's later newfound interests with Komugi. Thus, among the three Royal Guards, Neferpitou is the only one that greatly prioritizes Komugi's safety as opposed to how Menthuthuyoupi and Shaiapouf hate Komugi, which causes tension among the guards.

characters.name: Illumi Zoldyck
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: __Height:__ 185 cm __Nen Type:__ Manipulation Illumi is Killua's eldest brother. He is an experienced assassin, whom along with his father was responsible for Killua's training and upbringing.

characters.name: Kite
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: __Nen Type:__ Conjuration Kite is the very first Hunter introduced in the story. He is a disciple of Ging Freecss, Gon's father. After saving Gon from a foxbear on Whale Island, Kite revealed to him the truth about his father. Before he took his leave, Kite left Ging's Hunter License in Gon's hands. After leaving Greed Island, Gon runs into Kite again, while he is in the middle of a zoological survey, searching for new species, in the country of Kakin. At the time, he was leading a team of young would-be Hunters.

characters.name: Biscuit Krueger
characters.native_name: ビスケット＝クルーガー
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Biscuit is a master and experienced teacher of Nen. She continues the Nen training Wing gave to Gon and Killua during the Greed Island arc. As a Treasure Hunter, Biscuit loves collecting rare jewels (and gets very excited about them; she has a habit of naming them) and getting money. Biscuit has a devious personality. She initially uses her cutesy appearance and demeanor to her advantage whether it's for information gathering, getting what she wants, or even in combat by acting innocent and helpless so most people will usually put their guards down around her. However, as a teacher of Nen, she has a stern and serious attitude towards her students.

characters.name: Alluka Zoldyck
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Alluka Zoldyck is the second youngest sibling of the Zoldyck Family. She is said to be a dark, uncontrollable child. Her younger brother Kalluto is envious of her, perhaps because of her closeness to Killua.

characters.name: Komugi
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Komugi is a blind girl who is a genius at Gung-gi, a fictional board game of Hunter x Hunter. She is introduced during the Chimera Ant arc and frequently plays Meruem, the Chimera Ant King, in Gung-Gi games. Meruem seems to be developing some feelings towards her, despite her being a human.

characters.name: Machi Komacine
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: __Height:__ 159 cm Not known to show much emotion, Machi seems to be one of the coldest members of the Phantom Troupe. The only person she has shown some feeling towards was Chrollo. Hisoka seems to have an occasional interest with her, although it's hard to see whether it's genuine, given Hisoka's unpredictability. Machi also doesn't appear to be interested in him, spurning his advances on all occasions. Machi is one of the Phantom Troupe that originated from Meteor City. __Nen Ability:__ Machi's nen transforms into thin wispy-long threads in which she uses in a variety of ways, including seaming together old wounds to heal them, repairing back dislodged limbs and forming a noose that can strangle enemies with a tug. Her thread's strength is inversely proportional to the length. The longer the thread she makes, the easier it is to break.

characters.name: Ging Freecss
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: __Height:__ 176 cm (5'9") A famous 2-star ancient ruins hunter and the father of Gon Freeccs. When Ging was a child, he left his home on Whale Island to become a hunter and did not return home for 10 years, carrying a young Gon whom he entrusted to Mito. He is the primary reason Gon decides to leave home, following in his footsteps to become a hunter and find his father.

characters.name: Knuckle Bine
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: __Nen Type:__ Conjuration Knuckle Bine is an Unidentified Beast Hunter and Morel's apprentice. Despite appearing to be an aggressive man, Knuckle is very compassionate and easily moved to tears. Knuckle also gets along well with animals, having the habit of taking care of abandoned pets.

characters.name: Pakunoda
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Pakunoda exudes an air of self-confidence that can be intimidating to others. She is fully loyal to Chrollo. She is one of the original Phantom Troupe from Meteor City. Her physical strength is 11th in the Troupe. She has the ability to read the conscious thoughts of any person she is in physical contact with and can extract memories by asking specific questions. Attempting to create false information is impossible, since she can extract her target's purest memories. The information she collects is highly useful in exposing weaknesses and secrets, especially in finding out the opponent's nen ability or in situations requiring some form of extortion or blackmail. Her ability can also be used to see the recent past of an object. She also has the ability to share her memories by shooting them into another person's head using a revolver and conjured nen bullets called "Memory Bombs". This is not a combat ability, and does no damage. If she shoots a Memory Bomb into the person from whom the memories were read, those memories are erased permanently.

characters.name: Shaiapouf
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Butterfly-humanoid Chimera Ant and one of Meruem's Royal Guards.

characters.name: Ikalgo
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: __Nen Type:__ Manipulation Ikalgo is a former officer of the chimera ants whom eventually befriends Killua. Ikalgo, an octopus, wishes he had been a squid instead. After saving Killua's life after a battle, Ikalgo teams up with him in the assault on the palace of East Gorteau. ## __Ikalgo's Abilities:__

characters.name: Morel Mackernasey
characters.native_name: モラウ=マッカーナーシ
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: __Nen Type:__ Manipulation Morel is a Hunter who uses a giant smoking pipe and smoke as weapons, and who has a great sense of compassion. As his role progresses during the chimera ant arc, Morel shows himself as an experienced and resourceful fighter, which is shown in his fight against Leol wherein he uses his pipe as a snorkel so that he could allow himself to breathe underwater, and in doing so suffocates his opponent with the Carbon Dioxide he had emitted. The smoke that he uses are for his nen ability, able to take on various shapes and could act independently to him once commands are issued. ## __Morel's Abilities:__

characters.name: Shalnark Ryuseih
characters.native_name: シャルナーク=リュウセイ
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: From his appearance, Shalnark seems to be a guileless and normal boy. However, see him in action with the rest of the Phantom Troupe and that thought is dispelled. Shalnark is one of the most intelligent and quick-thinking members in the group —being adept at using technology for information gathering, providing the brains behind the brawn. Shalnark is also a Hunter, so he has the ability to gain access to certain information that could be potentially useful for the Phantom Troupe He is member number 9 of the Troupe. __Nen Abilities:__ Black Voice - Mobile Fate Detector: Shalnark is able to control the physical movements of any person he has targeted, as long as he has a special antenna on them and that person is not already being controlled. This is done via a cellphone interface in which he remotely controls other people from a distance while pointing the antenna at the person he's controlling. Auto Mode: When Shalnark places an antenna on himself, he temporarily gains immense strength. However, he can only control himself through giving himself instructions and cannot withdraw from Auto Mode until he has accomplished the task. After going out of Auto Mode, Shalnark cannot move for two days. He also doesn't retain any memory from what happened in that state.

characters.name: Canary
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: __Height:__ 164 cm (5′4.5) A servant to the Zoldyck family. She believes their difference in status means they will never be close. Unbeknownst to her, Killua regards her as a dear friend. She is initially introduced as a ruthless guardian who does not hesitate to attack trespassers, but, as noted by Gon, she is not as heartless as she pretends to be, and just for a fraction of a second, her eyes convey gentleness or concern, although she tries to suppress it.

characters.name: Wing
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Wing is a Nen trainer whose main student is Zushi. He meets Gon and Killua at the Celestial Tower. Although in the beginning he refuses to train Gon and Killua, and even lies to them about Nen's purpose, he changes his mind when they reach the 200th floor, as he realizes they could die or be badly injured from nen "initiation". For the next several months he teaches them the basics of Nen, after which he announces they have passed the secret final requirement for being a Hunter. His teacher was Biscuit Kruger.

characters.name: Zeno Zoldyck
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Zeno Zoldyck is Killua's grandfather and Silva's father. A witty old man, his advancing age has not dampened his quick thinking and speed in battle. Zeno wears alternating signs on his garb that say either "A Kill A Day" or "Never Retire." He appears to be on good terms with the Hunter Committee's Chairman, Netero, who hired Zeno to assault Ming Jol-ik's palace in East Gorteau in order to catch the chimera ant King off guard. Zeno favors Killua more than his other grandchildren, most likely because Killua is the heir of the family.

characters.name: Pariston Hill
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Pariston Hill is a Triple-Star Hunter and both the former 13th Chairman and 12th Vice Chairman of the Hunter Association. He is also a former member of the Zodiacs with the codename Rat. According to Ging Freecss, Pariston's personality is similar to Netero's and his own in that he likes to play around and enjoy himself, uninterested in winning or losing, which makes him very unpredictable.
