He always appears cheerful with a bright smile, making it quite impossible to read his thoughts and calculate his motives. This alone infuriates the Zodiacs, mostly Cheadle, Kanzai, and Cluck. He is extremely sly and gets pleasure from destroying what he loves most. Simultaneously, he is infuriated by and enjoys a rivalry with Ging; Pariston has rarely hated anyone, though he does awful things to them and is curious to see what he would do to someone he hates, with Ging currently occupying that position. He has a preference for harsh punishments for anyone who does him wrong. He tends to treat serious situations as mere games, such as the elections for the 13th chairman. When he wins the chairman position, he casually hands it to Cheadle and resigns. He has also 5,000 cocooned Chimera Ants for his private playground. Due to his extreme unpredictability, slyness, shadiness and the tendency to test anyone's patience and temper, he is disliked by all of the Zodiacs and many Hunters in the Association, even more than Ging. Even Morel states that he would rather die than vote for a slew rat-like Pariston. It is also shown that Netero also cannot stand him and often gets into a lot of arguments with him, but he tolerates Pariston's presence because he believes that a yes-man second-in-command is too boring for him. Pariston became a Hunter in preparation for Beyond's expedition to the Dark Continent. Three years before Netero's demise, Pariston was appointed Vice Chairman of the Hunter Association, partly because Netero enjoyed how Pariston challenged him, and made him a member of the Zodiacs. During his time as Vice Chairman, Pariston handled the business side of the Hunter Association. During those three years, 18 Hunters went missing, an average of six per year, in contrast to an average of 0.6 Hunters per year prior to Pariston's term, which also included Ging. Pariston declared that if he became Chairman, that number would go down, implying he played a part in the mysterious disappearances, although he may have done so only to irritate Mizaistom,[1] who suspects that Pariston has ties to the underworld. Other shady dealings include a scandal in which funds from the Temp Agency established by Pariston were found in his account, which he claims was all a misunderstanding, as the money was supposedly a reserve fund to strengthen the Hunter Association. Through his Temp Agency and position as Vice Chairman, Pariston succeeded in acquiring a firm grasp over the organization, obtaining the power to control the Review Board from the shadows and thus give jobs only to his supporters.

characters.name: Kalluto Zoldyck
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Kalluto Zoldyck is the younger brother of Killua. He was initially introduced accompanying his mother during Gon's retrieval of Killua from his home on Kukuroo Mountain. Kalluto appears again during the Yorknew City arc, assisting his older brother Illumi with the assassination of the ten mafia dons that placed bounties on the Phantom Troupe's heads. After the Phantom Troupe's entrance into Greed Island, Kalluto joins as Hisoka's replacement. During the Phantom Troupe's assault on Zazan's palace in Meteor City, he reveals he joined the Spiders with the intention of bringing Killua back home.

characters.name: Silva Zoldyck
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Silva is Killua's father. He is a silent, pensive figure, and Killua seems to rarely interact with him, although Killua does look up to him. He allows Killua to go along with Gon on their journey, but this is only so Killua would gain more experience when thrown out into the real world on his own. In fact, Silva was confident that Killua would eventually return home on his own, as an assassin.

characters.name: Uvogin
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: __Height:__ 258cm Uvogin is the eleventh member of the Phantom Troupe. Nobunaga has compared his personality to Gon's, seeing how not only do they have the same Nen type, but their behavior is similar as well, being impulsive and short tempered. Uvogin is one of the Phantom Troupe that originated from Meteor City. However, like all of the Phantom Troupe, Uvogin doesn't hesitate to kill anyone. Out of all of the Phantom Troupe, Uvogin is the strongest in terms of physical power. Although he prefers to fight alone, Uvogin works best when fighting with a partner (specifically, Nobunaga) as he fights better when he has someone else to protect, though he would never admit it. __Nen Ability:__

characters.name: Menchi
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: One of the two examiners that presided over the second stage of the Exam. Her exam topic was to prepare a piece of sushi for her to taste. If it met up to her stringent expectations, the candidate would pass.

characters.name: Nobunaga Hazama
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Like one of the ronin warriors in Edo period Japan, Nobunaga comes complete with a long Japanese sword that he uses with great finesse and skill. Nobunaga's speciality is the unparalleled use of the sword in executing enemies. Franklin has described him as the "King of Carelessness." His best friend is Uvogin, and the two bring out the best in each other during combat. Seeing some of Uvogin's personality in Gon, he expressed interest in having Gon join the Troupe, though Gon adamantly refused. He is one of the Phantom Troupe that originated from Meteor City. Nobunaga's En: Supplementing his swordfighting skills is the use of En in creating a circular boundary that can detect the slightest of movements of his opponents. Once the opponent steps into this boundary, an immediate retaliation can be expected from Nobunaga.

characters.name: Meleoron
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: A chameleon-like ant, Meleoron is an eccentric among chimera ants, as he dislikes fighting or killing. Even though Meleoron has the rank of a squadron leader, he himself admits his actual fighting strength is only on par with a common soldier ant. Meleoron dresses in a hooded sweatshirt with sweatpants, and is often seen smoking. His original name, before the chimera ant queen died, was Jail.

characters.name: Knov
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Knov is a Hunter who participated in the Chimera Ant Extermination Mission.

characters.name: Ponzu
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Examinee #246 during the Hunter Exam. Ponzu is the only prominent female who managed to enter the last few stages of the Hunter exam. Her secret weapon lies in the big round hat she wears, which carries powerful bees under the surface that emerge and attack people that threaten her. Although Ponzu is a relatively minor character in the series, her cute and girlish charm has won her some fans who voted for her in an early Hunter popularity poll.

characters.name: Palm Siberia
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Palm Siberia is Knov's apprentice. She only appears in the manga and develops a crush on Gon at one stage. She, on most occasions, has scruffy hair and too much make-up, not to mention a frightening aura caused by stress. However, sometimes she will do herself up and looks stunning.

characters.name: Nanika
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Nanika is a mysterious Dark Continent creature who came to possess Alluka Zoldyck under unknown circumstances. The two currently coexist inside Alluka's body.

characters.name: Senritsu
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Senritsu, known as Melody in the Viz Media translation, is a Music Hunter, named for her skill with instruments. Senritsu is a Music Hunter and is the kind and understanding member of Neon's bodyguards. She is always ready to listen to anyone's confessions and has the gift to make people open up to her. As Leorio notes, she is one of the very few characters who has made Kurapika open up to her.

characters.name: Phinks Magcub
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Phinks is a genius when it comes to unarmed combat. Phinks uses his hands in battle, which have been shown to be extremely powerful. He is rather brash and has a tendency to get into conflicts with other people. Phinks is one of the members of the Phantom Troupe that originated from Meteor City. He first appears in Egyptian Suit but later changed into jogging suit. He seems to get along with Feitan. Phinks also displays a level of compassion for Zazan's minions after they are released from her control. When they beg him to kill them he refuses to simply execute them on their knees, instead urging them to fight back and die in battle honorably. __Nen Ability:__ Ripper Cyclotron: Phinks's nen ability involves how many times he rotates his arm. The more rotations that he does with the arm, the stronger his blow will become.

characters.name: Shoot McMahon
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Shoot McMahon (シュート＝マクマホン, Shūto Makumahon?) is an Unidentified Beast Hunter, Knuckle's partner, and the second disciple of Morel. He has a timid personality and is often afraid of taking advantage of opportune times to attack his enemy. When the fight begins with Youpi, he becomes inspired by Gon and is able to fully unleash his power, overcoming his timidness and injuries.

characters.name: Zushi
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: A young boy who studies Shingen-Ryu Kung fu and Nen under the tutelage of Wing, whom Gon and Killua meet in the Heavens Arena. He is a formidable fighter and a prodigy in his own right, said to have skills only 1 out of 100,000 people have. However, he is quickly surpassed by Gon and Killua, who are said to have skills only 1 out of 10,000,000 people have. According to the results of his water divination, Zushi is a Manipulator. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Mito Freecss
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Mito Freecss is Gon's adopted mother, and cousin to Ging Freecss. In the manga, Mito did not want Gon to become a Hunter because Ging only came back home once after he took the Hunter's exam. She did not want Gon to leave his family like Ging did. In the manga and in the 2011 anime, Ging is Mito's cousin. However in the original anime and novelization, Mito was made into the sister of Gon's mother, making Ging her brother-in-law.

characters.name: Satotz
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: A seemingly mouthless man, the appointed examiner for the first part of the Hunter Exam. He tests the examinees' stamina by leading them on an marathon of initially unknown length through an underground tunnel. Though he seems only to move his legs at a fast walking pace, the examinees are forced to run faster and faster to keep up with his speed. After they emerge from the tunnel, Satotz then leads the examinees through the Numere Marsh, nicknamed the "The Swindler's Nest", a swamp filled with deadly man-eating animals, before leaving them at the site of the second exam. As an Archaeological Hunter in his normal profession, he was also inspired by Ging in taking up the Hunter license. He initially simply felt a strong civic duty to carry out his role as a judge, he progressively takes a liking to Gon and wishes to help him.

characters.name: Neon Nostrade
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Neon is the daughter of the boss of the Nostrade family, who are part of the Mafia. She is a hyper but spoiled young girl, who enjoys collecting body parts (whether they are legal or not) as her hobby. She is constantly protected by many bodyguards by the order of her father. Neon possesses a prophetic ability, which she calls "Lovely Ghost Writer". While she herself does not realize this, it is a form of specialization nen. Her prophecies are 100% accurate and written in the form of a poem. Neon cannot predict her own future, and is able to write a prophecy using only a small amount of information from her client. The prophecy is a automatic process, so what is written on the paper must be asked by the person in question. Neon's father was able to rise up in rank in the Mafia because of her ability. This made her father more interested in her ability then her life. This also made her father overly protected over her, assigning her many bodyguards. Kurapika is one of Neon's bodyguards. (Source: AnimeNfo.com)

characters.name: Menthuthuyoupi
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Mentsutsuyupi, nicknamed Yupi, is the third of the chimera ant king's Royal Guard. Mentsutsuyupi is the largest of the Royal Guards and the only non-human hybrid among them, mixed with the genes of a magical beast instead. He is the most straightforward of the royal guards and possesses a strength that comes from complete selflessness and devotion to the King. Youpi's ability allows for both bodily metamorphosis and the transformation of his own anger into pure destructive power. His Hatsu allows for him to billow large quantities of his aura into his body through En, subsequently resulting in an explosion. Youpi can use his explosive ability in conjunction with his shape-shifting ability, physically manifesting the blast's power into his own body. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Colt
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Colt (コルト, Koruto) is a Chimera Ant squadron leader. His name from when he was human is Kurt.

characters.name: Beans
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Beans (Maamen in the Nippon Animation adaptation) is Netero's personal secretary and helps to organize a lot of things during Hunter Exam. Beans gives examinees their number badges prior to the Hunter Exam and gives a presentation on the uses of the Hunter License to the successful candidates of the Exam.

characters.name: Gotou
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: The Zoldyck family manager. All contacts with the family members must go through him. An enigmatic and intimidating character, Killua once expressed to Gon his recurring nightmares of Gotou chasing him with a knife. He is also superb at the "where is the coin" trick. He cares for Killua as if he was his own son.

characters.name: Razor
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Razor is one of the Gamemasters and a creator of Greed Island. Razor was entrusted by Gon's father that he was not to hold back against his son should he ever comes to Greed Island. Razor is a tall and well built man by appearance and perhaps likes to play sports (especially ball games) as a pastime.Razor is a key person in getting one of the hardest designated card of the game. To get the card, the challengers must confront Razor and his 14 devils. It was learned that the 14 devils were not the pirates that follows him but his ability to emit 14 nen creatures at will. He can also emit nen into a ball (or create a ball from nen) and throw it at his opponent, which is extremely strong and could critically injure or kill his opponent on a direct hit. He was defeated in a deadly dodgeball game by Gon's allied party (consisting of Gon, Killua, Biscuit, Hisoka, and several other hunter/players hired by Battera).Razor later revealed to Gon that he was a former convict along the same as the pirates here whom were exiled to Greed Island. Razor is also the warden of these convicts. He became one of Ging's best friends and entrusted to look after the island as one of the Gamemasters.

characters.name: Leroute
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Leroute is a criminal who manipulates her victims. She is smart, sharp, and insightful. Leroute was formerly a deranged psychologist who reveled in the misery of her clients. She often attacked her victims psychologically to such a degree that they often committed suicide.

characters.name: Cheadle Yorkshire
characters.native_name: チードル=ヨークシャー
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: She is a Triple-Star Disease Hunter and a member of the Zodiacs with the codename "Dog".

characters.name: Baka Ki El Dogra
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: The first prince of the planet Dogura. He has an exceptionally high IQ and has little interest other than using it to torment those around him for his own amusement. His real name is Baka Ki El Dogra, but everybody refers to him solely as Prince or Prince Baka (a play with words since baka-ouji can mean both "Prince Baka" and "stupid prince"). He also appears for a few minutes in episode 36 of Hunter x Hunter (2011), commenting on an arena match. His voice actor was unlisted, however.

characters.name: Hanzou
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: An 18-year-old jounin ninja from the Cloud Hidden Village whom has trained in the art of ninjutsu from the moment he could stand. He decided to become a Hunter in order to find the elusive Hermit's Scroll.

characters.name: Cheetu
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Cheetu (ヂートゥ, Jītu) is fastest of all the chimera ants. Cheetu is first introduced along with the other recurring squadron leaders early in the Chimera Ant story arc (Source: Hunterpedia)

characters.name: Baise
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: One of the bodyguards hired to protect Neon. She is from the Manipulation group. Her hatsu, Instant Love, makes every man she kisses her slave. Her slaves enjoy being hurt by her, which she videotapes. She uses this to make men tell the truth.

characters.name: Pokkle
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: __Nen Type:__ Emission In the same Hunter exam as Gon, Pokkle ends up passing. He pursues his dream of becoming a Wildlife Hunter, discovering new types of animals and plants. In the Hunter exam Pokkle uses a bow and arrows tipped with a paralyzing poison. After discovering nen, he creates a hatsu called Rainbow;. It can shoot 7 different arrows, every color of the rainbow. Every color has a different attribute. Only his red and orange arrow have been seen: flame element and the highest speed, respectively.

characters.name: Welfin
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Welfin is a Chimera Ant that resembles a humanoid wolf and a former tactician. His name from when he was human is Zaikahal (ザイカハル Zaikaharu). After the death of the Chimera Ant King, Welfin travels to Meteor City in search of Gyro. __Nen Type:__ Conjuration ## __Welfin's Abilities:__

characters.name: Tonpa
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Examinee #16 during the Hunter exam. Tonpa is nicknamed the "Rookie Crusher" by other candidates with more experience taking the exam. Tonpa has taken the exam for 35 consecutive terms (given that the Hunter exam can only be taken by someone who is at least 12, it means that Tonpa either was lying, sneaked in the first two times, or that the age limit is a new rule), but has somehow never managed to pass. He often brags of his experience to those taking the Hunter Exam for the first time and then offers them a helping hand. Of course, this is merely subterfuge as he takes a perverse pleasure in sabotaging their attempts to get the license.

characters.name: Gyro
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Gyro is the founder and the former king of NGL. As a human, he suffered an abusive childhood at the hands of his alcoholic father. His ambition is to spread evil throughout the world.

characters.name: Hina
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Hina is usually seen accompanying Leol and Flutter.

characters.name: Koala
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Koala was a soldier under Meleoron's command, but disapproved of Meleoron's pacifist attitude. He generally does not take part in the war between the Hunters and Chimera Ants. After Meleoron has gone individual, he is presumably free from any duty.

characters.name: Zazan
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Zazan is a scorpion-like Chimera Ant Squadron Leader.

characters.name: Eeta
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Eeta is, like her twin sister Elena, one of the eleven who helped make Greed Island. One of the E's in "Greed" comes from her name. She is in charge of moving people from the real world to Greed Island. She plays the tape for Gon, left behind by his father.

characters.name: Amane
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Amane is a female servant of the Zoldyck Family.

characters.name: List
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: List is one of the eleven people responsible for creating Greed Island. The "L" in "Island" is the first letter of his name. List lives in the castle along with Dwun. He appears to be Dwun's counterpart; he is neat and well mannered as opposed to the messy and rude Dwun.

characters.name: Spinner Clow
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Spinner Clow is a young girl and an amateur beast hunter and member of the Kakin exploration team lead by Kite.

characters.name: Bonolenov Ndongo
characters.native_name: ボノレノフ゠ンドンゴ
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Bonolenov is member number 13 of the Phantom Troupe. He dresses partially in rags and looks like a mummy. During the Yorknew City arc, his appearance was insignificant. During the Chimera Ant arc, he was seen fighting with the rest of the Phantom Troupe against the Chimera ants. Very little is known about his personality and reasons for joining the Troupe, but in the fight with the Chimera ants he displays a mocking and confident attitude.

characters.name: Elena
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Elena is, like her twin sister Eeta, one of the eleven who helped make Greed Island. One of the e's in "Greed" comes from her name. She is in charge of moving people from Greed Island to the real world, and is happy when Gon remembered her name.

characters.name: Franklin Bordeaux
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: A hulking, Frankensteinian monster is what Franklin (Furankurin) appears to be, complete with scars and sewn-up wounds that ravage his face. It does seem though, that beneath his harsh exterior lies a small, caring spot in his character, as Franklin acts as a caregiver to Shizuku, and shows concern of her well-being. He is also composed and respectful, normally breaking up arguments and fights within the organization. He is one of the members of the Phantom Troupe that originated from Meteor City. Nen Ability - Double Machine Gun: Franklin is a human machine gun, as his fingers cap off to reveal chambers where he channels his nen that shoot out as bullets. His fingers weren't required to be cut off and used as caps in order to achieve this, but Franklin did so because he felt "it would be more effective." Doing this actually did greatly enhance the force of his Nen Bullets, due to the commitment he showed in doing so. This power has been shown to wipe out a room full of people within seconds.

characters.name: Piyon
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Piyon is a Paleograph Hunter and member of the Zodiacs with the codename "Rabbit". Piyon is one of the few characters in the series to be left handed.

characters.name: Cocco
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: The live announcer at the arena.

characters.name: Kiriko
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: Kiriko are Magical Beasts that can change their own physical appearance.

characters.name: Shidore
characters.energy_system: Nen (Ten, Zetsu, Ren, Hatsu — Enhancer, Transmuter, Emitter, Conjurer, Manipulator, Specialist)
characters.description: A Chimera Ant and former Peon from Leol's Squad Although initially believed to be unable to talk due to her being a lower ant, this is actually due to Shidore being a very young child. She always obeys her orders silently and seems loyal to Hina

characters.name: Noelle Silva
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Height:__ 161 cm (5'3") Noelle Silva is a member of the Black Bulls and was inducted into the squad around the same time as Asta. She is the second daughter of one of the Clover Kingdom's royal families, House Silva, and the younger sister of the captain of the Silver Eagles, Nozel Silva. She likes sweets.

characters.name: Yuno
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Height:__ 172 cm (5'7") Yuno was left, along with Asta, in front of a church in a village called Hage when he was an infant. He grew up at the church and spends most of his day with Asta. Sometime later, a thug tries to take his necklace away from him and sell it for money. Fortunately, Asta steps in and tries to take it back. In the end, the thug decided to leave without the necklace after Asta keeps charging at him. Since then, Yuno stopped crying and decides to take Asta's dream to be the Wizard King as his own as well.

characters.name: Yami Sukehiro
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Height:__ 183 cm Yami Sukehiro is a foreigner from the Land of the Sun and the first captain of the Clover Kingdom's Black Bulls squad of the Magic Knights.

characters.name: Mereoleona Vermillion
characters.native_name: メレオレオナ・ヴァーミリオン
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Height:__ 178 cm She is a noblewoman and the first daughter of the Clover Kingdom's House Vermillion, one of its royal families. She is also the captain of the Crimson Lion squad and the Royal Knights squad.

characters.name: Julius Novachrono
characters.native_name: ユリウス・ノヴァクロノ
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Height:__ 180 cm The Wizard King of Clover Kingdom's Order of the Magic Knights. Fascinated by magic in all its forms, he eagerly seeks out and observes unusual magical abilities whenever possible. Those close to him know him for his boundless enthusiasm, excitement, and curiosity toward magic. __Chapter 333 spoiler:__

characters.name: Luck Voltia
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Species:__ Human __Affinity:__ Lightning __Height:__ 167 cm A 5th Class Junior Magic Knight of Clover Kingdom's Black Bull and Royal Knights squads.

characters.name: Kuro Nero
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Species:__ Anti-bird __Height:__ 8 cm An Anti-bird who decided to stay alongside Asta after encountering him at the beginning of the Magic Knights Entrance Exam.

characters.name: Zora Ideale
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords

characters.name: Vanessa Enoteca
characters.native_name: バネッサ・エノテーカ
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Height:__ 170 cm Originally from the Forest of Witches, Vanessa is a member of the Black Bull Brigade.

characters.name: Charmy Pappitson
characters.native_name: チャーミー・パピットソン
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Height:__ 142 cm Member of the Black Bull squad. She is an extremely big eater and tougher than she looks. When someone threatens to steal her meals, she becomes cold and merciless. In contrast, she is actually very generous and loves to share her meals with her friends, going so far as to constantly give them food after they have already expressed their satisfaction.

characters.name: Mimosa Vermillion
characters.native_name: ミモザ・ヴァーミリオン
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm Mimosa is a noblewoman of Clover Kingdom's House Vermillion and a member of the Golden Dawn squad of the Magic Knights.

characters.name: Finral Roulacase
characters.native_name: フィンラル・ルーラケイス
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Height:__ 173 cm (5'8'') He is a nobleman of House Vaude and a member of Clover Kingdom's Black Bull squad of the Magic Knights. He is from Tota, a village within the Clover Kingdom.

characters.name: Nacht Faust
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Height:__ 180 cm Nacht is a devil host and a former nobleman of House Faust. He spent several years working as a spy within the Spade Kingdom.

characters.name: Charlotte Roselei
characters.native_name: シャーロット・ローズレイ
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Height:__ 171 cm Charlotte is a noblewoman of House Roselei and the captain of Clover Kingdom's Blue Rose squad of the Magic Knights. She appears as a quiet, cold, and indifferent woman who keeps her emotions controlled and well hidden. She is constantly shown to appear as a rather stern woman, despite inwardly having an inward monologue that constantly appears to say calm down, especially around Yami Sukehiro. She often does not respond to situations that go out of hand, preferring to appear indifferent and let things play out. She does respond well to emergencies and pressing concerns, performing her duties and moving swiftly to take care of any problems that come up. However, she still is capable of losing her composure and becoming annoyed, which almost always involves Yami teasing of her. She is also a lightweight when it comes to alcohol, barely able to finish a pint before becoming drunk. Charlotte considers her duty to the kingdom to be her foremost responsibility, with little interest in the social aspects of life. Her beauty is quite noticeable when she chooses to show it, but she is more comfortable in plate mail than silk dresses and cares little for the opinions of most others. She also has a hard time being open with most people and expressing herself on occasion. That said, she often quips back at her fellow captains when they make rash decisions or do something she considers stupid, particularly Yami. However, she also has admiration for those who are competent and work hard, though she rarely ever shows it. Outwardly, she displays little interest in finding a husband and becomes angry when the subject is brought up, for which Yami repeatedly teases her and calls her "Spiny Prickly Queen."

characters.name: Magna Swing
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Height:__ 169 cm A member of the Black Bulls magic knight squad. Coming from Rayaka out in the countryside, he can easily bond with Asta whom he is profoundly impressed by. His magic allows him to form fireballs which he can hurl at targets. He uses them as baseballs for the unofficial welcoming ceremonies he holds for new recruits. He can also form a magic bat for hitting his fireballs.

characters.name: Liebe
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords

characters.name: Fuegoleon Vermillion
characters.native_name: フエゴレオン・ヴァーミリオン
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Height:__ 188 cm He is a nobleman and the first son of the Clover Kingdom's House Vermillion, one of its royal families. He is also the former captain of the Crimson Lion squad of the Magic Knights.

characters.name: Nozel Silva
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Height:__ 177 cm Nozel is a nobleman and the oldest son of the Clover Kingdom's ruling family, House Silva. He is also the captain of the Silver Eagle squad of the Magic Knights.

characters.name: Dorothy Unsworth
characters.native_name: ドロシー・アンズワース
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: Dorothy is the captain of Clover Kingdom's Coral Peacock squad of the Magic Knights. She sleeps most of the time, but when she is awake she can bring enemies into a dream world where she controls everything.

characters.name: Gordon Agrippa
characters.native_name: ゴードン・アグリッパ
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Height:__ 187 cm (6'1.6") __Affinity:__ Poison Magic He is a member of Clover Kingdom's Black Bull squad of the Magic Knights. Gordon was born into the Agrippa Family, a commoner family infamous for their Curse Magic. He grew up lonely and unable to make friends due to his magic and appearance. After receiving his grimoire, Gordon abandoned his family and joined the Black Bull squad of the Magic Knights. Over the years, he comes to view them as friends.

characters.name: William Vangeance
characters.native_name: ウィリアム・ヴァンジャンス
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Height:__ 172 cm William Vangeance is the captain of Clover Kingdom's Golden Dawn squad of the Magic Knights. He is currently the closest person to becoming the next Wizard King.

characters.name: Grey
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Species:__ Human __Affinity: __Transformation __Height:__ 159cm A 3rd Class Junior Magic Knight of Clover Kingdom's Black Bull squad.

characters.name: Gauche Adlai
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Height:__ 181 cm He is a nobleman of House Adlai and a member of Clover Kingdom's Black Bull squad. He is also the smartest and most clever member of the Black Bulls. Obsessed with his sister Marie.

characters.name: Rill Boismortier
characters.native_name: リル・ボワモルティエ
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm Rill is the captain of Clover Kingdom's Azure Deer squad of the Magic Knights and a member of the Royal Knights squad.

characters.name: Leopold Vermillion
characters.native_name: レオポルド・ヴァーミリオン
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Height:__ 164 cm A nobleman and the second son of the Clover Kingdom's House Vermillion, one of its royal families. He is a member of the Crimson Lion squad of the Magic Knights.

characters.name: Lily Aquaria
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm __Affinity:__ Water A nun and caretaker at the orphanage in Hage.

characters.name: Licht
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Species:__ Elf __Affinity:__ Sword Magic __Height:__ 173 cm Licht is the leader of the Elf Tribe and one of its ten Apostles of Sephirah. He was married to Tetia, a human woman and the sister of Lemiel Silvamillion Clover, the first Magic Emperor.

characters.name: Klaus Lunettes
characters.native_name: クラウス・リュネット
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Height:__ 176 cm Klaus is a nobleman and a member of Clover Kingdom's Golden Dawn squad of the Magic Knights.

characters.name: Zenon Zogratis
characters.native_name: ゼノン・ゾグラティス
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: Zenon is a member of Spade Kingdom's Dark Triad His magic Attribute is Bone Magic, and his Demon's magic gives him Spatial Magic

characters.name: Jack the Ripper
characters.native_name: ジャック・ザリッパー
alt_names: ジャック・ザ・リッパー
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Height:__ 197 cm Jack is the captain of Clover Kingdom's Green Mantis squad of the Magic Knights.

characters.name: Vanica Zogratis
characters.native_name: ヴァニカ・ゾグラティス
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: Member of the Spade Kingdom's Dark Triad, and the host for the devil Megicula. She's a psychopath and she enjoys fightings against tough enemies. Her native magic is Blood Magic, whilst Megicula's magic is Curse Warding Magic.

characters.name: Mars
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Height:__ 170 cm Mars is a mage of the Diamond Kingdom and one of its Eight Shining Generals. He is the Kingdom's product of human experimentation to enhance his Magic Power, with several magic stones embedded in his body.

characters.name: Henry Legolant
characters.native_name: ヘンリー・レゴラント
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: Member of Clover Kingdom's Black Bull squad of the Magic Knights.

characters.name: Rhya
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Affinity:__ Imitation __Height:__ 181 cm A rogue mage and a member of the Eye of the Midnight Sun's Third Eye.

characters.name: Sally
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Height:__ 160 cm (5'3") She is a rogue mage and a member of the White Night Eye.

characters.name: Fana
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Height:__ 162cm __Species:__ Human

characters.name: Sol Marron
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: She is a member of Clover Kingdom's Blue Rose squad of the Magic Knights. She is a 3rd Class Intermediate Magic Knight.

characters.name: Dante Zogratis
characters.native_name: ダンテ・ゾグラティス
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: Dante is a member of the Spade Kingdom's Dark Triad and the host of the devil Lucifero. Dante seems to be a calm and easy going individual. Even in the face of a surprising turn of events, he does not lose his cool. He believes that evil is the true nature of humanity and the world is too dull because of it. Therefore, he considers being called evil a compliment, and encourages other people to embrace their malice, as it is a supreme emotion only humans have. He often looks down on who he considers weaker than him. His native magic is Flesh Magic, and his Demon's, Lucifero, is Gravity Magic.

characters.name: Lemiel Silvamillion Clover
characters.native_name: ルミエル・シルヴァミリオン・クローバー
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: First Wizard King of the Clover Kingdom.

characters.name: Sekke Bronzazza
characters.native_name: セッケ・ブロンザッザ
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Height:__ 175 cm Sekke is a member of Clover Kingdom's Green Mantis squad. A magic knight who fought and lost to Asta during their entrance exam. He befriended Asta in order to use him as a stepping stone to show off his powers which he believed to be superior, as Asta appeared to be an incompetent magician. As a magic knight, he complains about how tough he has it in his squad and that he's always tasked with monotonous chores. He meets Asta's group while gambling with an elderly woman on the black market. He tries to impress the women Asta is with, but ends up getting stabbed in the foot by a paralysis inducing knife while chasing a burglar. Believing his life to be over, he tries to pass on his unfulfilled life's ambition to Asta before realizing his injury is far from fatal.

characters.name: Licita
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: Licita was the foster mother of Liebe, the devil that currently recides within Asta's grimoire. She died protecting him from Lucifero.

characters.name: Rebecca Scarlet
characters.native_name: レベッカ・スカーレット
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Height:__ 165cm

characters.name: Zagred
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: This devil is the mastermind behind the creation of Licht's five-leaf grimoire, the massacre of the Elf Tribe, and the reincarnation of the elves.

characters.name: Mariella
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm (5'2") A former assassin of the Diamond Kingdom tasked with bringing the deserters Fanzell Kruger and Dominante Code back to the kingdom, but after encountering Asta, she chooses a different life path.

characters.name: Fanzell Kruger
characters.native_name: ファンゼル・クルーガー
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Height:__ 178 cm He is a former Commander of the Diamond Kingdom's army. After fleeing the kingdom, he now lives together with his wife Dominante Code and his students Mariella and Fana.

characters.name: Langris Vaude
characters.native_name: ランギルス・ヴォード
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: He is a nobleman of House Vaude and the vice-captain of Clover Kingdom's Golden Dawn squad of the Magic Knights. He is from Tota, a village within the Clover Kingdom.

characters.name: Lolopechka
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: Queen of the Heart Kingdom and user of the Water Spirit Undine.

characters.name: Sylph
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: Sylph is the spirit of wind and serves Yuno.

characters.name: Kahono
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Height:__ 157 cm Kahono is a priestess of the Seabed Temple.

characters.name: Marx Francois
characters.native_name: マルクス・フランソワ
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Height:__ 167 cm __Species:__ Human __Affinity:__ Memory He is one of the advisers of the Magic Emperor.

characters.name: Majo Ou
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: The Witch Queen is the ruler of the Witches' Forest and the mother of all witches.

characters.name: Gadjah
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: Spirit Guardian of Heart Kingdom. Uses Lightning magic.

characters.name: Acier Silva
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: A noblewoman of the Clover Kingdom's ruling family, House Silva, and the mother of Nozel, Nebra, Solid, and Noelle. Supposedly died giving birth to Noelle.

characters.name: Kirsch Vermillion
characters.native_name: キルシュ・ヴァーミリオン
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: **Height:** 182 cm Kirsch is a nobleman of Clover Kingdom's House Vermillion, vice-captain of the Coral Peacock squad of the Magic Knights, and a 1st Class Senior Magic Knight.

characters.name: Patry
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: Leader of the Eye of the Midnight Sun, under the name and appearance of Licht.

characters.name: Undine
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: Water Spirit that has served the Heart Kingdom for generations. Currently serving Lolopechka.

characters.name: Vetto
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Species:__ __Affinity:__ Beast __Height:__ 196 cm

characters.name: Dominante Code
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: **Height:** 167 cm A witch and former magic tool craftsman from Diamond Kingdom. She is the wife of Fanzell Kruger.

characters.name: Kiato
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Species:__ Human __Affinity:__ Butoh __Height:__ 176 cm A priest of the Seabed Temple.

characters.name: Marie Adlai
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Height:__ 135 cm She is the younger sister of Gauche Adlai and lives in Nairn under the care of Theresa Rapual.

characters.name: Neige
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: A rogue mage. “I'm going to make the person who did this to my brother pay... But before that, I need to pay for doing as he said... and not thinking for myself!” — To Asta in The Man Who Cuts Death

characters.name: Orsi Ofai
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Affinity:__ Fire __Height:__ 180 cm The priest in Hage and the foster father of Asta and Yuno.

characters.name: Zara Ideale
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: He was the father of Zora Ideale and a member of Clover Kingdom's Violet Orca squad of the Magic Knights.

characters.name: Theresa Rapual
characters.native_name: テレジア・ラプアール
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Height:__ 162cm A nun and a former member of the Crimson Lion squad of the Magic Knights. “Always... on every battlefield... it was the weak, the innocent children, who were the victims of war.” — To Asta in The Man Who Cuts Death

characters.name: Ladros
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: **Height:** 180 cm He is a mage from the Diamond Kingdom and one of its Eight Shining Generals.

characters.name: Letoile  Becquerel
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: Member of the Golden Dawn.

characters.name: Finesse Calmreich
characters.native_name: フィーネス・カルムルイヒ
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: Finesse is a noblewoman betrothed to the next head of House Vaude.

characters.name: Fragil Tormenta
characters.native_name: フラギル・トルメンタ
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: Fragil is a member of Clover Kingdom's Azure Deer squad of the Magic Knights. She is a 3rd Class Intermediate Magic Knight.

characters.name: Lucifero
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: Lucifero is a high-ranking devil who serves Dante Zogratis, a member of the Spade Kingdom's Dark Triad.

characters.name: Rades Spirito
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: __Height:__ 174 cm Rades is a rogue mage who is a member of the White Night Eye. He was a member of Clover Kingdom's Violet Orca squad of the Magic Knights.

characters.name: Tetia
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: Tetia was a human royal from the Clover Kingdom. She was also the wife of Licht, the leader of the Elf Tribe, and the younger sister of Lemiel Silvamillion Clover, the first Magic Emperor. Tetia was a cheerful person. She wished for a world where elves and humans could live together. This goal, along with how Rhya hints the similarities she shares with Mimosa, implies that Tetia was also extremely kind and would not discriminate against others despite being royalty.

characters.name: Damnatio  Kira
characters.native_name: ダムナティオ・キーラ
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: Chairman of the Magic Parliament.

characters.name: Salamander
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: Salamander is the spirit of fire who previously serves Fana and later Fuegoleon Vermillion.

characters.name: Catherine
characters.energy_system: Mana, Elemental Grimoires & Asta's Anti-Magic Swords
characters.description: She is a rogue mage and a member of the White Night Eye.

characters.name: Erza Scarlet
characters.native_name: エルザ・スカーレツト
characters.energy_system: Magic (Dragon Slayer, Celestial Spirit, Take Over & Caster Magic)
characters.description: An S-class mage from the Fairy Tail Guild who uses requip magic, which allows her to summon weapons and equip armor stored in another dimension. She is the strongest active female member. Erza is a very strict, intimidating, and impatient person with a strong sense of justice. She has been a member of Fairy Tail since she was a kid, and shows great loyalty and dedication to Makarov and the guild.

characters.name: Lucy Heartfilia
characters.native_name: ルーシィ・ハートフィリア
characters.energy_system: Magic (Dragon Slayer, Celestial Spirit, Take Over & Caster Magic)
characters.description: A mage from the Fairy Tail guild who wields Celestial Spirit magic. Lucy is cheerful, clever, and often gets swept along by her disruptive guildmates when they go overboard. Empathetic, caring, and more likely to write novels than wage battles, Lucy becomes most emboldened to challenge enemies when she needs to fight for her friends. She is said to be a noisy and somewhat fussy person, and there are times when she can be naive and too easily forgiving, greedy for validation as well as overly confident at inopportune moments. However, despite any failings and instances of self-doubt, she doesn't allow herself to feel down for too long - her optimism is boundless. In July of Earth Land year X784, Lucy is a normal 17-year-old Fioran who wishes to join the infamous mage guild, Fairy Tail - although they have a reputation for being thoroughly destructive, she admires their strength and numbers. After a fateful meeting with two members of the guild in the town of Hargeon, Natsu Dragneel and his flying blue cat, Happy, she travels with them back to Fairy Tail, located in Magnolia, to begin the adventure of a lifetime.

characters.name: Gray Fullbuster
characters.native_name: グレイ・フルバスター
characters.energy_system: Magic (Dragon Slayer, Celestial Spirit, Take Over & Caster Magic)
characters.description: __Occupation:__ Mage __Affiliation:__ Fairy Tail Guild __Team:__ Team Natsu __Magic:__ Ice-Make, Ice Magic, Gray Fullbuster is a member of the Fairy Tail guild. He is an 18 year-old ice mage, practicing ice alchemy, the art of molding ice. Due to his training history, he is most comfortable in little clothing and often forgets to wear clothes or quickly takes it off, thus often being accused of being an exhibitionist. He and Natsu have a friendly rivalry, and can often be seen fighting one another. Lucy believes the nature of his magic is the reason that he and Natsu constantly bicker. His member stamp is on the right side of his chest. In certain panels, Gray's necklaces looks quite similar to the Rave Stone which is a crucial part of another one of Mashima's stories, "Rave Master." Mashima has stated he doesn't remember the name. He takes off his clothes because Ul made him do it as one of her teachings and now it's a force of habit.

characters.name: Happy
characters.energy_system: Magic (Dragon Slayer, Celestial Spirit, Take Over & Caster Magic)
characters.description: Happy is a cat with some magical power, which may be the reason for his ability to speak. He can temporarily grow wings on his back and fly, and is capable of carrying only one person in this form. Happy apparently can fly at incredible speed (As it took Eligor less than a hour to reach Clover when Happy caught up with him in mere seconds with Natsu in tow) This is also the only kind of transportation that does not make Natsu sick. When asked why, Natsu got angry and exclaimed that Happy was a friend, not a means of transportation, ironically Natsu later gets sick when Gray gives him a piggyback ride when he's injured. He's very close to Natsu and becomes friends with Lucy quickly. The three form a team at the start of the manga. Happy is a full-fledged member of Fairy Tail, and has a member stamp on his back. It's also unknown if Happy even though being a mage and a member of Fairy Tail, can use his magic offensively or not. Happy has a very cheerful nature. Even when facing danger, he maintains a smile. Along with Lucy, he is one of the saner members of Fairy Tail and often acts as the mediator between Natsu and Gray. Happy's original name was going to be named Freyr, after a Norse god. But Hiro Mashima felt it didn't fit him, so he change the name to Happy to fit the character.

characters.name: Wendy Marvell
characters.energy_system: Magic (Dragon Slayer, Celestial Spirit, Take Over & Caster Magic)
characters.description: Wendy is the sky dragon slayer. She has the ability to heal and manipulate air.

characters.name: Charlés
characters.energy_system: Magic (Dragon Slayer, Celestial Spirit, Take Over & Caster Magic)
characters.description: Charlés is an Exceed with the same type of magic as Happy. Wendy found her as an egg and they have been together ever since. They are very close, and Charlés sees it as her duty to protect Wendy from danger. Charlés is strict and uptight. She disapproves of fooling around.

characters.name: Juvia Lockser
characters.energy_system: Magic (Dragon Slayer, Celestial Spirit, Take Over & Caster Magic)
characters.description: Juvia made up 1/4th of the Phantom Lord's elite group, Element 4. She was sent by the guild master Jose, along with Sol, to go and capture Lucy and bring her back to him safely. Her magic seems to deal with water as she is able to control rain and other large bodies of water. In addition, her body seems to be formed from the rain that surrounds her, leaving her intact and able to reform herself after attacks. Her nickname is also Juvia of the Sea, which correlates with her water controlling magic. When angry she can also control hot water. Juvia also often refers to herself in the 3rd person. Juvia has developed a crush on Gray, and due to a misunderstanding, views Lucy as her rival in love. After being defeated by Gray, the rain above her finally clears up which she thought was beautiful. After the fight, her deep infatuation with Gray continues, secretly following him wherever he goes. In the Tower of Heaven arc, she mentions to Gray that she is now an independent mage once more, but Gray notes that she has probably has her eyes set on Fairy Tail. She is quite willing to do anything for him. She is the only member of the Element 4 to be shown after the Phantom Guild arc.

characters.name: Gajeel Redfox
characters.native_name: ガジル レッドフォックス
characters.energy_system: Magic (Dragon Slayer, Celestial Spirit, Take Over & Caster Magic)
characters.description: Gajeel is an Iron Dragon Slayer. He's short-tempered, tenacious, and fiercely loyal and dedicated to his guild. Despite saying that he doesn't want to make friends, he tries in his own way to do so. Behind Gajeel's tough exterior is an emotional guy with a sense of humor and a love for music.

characters.name: Mirajane Strauss
characters.native_name: ミラジェーン・ストラウス
characters.energy_system: Magic (Dragon Slayer, Celestial Spirit, Take Over & Caster Magic)
characters.description: __Title:__ The Demon __Occupation:__ Mage __Known relatives:__ Elfman Strauss; Lisanna Strauss. She is a former S-class mage and the older sister of Elfman. When Mirajane was an S-class mage, she was known as "The Demon." However, due to a past incident involving the death of her younger sister, Lisanna, Mirajane somehow lost much of her magical ability and her will to fight. Given the recent event of Elfman regaining his lost abilities and Mirajane's increased confidence, Mirajane may someday regain her abilities and move forward with her life. Mirajane plays a motherly role within the guild, and is often seen running the bar at the guild hall. She has rarely been shown to be in a bad mood, and can tolerate all of the guild's eccentricities. However, there have been a couple events that have disturbed Mirajane, including her discovery of the stealing of an S-Class job by Natsu, Happy and Lucy, and her later disappointment with Laxus following the destruction of the guild building.

characters.name: Jellal Fernandes
characters.native_name: ジェラール・フェルナンデス
characters.energy_system: Magic (Dragon Slayer, Celestial Spirit, Take Over & Caster Magic)
characters.description: Jellal is a young man whose most prominent features are his blue hair and a red tattoo above and under his right eye, which he has had since his childhood. He is introduced under the alias of Siegrain, a young member of the Magic Council and can be considered the main antagonist of the series.

characters.name: Zeref
characters.energy_system: Magic (Dragon Slayer, Celestial Spirit, Take Over & Caster Magic)
characters.description: The legendary dark mage Zeref is a human wizard known to history as the strongest and most evil mage to ever walk the earth. He lived over 400 years ago, but even to the present day his legacy continues in the form of other dark wizards and dark guilds who worship Zerefs power. In fact most dark guilds were founded and operate under the pretense of reviving Zeref, and helping him to conquer the world. Not only was he an incredibly strong mage, but he was also regarded as a genius, and he used his immense intellect to try to research and discover new magic, regardless of his status as the most powerful human alive. He is also responsible for the creation of tens of thousands of demons by means of his living magic, and these demons continue to roam the earth, leaving trails of destruction behind them. Aside from living magic, Zeref was also a skilled user of death magic.

characters.name: Laxus Dreyar
characters.energy_system: Magic (Dragon Slayer, Celestial Spirit, Take Over & Caster Magic)
characters.description: __Affiliation:__ Fairy Tail Guild __Occupation:__ S-Class Mage __Team:__ Thunder God Tribe, Team Fairy Tail, Team Fairy Tail B __Magic type:__ Lighting Laxus Dreyar is the 23 year old S-Class mage of Fairy Tail guild. He is the grandson of Fairy Tail's master, Makarov Dreyar, and son of Ivan Dreyar. Laxus is a master of Lightning magic. It allows him to produce, control and manipulate lightning and electricity at his will. Through its use, Laxus can not only generate lightning from his body, but also make it appear from almost anywhere to strike his opponents, taking them by surprise. By generating electricity on different parts of his body, he’s capable of making his attacks in melee deadlier, and of propelling himself around to gain extra momentum. The bright light from his lightning can be also used to momentarily blind enemies. In addition, much like other Elemental types of Magic, Lightning Magic allows Laxus to turn his own body into lightning, in order to evade enemy attacks, move around at high speed and strike every opponent crossing his path. His eye color is different in the manga and the anime. In the manga, it is orange/dark yellow, while the anime portrays it as greenish blue.

characters.name: Mavis Vermillion
characters.native_name: メイビス・ヴァーミリオン
characters.energy_system: Magic (Dragon Slayer, Celestial Spirit, Take Over & Caster Magic)
characters.description: Mavis has very long, wavy, pastel yellow-blonde hair that reaches down to her feet with a small ahoge; large green eyes with no pupils; peachy skin and a slight child-like build. As a consequence of using an incomplete version of a grand Magic when she was thirteen to save Yuri Dreyar, her body was no longer able to grow or mature from that point onwards. By the time Precht encased her body in a Lacrima, though, Mavis was biologically twenty-four. Regarding her usual clothing, Mavis wears a frilly, pink layered robe with a red ribbon tied in a bow around her neck. Around the chest are three blue diamond patterns with two blue triangles above. Each series of these is outlined in a hot pink. She wears wing-like adornments around her ears and small hoop earrings. She also seems to prefer going barefoot. Mavis is The First Master and the founder of the Fairy Tail Guild. Mavis is kind and protective of Fairy Tail. She cares, guides and protects the guild whenever it's possible. She seems to be quite cheerful as she's smiling and happy most of the time. Mavis can also be quite carefree and reckless. As a child, Mavis worked for the "Red Lizard" Guild, where she would either clean the guild's floor, the members' clothes or even make food. She was forced to pay back her parents' debts to the guild and contribute to the guild that sustained her. Although, she was mistreated, she vowed never to cry, as her parents once told her that fairies never approached those who were cry-babies.

characters.name: Levy McGarden
characters.energy_system: Magic (Dragon Slayer, Celestial Spirit, Take Over & Caster Magic)
characters.description: __Height:__ 155cm __Magic:__ Solid Script Mage Levy is a member of the Fairy Tail Guild's team Shadow Gear, along with Jet and Droy. She has a cheerful personality, being able to get along with many other guild members. Levy loves to read books, she and Lucy Heartfilia quickly became friends through their mutual love for books. Levy read the novel that Lucy is working on and is the only person who has done so by consent. Levy's magic is called Solid Script. Which allows her to make words solid and then throw the words at her opponent. For instance, if the word fire were to be thrown at her opponent the victim would feel as if he were hit by a fireball.

characters.name: Sting Eucliffe
characters.native_name: スティング・ユークリフ
characters.energy_system: Magic (Dragon Slayer, Celestial Spirit, Take Over & Caster Magic)
characters.description: Sting is a White Dragon Slayer and a Mage of the currently strongest Guild in Fiore, the Sabertooth. He was raised by the Dragon Weisslogia, who taught him White Dragon Slayer Magic. He eventually used this Magic to kill Weisslogia, in order to become a "real" Dragon Slayer. At some point in his life, Sting also implanted Dragon Lacrima into his body, thereby making him a third-generation Dragon Slayer.

characters.name: Gildarts Clive
characters.native_name: ギルダーツ・クライヴ
characters.energy_system: Magic (Dragon Slayer, Celestial Spirit, Take Over & Caster Magic)
characters.description: Gildarts Clive is one of the Fairy Tail Guild's S-Class mages. Gildarts is widely accepted by all the members as the strongest member in the guild under Makarov. Whether or not he is as powerful as Makarov is widely debated. He is frequently absent in the guild due to the nature of the requests he receives. He is widely referred by members of the Fairy Tail Guilds as "that geezer". Gildarts went out of the guild 3 years ago to carry out his job, and recently has returned to the guild. He is rumoured to have taken both a 10-year-job as well as a 100-year-job, which is classified above the SS rank jobs as the difficulty is ranked on how long it would take for completion.

characters.name: Cana Alberona
characters.energy_system: Magic (Dragon Slayer, Celestial Spirit, Take Over & Caster Magic)
characters.description: A member of the Fairy Tail guild who uses a type of card magic. Cana is a short-tempered woman with a pure heart. She's a heavy drinker and seems to always be drinking, although she rarely gets drunk. She's one of the original members of Fairy Tail, having been a part of it since she was a kid.

characters.name: Ultear Milkovich
characters.energy_system: Magic (Dragon Slayer, Celestial Spirit, Take Over & Caster Magic)
characters.description: Ultear is introduced as a member of the Magic Council who apparently works for Siegrain.

characters.name: Loke
characters.energy_system: Magic (Dragon Slayer, Celestial Spirit, Take Over & Caster Magic)
characters.description: Loke (ロキ Roki) is a member of the Fairy Tail guild. He is very flirtatious with attractive women, being top ranked "Mage you want to have as your boyfriend". He attempts to flirt with Lucy but after finding out that she's a Stellar Spirit mage, he quickly stops his advances. Mirajane said that something must have happened to him with a similar female Stellar Spirit mage. She also mentioned that Loke once tried to flirt with Erza, but nearly got himself killed because of it. His weapon is a magical ring and is skilled in "hand-to-hand" combat. He seems to have an interest in Lucy, despite his fear and is the one who searched for Lucy's lost keys and subsequently saves Lucy from bandits. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Rogue Cheney
characters.energy_system: Magic (Dragon Slayer, Celestial Spirit, Take Over & Caster Magic)
characters.description: Rogue Cheney is the Shadow Dragon Slayer. He is also in the fromer strongest Guild in Fiore, the Sabertooth Guild. He has an exceed named Frosch, just like most of the Dragon Slayers. He is very close with Sting Eucliffe.

characters.name: Mystogan
characters.energy_system: Magic (Dragon Slayer, Celestial Spirit, Take Over & Caster Magic)
characters.description: He is another one of the S-classed mages who puts everyone to sleep every time he comes to the guild mainly because he hates to be seen. Makarov is the only person who is left unaffected by his magic but it still makes him tired. Laxus states that he has seen his face as well. He has a bandit type mask covering the bottom half of his face and a cap covering the top with only a slit being shown between his eyes.

characters.name: Virgo
characters.energy_system: Magic (Dragon Slayer, Celestial Spirit, Take Over & Caster Magic)
characters.description: Maid Spirit Virgo. She initially had a contract with Everlue, but after he was arrested the contract broke. She handed her key to Happy and told him to give it to Lucy. She is then called by Lucy to help them out of a situation. She explains that since she's a spirit, she takes the form that her master desires, so when she was bound to Everlue, she had a big woman form, according to her masters likes. When shes bound to Lucy, she takes a more visually appealing form

characters.name: Frosch
characters.energy_system: Magic (Dragon Slayer, Celestial Spirit, Take Over & Caster Magic)
characters.description: Rogue Cheney's exceed. Frosch easily agrees with Lector's opinion. His catchphrase is, "I think so too!"

characters.name: Makarov Dreyar
characters.energy_system: Magic (Dragon Slayer, Celestial Spirit, Take Over & Caster Magic)
characters.description: Makarov is the "Master" of the Fairy Tail guild and is also one of the Ten Great Holy Mages. Makarov shows extreme dislike for the Council and all the rules they try to impose on guilds. He frequently attempts to balance reprimands from the council and the eccentricity of his guild. He encourages Fairy Tail to do what they feel is right, but he has shown some concern that Natsu, Erza, and Gray will someday level a whole town. His magical abilities include Titan magic, giving him the ability to grow his body parts gigantic and his body into a giant-sized version of himself, and can control various other forms of magic including fire, ice and wind, which give him an immense magical power. The members of his guild affectionately refer to him as Ji-san or grandpa. Makarov also sees all of his guild members as his own children and will do anything to protect them. He has a perverted side, shown when he states he wishes to be smashed by Lucy's breasts and subsequently spanks her many times as a punishment. Given his advanced age, he considers retirement, but considers Laxus as too uncaring, Gildartz impossible for some unknown reason, Mystogan as too reclusive, and Erza as too young and brash to succeed him as guild master. After hearing the damages made by the team Erza-Lucy-Gray-Natsu-Happy from Mirajane, he cried that it's impossible to retire by now.

characters.name: Aquarius
characters.energy_system: Magic (Dragon Slayer, Celestial Spirit, Take Over & Caster Magic)
characters.description: "The Water Bearer" is a Celestial Spirit that is one of the 12 Golden Zodiac Keys. Aquarius is a moody and ill-tempered Celestial Spirit who often threatens to kill her owner, Lucy. When summoned, Aquarius will either attack the opponent, Lucy, or both of them, depending on her mood. Despite this, Aquarius does care for Lucy's well-being, which will later be elaborated on. Aquarius' previous master had been Lucy's mother, Layla Heartfilia. When Layla retired from her work as a Mage because of her health problems, she entrusted Aquarius' Key to another Mage with instructions to present it to Lucy if she chose to be a Celestial Spirit Mage. Aquarius' key was the first key that Lucy ever received. Because there weren't any other children to play with, Lucy would summon Aquarius as a playmate. This greatly infuriated Aquarius, however, learning why Lucy summoned her, the Celestial Spirit couldn't help but feel bad for the girl.

characters.name: Kagura Mikazuchi
characters.energy_system: Magic (Dragon Slayer, Celestial Spirit, Take Over & Caster Magic)
characters.description: Kagura Mikazuchi is a Mage from the Mermaid Heel Guild and a member of its team competing in the Grand Magic Games. Kagura is a slim, large-busted woman, with long, straight dark hair that falls to the middle of her back. It is cut in the traditional Japanese "princess style." Kagura dons an elaborate blazer with a large collar, which is open to reveal a collared shirt and tie underneath. The cuffs of this jacket are tucked into a pair of gloves. On her legs, Kagura wears a pair of black tights, which are tucked into a pair of thigh-high boots and sit under a short frilled skirt. On her head, Kagura ties a ribbon, with the ends of the bow pointing straight up, giving them the appearance of animal ears.

characters.name: Plue
characters.energy_system: Magic (Dragon Slayer, Celestial Spirit, Take Over & Caster Magic)
characters.description: The strange creature that Haru discovered, Plue is the Rave Bearer, and is able to sense the presence of the other Rave Stones. Plue's nose also has the ability to destroy dark brings. Plue is quite fond of sweets - especially lollipops. Plue hates pudding. He has the ability to utilize the rave of conflict which powers him and Haru up. Plue has since shown up in Fairy Tail as one of Lucy's stellar spirits (Nicola, Canis Minor) and quickly named Plue and has been noted to only agree to be summoned on Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Igneel
characters.energy_system: Magic (Dragon Slayer, Celestial Spirit, Take Over & Caster Magic)
characters.description: Fire Dragon and foster father of Natsu Dragneel Igneel has been shown to be a loving parental figure towards Natsu, though leaving him to fend for himself leads one to doubt this. Despite leaving him, Igneel is shown to be incredibly protective of Natsu as he watches him from afar. Contrary to his loving self, Igneel can also be very fierce when he wants to be. He has also shown some arrogance, referring to himself as "the one and only Igneel" during Grandeeney's visit. According to Grandeeney, like Natsu, Igneel has a tendency to take things to excess. He taught Natsu how to write, speak, and how to use the fire-brand style of Magic known as "Dragon Slayer Magic ", an ancient form of Magic that gives the user the traits of a dragon.For some still unknown reason, Igneel disappeared one day without saying a word to Natsu on the 7th July of X777 (along with the other dragons like Grandeeney and Metalicana, Wendy Marvell's and Gajeel Redfox's foster dragon parents, respectively), leaving Natsu to fend for himself. Natsu's dream is to be able to meet with Igneel again and he searches for clues of his whereabouts.

characters.name: Lisanna Strauss
characters.native_name: リサーナ・ストラウス
characters.energy_system: Magic (Dragon Slayer, Celestial Spirit, Take Over & Caster Magic)
characters.description: Lisanna is the younger sister of both Elfman and Mirajane, and is also a member of Fairy Tail, like her siblings her magic is take over. Her member stamp was on her upper left shoulder and now is on Left Thigh.

characters.name: Freed Justine
characters.native_name: フリード・ジャスティーン
characters.energy_system: Magic (Dragon Slayer, Celestial Spirit, Take Over & Caster Magic)
characters.description: A 20-year-old member of the Fairy Tail Guild who doesn't show his face often, but is skilled enough to be a S-Class Mage (stated by Erza). Laxus Dreyar calls him Freed the Dark. He hadn't been to the guild for half a year, and hadn't met any of the newer members like Lucy Heartfilia. During Fairy Tail's battle with Phantom Lord Guild, he was off in another town. He is part of the Raijinshuu, a group of mages who act as servants to Laxus, with Freed as the self-proclaimed captain. He is known as one of the "Mystery Men" along with Mystogan and Gildarts. His magic style is Enchantments. Fried seems to be the most quiet of the Raijinshuu. He also seems to care for his former friends as he questioned Laxus when Laxus told him to kill other Fairy Tail members if he must. He seems to respect Laxus as he does whatever Laxus says even killing other guild members if he is ordered. When Mirajane shouts at him saying weren't they friends, Freed closes his eyes and replied "we were once". After Laxus left Fairy Tail, he shaved his head, though it grew back to normal as seen in chapter 165. Freed's magic allows him to write runes that, depending on what is written, will actually effect its target, though Freed's magic seems to do more with inflicting pain and suffering on his opponents. It was first used during the Battle of Fairy Tail, where Freed's enchantments were used as traps do have the guild members fight each other to escape. Contrary to Makarov's theory that his magic needed some time to complete, Freed was shown to be able to easily write characters with his sword to produce its effects. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Yukino Aguria
characters.energy_system: Magic (Dragon Slayer, Celestial Spirit, Take Over & Caster Magic)
characters.description: Yukino is a Celestial Spirit Mage and a member of the currently strongest guild in Fiore, Sabertooth. She is part of Sabertooth's team in the Grand Magic Games and battled against Kagura from Mermaid Heel. Yukino possesses three Celestial Keys, two gold keys - Pisces and Libra, and the thirteenth zodiac key of Ophiuchus. She is able to summon more than one Celestial Spirit at the same time. She is also the younger sister to Angel/Sorano.

characters.name: Cobra
characters.energy_system: Magic (Dragon Slayer, Celestial Spirit, Take Over & Caster Magic)
characters.description: Cobra is a member of the Oración Seis, a dark guild composed of highly powerful mages. He, along with the other Oración Seis, seek to find Nirvana, a destructive magic power that was sealed long ago. Cobra is accompanied by a huge snake, Cuberios, whom he considers to be his only friend.

characters.name: Meredy
characters.energy_system: Magic (Dragon Slayer, Celestial Spirit, Take Over & Caster Magic)
