characters.description: Straits is another of Tonpetty's followers. He aided Jonathan in the fight against Dio and his minions. He, along with Dire, were named after the band Dire Straits. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Santana
characters.description: He is discovered in a Mexican pyramid in 1938. He is then awakened and studied by a Nazi vampire study team in an underground base. The team, led by Major Stroheim, conducts live human experiments with the stone mask to try to strengthen the Nazi Army. The team awakens Santana in an advanced isolation room fortified with steel plates, and conduct behavioral experiments on him. They soon find that Santana feeds on vampires and is able to absorb food from the surface of his body. The team then is shocked by Santana's escape from the isolation room. Santana breaks many of his own bones in order to squeeze himself into the 4-by-20 cm ventilation outlet of the room, and does all this at a speed faster than human eyes can perceive. The team shoots Santana with machine guns, only to find that Santana has learned their language and the mechanisms of their weapons from only minutes of contact. He then easily disposes of the Nazis who disturbed his sleep, and even manages to stay alive after being attacked, exposed to sunlight, and blown up. He is named after the long-lived rock group Santana. He is the only member of the Pillar Men to survive, and is theoretically still alive throughout all of the arcs. However, due to his vastly-improved Ripple power, it is possible that Joseph killed him after returning to America. (Source: Wikipedia)

characters.name: Bruford
characters.description: Bruford is an antagonist featured in Part I: Phantom Blood. He is a vampire made from the centuries-old corpse of a brave and powerful warrior of ancient Britain. Along with Tarkus, Bruford was one of "The Dark Knights". He also had unusual battle prowess and powers associated with his dark hair.

characters.name: George Joestar I
characters.native_name: ジョージ・ジョースターI世
characters.description: George is Jonathan Joestar's father and, after a tragic misunderstanding, adopts Dio Brando in his family, kick-starting the events of the first six parts of the series.

characters.name: Dire
characters.description: Dire is a minor ally featured in Phantom Blood. Dire is a Ripple disciple under the Ripple Master Tonpetty and is a very close friend of Will Anthonio Zeppeli.

characters.name: Tompetty
characters.description: Tonpetty is a minor ally featured in Part I: Phantom Blood. He is a Ripple master who trained Will Anthonio Zeppeli as well as Straizo and Dire.

characters.name: Mark
characters.description: Mark is a German soldier and a friend of Caesar Zeppeli who participated in the effort for stopping the Pillar Men's awakening.

characters.name: Poco
characters.description: Poco was a cowardly boy who got bullied by other kids, but was protected by his sister. When confronted by her about when he was going to fight back and live on his own, Poco answered that he would do this "tomorrow", which causes her to slap him. (Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

characters.name: Mario Zeppeli
characters.native_name: マリオ ・ ツェペリ
characters.description: Mario Zeppeli is characterized as hard-working, trustworthy, and a wholesome family man. Although he loved his family, Mario had to abandon them in order to investigate the Pillar Men. (Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

characters.name: Dario Brando
characters.description: Dario is the father of Dio Brando. An alcoholic and abusive man, he is primarily responsible for contributing to Dio's descent into evil. After a tragic misunderstanding, George Joestar I decides to give him a favor and adopts his son Dio into the Joestar Family.

characters.name: Wang Chung
characters.description: Wang Chan is a minor antagonist featured in Part I: Phantom Blood personally as a human, Wang Chan has shown a greedy personality, selling a poison to Dio Brando without any regard for its use and heading back to the Joestar mansion to salvage for treasures and antiques. Upon becoming a vampire, however, he becomes entirely devoted to Dio's wishes. Synopsis Originally only known as the "Oriental Man", he owned a curiosity shop on Ogre Street. Wang Chang sold Dio the poison which Dio used in his murder of Dario Brando and his attempted murder of George Joestar, although Wang was not concerned with what the poison was to be used for. He told Dio, without much, if any, intent to provoke him, of a man in his own land who had a similar birthmark to Dio's who had had a harsh life, but in the end lived to be over 183. Sometime after, he was was captured by Jonathan Joestar and taken to the the Joestar Manor. When he is used in an attempt to force Dio to go with the police, he again mentions his fortune telling, saying that Dio is far too lucky to fully have to give up this early. Dio uses George's blood to become a vampire, taking Wang Chan as his subordinate when the latter goes to search the Joestar manor for valuables. Dio trusts him enough to be responsible for his head and implanting it onto Jonathan's body. This did not go according to plan, however as Jonathan use the last of his strength to crush Wang Chan's head and sent a ripple to take control of his body, and made him sink the ship of zombies by grinding his body into the machinery.

characters.name: Tarkus
characters.description: Tarkus the "Dark Knight" was a knight from 16th Century Great Britain who was executed after losing a war. Resurrected as a Zombie by Dio Brando, he is wholeheartedly loyal to his new master and fights the Joestar Group. (Source: JoJo Wikia)

characters.name: Doobie
characters.description: Doobie is a minor antagonist featured in Phantom Blood. He is a musclebound masked zombie that Dio Brando sics on Poco's Sister after she refuses to serve him. Doobie grabs the girl and rips her dress in an attempt to assault her, but his plan is quickly ruined by an anvil thrown by Jonathan Joestar. (Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

characters.name: Loggins
characters.description: Loggins is a tall, muscular man with chiseled features and somewhat glazed eyes. He wears a tunic, an over-sized fez, and armbands. Loggins displays a very demanding demeanor when instructing Joseph and Caesar, often forcing them to do tough trials during their Ripple training. Despite this, he seems to have, along with Messina, a sense of humor as the two would often tease their disciples. (Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

characters.name: Messina
characters.description: Messina is a tall muscular man with short hair tied into a ponytail and a Fu Manchu mustache. He wears a long hat, a sleeveless tunic, and armbands. Though much of Messina's personality isn't focused upon, he displays the characteristics of a stern, yet effective instructor to Joseph and Caesar. Despite this, Messina seems to have a sense of humor as he, along with Loggins, would often tease his disciples during their training. (Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

characters.name: Poco no Ane
characters.description: She's the older sister of Poco and was held captive in the castle by Dio

characters.name: Tattoo
characters.description: Tattoo is a rugged looking grown man with a medium sized beard and unkempt hair. His wardrobe consists mainly of a fringed leather jacket, pants, and belt. His most noticeable feature, and the obvious source of his name, is a large tattoo stretching from cheek to cheek and from forehead to nose dorsum - the tattoo appears to be either a butterfly or a design similar to a Rorschach test image. (Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

characters.name: Donovan
characters.description: Donovan is a mature athletic man whose dark hair is slicked back. His skin is colored differently around his eyes, starting from a wide area on his hairline and converging to the side of the root of his nose. Donovan wears a sleeveless officer outfit. (Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

characters.name: Jack
characters.description: Jack is a serial killer who meets Dio Brando and is transformed into a Zombie sent to fight the Joestar Group. He was inspired by the historical figure of the same name. (Source: JoJo Wikia)

characters.name: Kisha
characters.description: She arrives at the cafe where Joseph and Straizo are fighting and begins to take photos, saying it would reach the front page of the newspaper. Straizo catches her off guard and uses her as a hostage to approach Joseph, vowing to kill her if the Joestar runs off. Though Joseph attempts to bluff his way out by calling her a "floozie" he won't risk his life to save, Straizo forces Joseph to fight him when he rips the reporter's tooth out. After being saved, the reporter punches Joseph for insulting her and then kicks him in the knee. The adrenaline from the ordeal then wears off and she screams from the delayed pain of losing her tooth. This content comes from JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia (https://jojowiki.com), and must be attributed to its authors, as specified in the license. JoJo's Bizarre Wiki (the FANDOM wiki) is prohibited from using it, for repeatedly copying without giving attribution.

characters.name: Elizabeth I
characters.description: Elizabeth I is a queen of England and a monarch from the Tudor dynasty. In 1565, she battles her first cousin once removed, Mary Stuart, over the throne. Her betrayal of Bruford and Tarkus, two retainers of Mary, led to the two knights cursing humanity; Dio Brando uses this resentment to his advantage over three hundred years later when he revives them as zombies. (Source: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Wiki)

characters.name: Shitsuji
characters.description: A butler of the Joestar Family.

characters.name: Adams
characters.description: Adams is a former human and villager from Windknight's Lot who becomes a Zombie created by Dio Brando.

characters.name: Chuugoku Kenpouka
characters.description: He originally tries to rob Jonathan Joestar in Ogre Street alongside Robert E. O. Speedwagon and Tattoo

characters.name: Wired Beck
characters.description: He is a Vampire created by Kars tasked with guarding the hotel Kars is hiding in and briefly battles Lisa Lisa.

characters.name: Joutarou Kuujou
characters.description: __Height:__ 195 cm (6'5") __Occupation:__ Student, Marine Explorer, Oceanographer __Nationality:__ Japanese Joutarou is Holly Kujo's son and Joseph Joestar's grandson. In Part 3, he has a recognizable attire of a blue trenchcoat-length school uniform jacket with yellow chains on the collar. He also wears a trademark hat which, while torn in the back, often seems to blend with his hair. When Joutarou first appears, he turned himself in to the police because he believes his Stand is an evil spirit possessing him. After he is released from jail, and learns what his Stand is, Joutarou gets used to Star Platinum -- a fierce, muscular, vaguely Aztec-looking spirit with "the precision of a machine" and the ability to destroy virtually anything with a sledgehammer barrage of fists. He has a very tough exterior, and is even rather rough and delinquent, but he also is very dedicated, intense, and loyal. He is very intelligent, but usually lets his (or Star Platinum's) fists do the talking with the enemy, even though he often has to rely on his wits to deal with stand users' attacks. He is also known for a quick and short temper. His catchphrase is "Yare yare daze." It generally relates of being bored or exasperation. In Part 3, he is the main target of Dio, who realizes that Joutarou is his greatest threat. One of the strongest stands in the JoJo universe; Star Platinum possesses super human senses, strength, stamina, accuracy and speed. It can see for great distances and at great magnifications. The Star tarot card that Star Platinum is named after symbolizes hope. Like other physically powerful stands, Star Platinum suffers from a narrow range of activity. It can only be active within a 2-3 meter radius from Joutarou. In the sixth story arc Stone Ocean, Joutarou becomes an oceanologist, moves to the United States, eventually marries, and his daughter, Jolyne inherits the potential to wield Stand powers.

characters.name: Holly Kuujou
characters.description: Holly Kuujou née Joestar is the daughter of Joseph Joestar and mother of Joutarou Kuujou.

characters.name: Danny
characters.description: Minor character appearing in Phantom Blood. He is Jonathan Joestar's dog and childhood best friend. George Joestar I bought Danny when he was a puppy when Jonathan was five years old. Danny was very afraid of unfamiliar places and strange people causing him to bite Jonathan when the young boy first approached him. For a while, Jonathan also antagonized Danny by throwing stones at him. One day, while swimming in a river, Jonathan started drowning and was saved by Danny, which made them the best of friends.

characters.name: George II Joestar
characters.native_name: ジョージ・ジョースター 2世
characters.description: George resembles his father Jonathan and his son Joseph. He is only seen wearing a military dress uniform. Assumed to be a capable fighter pilot, George was one of the first to fly an aircraft during World War I. It's hinted that he may have had a talent for the Ripple much like his father and son, though he was never given any training to properly use it. (Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

characters.name: Mary Joestar
characters.native_name: メアリー・ジョースタ
characters.description: Mary Joestar is the late mother of Jonathan Joestar and wife of George Joestar. Never shown in person in the series, the only thing known about her story is that she accompanied her husband during a trip to London and died protecting her baby when her carriage had an accident and fell into a ravine. (Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

characters.name: Styx
characters.description: An alcoholic priest who discovers Dio's coffin in the boat Jonathan and Erina board.

characters.name: Noriaki Kakyouin
characters.description: __Height:__ 178 cm (5'10") __Stand:__ Hierophant Green Kakyoin is a high school student and user of the stand Hierophant Green. Unlike most stand users, Kakyoin was born with his stand, though it caused him to feel like an outsider for most of his life due to not knowing any other stand users. Until meeting the rest of the main characters, Hierophant was Kakyoin’s only real friend. Hierophant is not physically strong, but is elastic and can able to unravel into tentacles which can capture opponents. It can also enter an enemy’s body to possess them, though Kakyoin rarely uses this ability. Hierophant’s signature power is emerald splash, which hurls emeralds that slice opponents. Kakyoin remains calm and collected even in dangerous situations, and is good at seeing through opponents’ strategies. During a trip to Egypt with his family, he encountered Dio, who controlled him using a flesh bud. It was later removed by Jotaro and Kakyoin joined the Joestar group.

characters.name: Jean-Pierre Polnareff
characters.native_name: ジャン＝ピエール・ポルナレフ
characters.description: __Height:__ 185 cm (6'1") Jean-Pierre Polnareff is a Frenchman who joins the Joestar group on their journey to Egypt after being freed from Dio's control by the group. He aims to avenge the murder of his sister. His brash nature and overconfidence combined with his general tomfoolery is often the source of trouble throughout the journey, and other members of the group often remark on his tendency to endanger himself and others. He also serves as the inspiration for many characters in other franchises such as Guile (Street Fighter), Paul (Tekken), Benimaru Nikaido (King of Fighters).

characters.name: Mohammed Avdol
characters.native_name: モハメド・アヴドゥル
characters.description: __Height:__ 188 cm (6'2") __Stand:__ Magician's Red Avdol is a fortune teller and friend of Joseph Joestar. They met three years before the events of the story. He was born with a stand, Magician’s Red, which controls fire. This stand’s abilities include Crossfire Hurricane, which shoots fire in the shape of an Ankh, and Crossfire Hurricane Special, which splits into multiple Ankh-shaped flames. He can also create flame tracker that detects a person’s energy. Avdol presents himself as a serious person but can sometimes let his emotions get the best of him. He often acts as the voice of reason among the Joestar group and exhibits strong loyalty by frequently placing himself in danger to protect his friends. He is knowledgeable about geography and stands, enjoys India’s chaotic atmosphere, and respects Polnareff's chivalrous attitude that he displayed when they first met. Avdol gives Jotaro's stand its name. He is named after Paula Abdul.

characters.name: Iggy
characters.description: __Height:__ 33.3 cm __Nationality:__ American Iggy is a boston terrier who wields a stand known as The Fool, which is able to manipulate sand. Since The Fool is made of sand, damaging it will not hurt Iggy. He creates various objects out of sand including the wings of a glider and a statue of DIO. Iggy is depicted as rude and disobedient, as shown by his tendency to chew on people’s hair while farting on them. He loves coffee-flavored gum. Iggy was previously owned by a rich man, but he ran away and became a stray in New York. Avdol caught him and brought him to Egypt to help the Joestar group defeat DIO. He frequently chews Polnareff’s hair and once put chewed gum inside Jotaro’s hat. He was initially drawn as realistic dog, but as the story progressed, his face gradually became more similar to a human’s. He is named after Iggy Pop.

characters.name: Hol Horse
characters.description: **Height**: 188cm *(anime)* Hol Horse is a minor antagonist in JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Stardust Crusaders (first seen in Chapter 141 and Episode 10), as well as one of the main characters of Crazy Diamond's Demonic Heartbreak. He is a tall, blonde-haired cowboy-themed mercenary, serving under Dio and his army of other Stand Users. He considers himself "The #2", preferring to work as support with a partner due to his cowardice and caution. He also respects women, no matter how pretty, or how ugly, as seen with his ex, Nena. His Stand is Emperor, named after the Tarot Card of the same name. It manifests itself as a retro-futuristic pistol, which functions as a normal firearm, although the bullets are able to change their trajectory to Hol Horse's command.

characters.name: Boingo
characters.description: Boingo is a young Stand User whose Stand is Tohth. As part of the Egypt 9 Glory Gods, he attempts to assassinate the Joestar Group in Egypt alongside his older brother Oingo and later Hol Horse. Boingo is a young child of ordinary build, but his characteristics include an unusually large mouth and a large afro held together by a topless cap, leaving a few stray hair locks. His attire consists of a bright shirt and trousers over which he wears shorts and a jacket, plus a coat and simple shoes. Tohth is an Artificial Non-Humanoid Stand that takes the form of a manga. The book, titled, Oingo Boingo Brothers Adventure, will show predictions of the future. When an image appears, the prediction(s) then become fate and are destined to come to fruition. However, nobody, not even Boingo, can control the Image projected onto Tohth.

characters.name: Anne
characters.description: Anne is a minor character appearing in Stardust Crusaders. Joining the Joestar Group before departing for Singapore, she somehow follows them from there to Pakistan and appears regularly alongside the main characters.

characters.name: Forever
characters.description: Forever is a malicious orangutan in DIO's service who confronts the group in the South China Sea aboard a freighter. Said ship happens to be possessed by Forever's Stand: Strength.

characters.name: Steely Dan
characters.native_name: 鋼入りのスティーリーダン
alt_names: スティーリー ダン
characters.description: Steely Dan is a Stand User using the microscopic Lovers. Steely Dan is sent to assassinate Enya the Hag and then confronts the Joestar Group in Pakistan.

characters.name: Sherry Polnareff
characters.native_name: シェリー・ポルナレフ
characters.description: Sherry Polnareff is Jean Pierre Polnareff's little sister who was raped and murdered by J. Geil, prompting Polnareff to seek revenge against her killer.

characters.name: Enya Geil
characters.description: Enya Geil is one of Dio's most loyal supporters, and the one who originally gave him the Stand Arrow, which she obtained from Diavolo. She is the mother of J. Geil. Her stand is Justice, which is able to control people through their wounds, whether alive or dead. For legal reasons, her name is changed in the American version of both the game and the manga, to N-Yah Gail and Enyaba Geil respectively. In the OVA:

characters.name: Midler
characters.description: Midler is the last of DIO's assassins the heroes encounter before entering Egypt. She is a Stand User, and her High Priestess attacks the group as they travel by submarine in the Red Sea.

characters.name: Mannish Boy
characters.description: Mannish Boy is an evil genius baby and Stand user in DIO's service. He tries to murder the Joestar Group inside the nightmare-world of his Death Thirteen.

characters.name: Rubber Soul
characters.description: Rubber Soul is a medium-height curly haired man, with his Stand granting him the ability to grow larger and to change appearance at will. He was hired by Dio with the promise of earning 100 millions as a reward for killing Jotaro. Rubber Soul does, however, have a rather disturbing personality: he is extremely rude and impolite, showing no respect nor mercy for people and animals, as they are beings that he only sees as food for his Yellow Temperance. He does not seem to be particularly intelligent, though he has a really bad temper: he wanted to ambush Jotaro with Kakyoin's appearance, but his unusual behavior blew his cover. Rubber Soul is also very violent: he attempts to kill a pickpocket by breaking his back, and remorselessly eats a dog under the eyes of its master with his Stand. In order to grow bigger, he did not hesitate to eat bugs either. From: http://jjba.wikia.com/wiki/Rubber_Soul

characters.name: Roses
characters.description: Roses is the butler of Joseph Joestar and Suzi Q, also acting as the latter's personal chauffeur and bodyguard.

characters.name: Nena
characters.description: Nena is a minor antagonist appearing in Stardust Crusaders. She first appears in India alongside Hol Horse and tries to assassinate Joseph Joestar while passing as an ordinary woman. She is a Stand User who uses Empress. Nena first looks like a beautiful young Indian woman in typical Indian attire. However, this is only a disguise and Nena is truly a short, ugly and overweight woman wearing a bikini. Nena also possesses a bud on her tongue. Nena used her Stand Empress to kill a beautiful young woman and wore her skin to hide her true form. (Source: Jojo Wiki)

characters.name: Nise Captain Tennille
characters.native_name: 偽キャプテン・テニール
characters.description: The impostor Captain Tennille is a minor antagonist appearing in Stardust Crusaders. He is an assassin sent by DIO who fights the Joestar Group in the middle of the ocean on their way to Egypt. He is a Stand User and wields Dark Blue Moon.

characters.name: Gray Fly
characters.description: Gray Fly is an assassin sent by DIO who attacks the group aboard a plane traveling from Tokyo to Cairo, eventually crashing it into the ocean near Hong Kong. He is a Stand User and wields Tower of Gray.

characters.name: ZZ
characters.description: ZZ is another of DIO's assassins who confronts the Joestar Group. He is a Stand User who drives his Wheel of Fortune.

characters.name: J. Geil
characters.description: J. Geil is the man responsible for the murder of Polnareff's sister, earning him Polnareff's desire for revenge. J. Geil expend most of his time hiding from plain view, preferring to have a partner in which to rely on. This made him a perfect candidate for Hol Horse who like him believe working in pairs. He would hide in the shadows while Hol Horse broke the glass needed for his stand to work and sometimes they would do combination attack, such as Hal Horse breaking glass and J. Geil attacking while Hol Horse shot a bullet from his Stand, the Emperor, locking the enemy in a mortal circle. Like his mother he had a deformity that give him two right hands. (Source: JJBA Wikia)

characters.name: Devo
characters.description: Devo the Cursed is an infamous Native American shaman and assassin in DIO's service. Devo ambushes Jean Pierre Polnareff in his hotel room in Singapore. He is a Stand User and uses Ebony Devil.

characters.name: Arabia Fats
characters.description: Arabia Fats is another of DIO's goons, who ambushes the Joestar Group in the middle of the Arabian desert with his Stand: Sun.

characters.name: Cameo
characters.description: Cameo (カメオ Kameo) is a minor antagonist featured in Stardust Crusaders. He isolates Polnareff from the Joestar Group on a secluded island in the Red Sea while they are there to retrieve Avdol. Cameo is one of DIO's henchmen, and the Stand User behind the genie Stand, Judgement.

characters.name: Genos
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: __Height:__ 178 cm (5'10") __Debut:__ Chapter 6 / Episode 1 __Race:__ Cyborg __Location:__ Z-City __Abilities:__ Enhancements Physical feats, Full Cyborg Weaponry, Highly Skilled and Strategist Combatant __Weapons:__ Cyborg Body __Occupation:__ Superhero __Level:__ S-Class; Rank 16 (beginning), Rank 14 (current) __Affiliation:__ The Heroes Association A cyborg and a self-proclaimed disciple of Saitama. He is always aiming to become stronger and fights for justice. Genos is an extremely serious character. He has a strong motivation to become stronger and is always looking at Saitama as an example of the ultimate hero. Constantly trying to be like him even if it results in reckless fights.

characters.name: Tatsumaki
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: __Race:__ Human __Abilities:__ Psychokinesis __Occupation:__ Superhero __Level:__ S-Class; Rank: 2 __Affiliation:__ Heroes Association __Family:__ Fubuki (sister) Tatsumaki is a petite woman, commonly mistaken for being much younger than she really is. She has an adolescent face with emerald green eyes and green hair that naturally curls up on the ends. She wears a long dress that separates into 4 sections slightly above the hips and low-heeled black shoes. __Personality:__ She has a rather brash, moody, hotheaded, and impatient personality. She is disrespectful towards most people, especially to those she deems incompetent. Despite her arrogant personality, she feels obligated to defeat monsters and considers her job as a hero to be a duty, accepting any of the Hero Association's requests to defeat monsters, due to the fact that she tends to get bored when she is not fighting monsters. She also seeks them to fight in her own time. She has a bit of a soft side towards her little sister Fubuki, but she is also very overprotective. __Abilities:__ As the most powerful esper in One-Punch Man and one of the most powerful heroes, Tatsumaki possesses extreme skill in wielding her psychic abilities, whether it be for offense, defense, or miscellaneous uses. Tatsumaki's knowledge about psychic powers is also as vast as her skill in wielding them, which is enough to lift an entire city. She's also called as the Association's ultimate weapon.

characters.name: Fubuki
alt_names: Jigoku no Fubuki (地獄のフブキ)
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: __Race:__ Human __Occupation:__ Superhero __Height:__ 167 cm (5'5¾") __Level:__ B-Class Rank 1 __Affiliation:__ Hero Association __Family:__ Tatsumaki (sister) __Abilities:__ Psychokinesis Fubuki, also known by her hero alias Blizzard of Hell, is the B-Class Rank 1 professional hero of the Hero Association. She is an esper, the younger sister of Tatsumaki, and the leader of the Blizzard Group, a B-Class hero faction. She and her sister are known as the Psychic Sisters. Fubuki is currently trying to recruit Saitama into her group. She's also a self-declared member of the Saitama Group.

characters.name: Onsoku no Sonic
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: __Height:__ 174 cm __Race:__ Human __Location:__ Z-City __Abilities:__ Superhuman Speed and Agility __Weapons:__ Ninja equipment __Occupation:__ Bodyguard (former, now a villain) __Affiliation:__ Mr. Monier (former) Sonic is a villain in the series, first appearing as a bodyguard hired by Mr. Monier. He views Saitama as his eternal rival. Sonic is a villain who, despite his normally calm appearance, loves fighting strong opponents as shown by when he gets a "child-like smile" on his face when he first meets Saitama and has two of his attacks blocked, earlier calling this his "bad habit." He seems to be very quick to act as he attacks Saitama on their first meeting without letting him explain the situation.

characters.name: Satoru
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: __Race:__ Human __Location:__ Z-City __Weapons:__ Gauntlets __Occupation:__ Superhero __Level:__ C-Class; Rank: 1 __Affiliation:__ Heroes Association License-less Rider is a C-Class Hero from Z-City. He has the #1 rank of the C-Class.

characters.name: Bad
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: Bad (バッド, Baddo), also known by his hero alias Metal Bat (金属バット, Kinzoku Batto), is the S-Class Rank 15 professional hero for the Hero Association. Metal Bat is a young man with black hair styled in a pompadour, and dark eyes that emphasize his hot temper. Metal Bat has a great deal of confidence in himself, stating that he did not care whether a threat is a Demon or Dragon level. Like Saitama, he doesn't care about his rank, and accidentally kills his enemies faster than he intended.

characters.name: King
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: __Race:__ Human __Occupation:__ Superhero __Level:__ S-Class; Rank 7 __Affiliation:__ The Heroes Association Despite not being the highest ranked hero of the Heroes Association, he is considered to be the most powerful man on Earth, and it is due to this strength that he receives praise and respect from fellow heroes. His strength is so feared that criminals and mysterious beings will surrender before having to fight him. Appearance: King has slightly long, blonde, brushed back hair along with three long scars on the left side of his face. He wears a turtleneck sweater, has sunken cheeks, a defined jawline and a squarish chin. Notably, a loud drumming sound may be heard in his proximity. The King Engine is a rumbling sound that others claim occurs when King readies for battle or when he is generally serious having an intimidating effect on his opponents.

characters.name: Bang
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm (5'5") __Race:__ Human __Occupation:__ Superhero __Level:__ S-Class __Rank:__ 3 __Affiliation:__ Heroes Association Bang is an S-Class, rank 3, superhero for the Heroes Association, settled in Z-City. Bang owns a dojo passed down from generations, and uses the fighting style the Rock-Smashing Water Stream Fist. __Abilities:__ Bang being in the top 3 of the S-Class ranking, he is acknowledged by the public and heroes to be a strong fighter. Not much is known about Bang's abilities other than that he uses a martial art called "Rock-Smashing Water Stream Fist".

characters.name: Zombieman
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: __Race:__ Human-Mutant __Abilities:__ Regeneration __S-Class:__ Rank 8 __Affiliation:__ Hero Association __Personality:__ Zombieman is stated to be nihilistic, possibly due to the fact that he has "died" several times, therefore he is always calm. In addition, he prefers to work as a lone wolf and dislikes gathering, although he still respects common courtesy. However, he appears to have a sadistic side, since he enjoys killings that create rivers of blood, he is also shown to be a rather smart individual, with detective-like thinking. In comparison to the other S-Class heroes, Zombieman is more thoughtful and respectful. __Abilities__: Zombieman possesses one of the best regeneration capabilities in the series. He is able to regenerate any part of his body no matter how severe the injury is, and he was able to heal his broken arms in an instant. He needs only a few minutes to recover from an extremely mutilated state and regrow his left arm, however this regeneration does not give Zombieman full immortality, as he will die if he is reduced to mincemeat. Zombieman has an incredible threshold for extensive physical activity, displaying one of the most impressive feats of stamina in the series and being able to fight for hours on end while his expedient recovery rate handles the more serious of injuries he suffers.

characters.name: Banken Man
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: Watchdog Man (番犬マン Banken-man) is a S-Class Rank 12 professional hero who is in charge of Q-City. Watchdog Man has been shown to be very blunt and nonchalant. He acts like a dog at all times, speaking sparingly, sitting on his haunches while alert or loitering, and curling up in a dog bed while asleep. He takes a stance on all fours while fighting, rather than standing upright to confront enemies.

characters.name: Boros-sama
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: __Race:__ Alien __Height:__ 240 cm (7'10½") __Occupation__: Space Pirate __Disaster Level:__ Dragon (or higher) Boros was the leader of the Dark Matter Thieves, a group of alien invaders responsible for the destruction of A-City. Like Saitama, Boros faced a self-imposed existential crisis, having become so powerful that no battle thrilled him.

characters.name: Puri-Puri Prisoner
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: __Occupation:__ Superhero __Level:__ S-Class; Rank 17 Puri-Puri Prisoner is a flamboyant, openly homosexual superhero. He takes an interest in other, up-and-coming heroes and criminals; an interest which led to his titular jail sentence, as he kept attacking them. Criminals that he apprehends are then added to his harem.

characters.name: Isamu
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: __Height:__ 135cm (4'5") __Race:__ Human __Occupation:__ Superhero __Level:__ S-Class; Rank: 5 __Affiliation:__ Heroes Association Child Emperor is a young boy with large eyes. He wears a plain T-shirt with two buttons both of which are buttoned, along with a black school bag on his back. As a genius, the Child Emperor values education, which can be seen when he mentions about going to cram school even after hearing about the Earth being in danger. He easily becomes infuriated when being labeled as childish by others. He is very analytical, observing the situation and formulating plans in a calm and collected manner.

characters.name: Senkou no Flash
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: __Race__: Human __Age__: 25 __Abilities__: Superhuman Speed and Agility, Master Swordsman, Ninjutsu Master __Occupation__: Superhero __S-Class__: Rank 13 __Personality__: Flashy Flash is a calm and serious man but he also appears to be quite arrogant. Despite his collected composure, Flashy Flash has a tendency to be hasty and reckless. __Abilities__: As an S-Class hero, Flashy Flash is very powerful. In terms of speed, Flashy Flash is arguably the fastest S-Class hero in the association, except for Blast and Saitama. Flashy was shown to be strong enough to combat and kill two Dragon-level threats simultaneously. He can deliver powerful kicks that can stun Dragon-level monsters. He can also easily cut massive pieces of stone and create giant explosions throughout his fighting.

characters.name: Kamikaze
alt_names: Earth's Strongest Swordmaster (地球最強の剣聖)
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: __Race:__ Human __Abilities:__ Superhuman Physical Prowess, Master Swordsmanship __Occupation:__ Superhero, Swordsmanship Teacher __Affiliation:__ Hero Association, Council of Swordmasters __Level:__ S-Class Rank 4 __Personality:__ Atomic Samurai has a rather prideful and jocular personality as seen when he refused to shake Saitama's hand, telling him that he only acknowledges the strong, and telling Saitama that he would greet him properly only if he makes it to the higher ranks of S-Class. Atomic Samurai also enjoys his swordplay and makes a game out of it, often taunting monsters and showing off as he cuts them to pieces, Kamikaze also is straightforward to a humorous degree in many ways, and is incredibly confident and cocky. __Abilities:__ Atomic Samurai is one of the top S-Class heroes. He is regarded as one of the most powerful of them, and the strongest backup hero in the Hero Association, he is also considered Earth's strongest swordsman. Atomic Samurai possesses extreme levels of speed, being able to cut his opponents to pieces in the blink of an eye using his sword.

characters.name: Ikemen Kamen Amai Mask
characters.native_name: イケメン仮面アマイマスク
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: __Race:__ Human __Occupation:__ Superhero __Level:__ A-Class; Rank 1. Sweet Mask is a tall and lean-built young man with messy, shoulder-length light blue hair and yellow eyes. He is considered to be very handsome by the public. Aside from being a hero he is also a famous model, actor and singer, being the most popular one in the world. Sweet Mask has stated that he believes that heroes are to protect the citizens, and if they can't do that, they must become strong enough to be able to do so. He also genuinely cares for the well-being of the citizens around him and actually wishes happiness upon every living thing in the universe. However, befitting the darker side of Sweet Mask's name is his hidden merciless nature. He is shown to have a burning hatred for anything that he sees as evil. Anything that he declares as evil must be swiftly and thoroughly exterminated. Sweet Mask is shown to adhere to any method that makes heroes popular. He notes that only promotions to S-Class or A-Class are fit for his attention, as they are the heroes who draw the most attention from the public, and hence, any heroes in those ranks who earn themselves negative reputations would drag his reputation down as well. Because of this, Sweet Mask stays in the A-Class Rank 1 position to prevent unworthy heroes from promoting to S-Class. Sweet Mask is very narcissistic about "beauty overwhelming the power", as he said about his philosophy that "heroes have to be beautiful as well". This became obvious when he showed interest in a worthy S-Class Hero like Genos, who has both a beautiful appeal and having done more heroic deeds as the main priority, fitting Sweet Mask's philosophy.

characters.name: Mosquito Musume
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: Mosquito Girl (モスキート娘 Mosukito Musume) is a prototype artificial mutant created by Dr. Genus of the House of Evolution. As a hybrid between human and mosquito, she has control over large swarms of the insects, using them to collect blood as sustenance or repair any bodily damage.

characters.name: Kudou Kishi
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: Drive Knight (駆動騎士, Kudō Kishi) is the S-Class Rank 9 professional hero for the Hero Association.Drive Knight has long black hair and wears a white mask. His mask has a single horizontal slit for the eyes, and a single red shining eye in the center of the slit. The mask has three small vertical slits where his mouth should be. His armor is rather simplistic, being similar to a medieval black knights' armor.

characters.name: Chougoukin Kurobikari
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: **Race:** Human **Occupation:** Superhero Superalloy Blackluster is a large, bald man with round eyes and a defined jawline. He is very muscular, with a thick neck, large and well-defined pectoral and abdominal muscles and large, muscular arms.

characters.name: Lin Lin
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: Lin Lin is a Martial Artist and user of the Palm Bell Fist.

characters.name: Shinkaiou
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: The Deep Sea King (深海王, Shinkaiō) ruled over the Seafolk as their king, and claimed the deep sea as his own. The Deep Sea King is a rather sadistic individual, who enjoys causing pain to others and starting fights. He is determined to take the surface world for himself to rule. He regards people as little more than food and has no qualms about treating them as such. He is also very arrogant and prideful, considering himself to be better than everyone and stating that he stands at the very top of the pyramid of all living organisms on the planet.

characters.name: Sneck
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: __Race:__ Human __Occupation:__ Superhero __Level:__ A-Class; Rank: 38 __Affiliation:__ Heroes Association Sneck is an A-Class Superhero, rank 38. He was tasked with welcoming the new heroes for the National Superhero Registry Test that Saitama and Genos were a part of.

characters.name: Butagami
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: __Race:__ Human __Occupation:__ Superhero __Abilities:__ Superhuman Physical Prowess, Inhuman Digestive System, Elasticity __Level:__ S-Class: Rank 10 __Personality:__ Pig God is a glutton and is constantly eating food. He is also very direct, or simply lazy. However he is a very caring individual and also appears to be very humble, as he usually doesn't mind helping others or openly embracing other heroes' advices. He also does not mind paying for people in secret. __Abilities:__ As an S-Class hero, Pig God is very powerful, he has the ability to digest swallowed monsters almost instantly, he also seems to have complete control over his digestive system. Pig God has a thick layer of fat capable of absorbing all types of impact and he is also immune to poison.

characters.name: Armored Gorilla
alt_names: アーマード ゴリラ
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization

characters.name: Genus Hakase
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: Gifted with immense intelligence, even at a young age he had made various scientific contributions. His fantastic mental capacities have allowed him to accomplish many genetic wonders. After considerable experimentation he has figured out how to create beasts such as Beast King and Carnage Kabuto.

characters.name: Ago no Wareta Gaki
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: He was saved by Saitama from Crablante three years prior to the start of the series.

characters.name: Banehige
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: __Level:__ A-Class; Rank: 33 Spring Mustachio is an intelligent, serious man who doesn't back down, as shown by his persistence in fighting Kombu Infinity, even after being beaten up rather badly. He also shares a bond with fellow A-Class hero Golden Ball, as they regularly pair up to hunt monsters and share drinks in their spare time.

characters.name: Kanirante
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: Mysterious Being which was created when a man ate too much crab and underwent metamorphosis.

characters.name: Bofoi
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: __Race:__ Human __Alias:__ Metal Knight __Location:__ Z-City __Abilities:__ Weapons; Large remotely controlled robot, with lots of firepower __Occupation:__ Superhero __Level:__ S-Class; Rank: 6 __Affiliation:__ The Heroes Association S-Class Rank 6 of the Hero Association. Besides fighting, Bofoi also provides many services for the Hero Association, such as weaponry sponsorships and facility construction.

characters.name: Stinger
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: __Occupation:__ Superhero __Level:__ A-Class; Rank 11

characters.name: Max
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: Max (マックス, Makkusu), also known by his hero alias Lightning Max (イナズマックス, Inazumakkusu), is the A-Class Rank 19 professional hero for the Hero Association. Max is shown to think ahead and spy on his target to know how to defeat them but it is shown that he has some doubt in his abilities.

characters.name: Tanktop Master
characters.native_name: タンクトップマスター
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: **Race:** Human **Occupation:** Superhero **Level:** S-Class; Rank: 14 **Affiliation:** The Heroes Association Much like the other heroes with the Tanktop motif, Tanktop Tiger and Tanktop Black Hole, Tanktop Master is a muscular man with a tanktop and short hair. However, unlike the other Tanktop heroes, no known color is associated with Tanktop Master's name. In the first anniversary color spread of the manga, he is shown with blonde hair and a blue tank top. Tanktop Master has a chivalrous nature, which can be seen when he noted that even if Tornado is ranked 2nd, he should not let a "little girl" handle dangerous enemies on her own, despite the fact that Tornado is actually an adult. He is also unafraid to admit defeat, for example, when he was outclassed by Tornado during the encounter of Dark Matter Thieves' aircraft.

characters.name: Geryuganshoop
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: Geryuganshoop was an alien, a general of the Dark Matter Thieves, and the right-hand man of Boros.

characters.name: Charanko
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: Charanko is a Martial Artist and Bang's last and only disciple before he was expelled during Garou's hero hunt.

characters.name: Ground Dragon
characters.native_name: グランド ドラゴン
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: __Affiliation:__ House of Evolution

characters.name: Iaian
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: Iaian is the A-Class Rank 2 professional hero of the Hero Association and the top disciple of Atomic Samurai. Iaian is described to be persistent in battle, refusing to back down regardless of whether his enemy is stronger or more skilled. Despite his persistence, he is in fact very analytical in battle, determining the strength of his opponent, all of their abilities and he also does not underestimate his opponent.

characters.name: Vaccine Man
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: __Height:__ 2-18 m (6'7"-59'1") __Level:__ Dragon Creature born due to the massive pollution released across the Earth by human beings. According to him, he was created as an incarnation of nature's wrath, meant to wipe out humanity and thus effectively vaccinate the earth against future infections. He is the first enemy faced by Saitama shown in One Punch-Man.

characters.name: Asura Kabuto
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: Carnage Kabuto (阿修羅カブト, Ashura Kabuto) was an artificial mutant created by Dr. Genus of the House of Evolution and is by far their strongest creation.

characters.name: Kombu Infinity
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: Mysterious Being that dwell in Z-City. It heard a rumor that a strong being was present in the outskirts of the town that drew strong Heroes opponents to it.

characters.name: Ougon Ball
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: __Race:__ Human __Weapons:__ Slingshot __Abilities:__ Shape Memory Gold __Occupation:__ Superhero __Level:__ A-Class; Rank: 29 __Affiliation:__ Heroes Association Golden Ball is an A-Class Superhero, rank 29. He was partnered with Spring Mustache to investigate the Kombu Infinity rumor in Z-City. He is a rather confident man, who believes he does not need to prepare for a fight.

characters.name: Kuseno Hakase
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: The doctor responsible for Genos' repairs and upgrades. He was pursing the cyborg that destroyed Genos' town. Genos begged for him to make him into a cyborg after promising the destroy the cyborg that destroyed his home.

characters.name: Hammer-Head
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: __Height:__ 215 cm (7'0") Leader of the Paradise Group. Is a wanted class B criminal with a past criminal record of numerous violent offenses.

characters.name: Groribas
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: Groribas is an Alien, who works for Boros' team, the "Dark Matter Thieves". He is a Dragon-Level threat and has a large imposing body. Its head and hands consist of eyeless mouths with rows of long sharp teeth. His head has a spiky collar around his neck and is quite muscular. He can use acid and hand to hand combat to its fullest usage leading him to be called the best warrior by Geryuganshoop.

characters.name: Tanktop Tiger
characters.native_name: タンクトップタイガー
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: **Race:** Human **Occupation:** Superhero **Level:** C-Class; Rank: 6 **Affiliation:** The Heroes Association Tanktop Tiger (タンクトップタイガー Tankutopu Taiga) is a C-Class superhero, rank 6, and the younger brother of Tanktop Black Hole. __Appearance:__ Tanktop Tiger is a large, muscular man who has tiger stripes running through his hair and eyebrows. He wears a tiger stripped tanktop. Tanktop Tiger is especially loud and obnoxious. He is confident in his own power and looks down upon superhero newbies, making him quite arrogant and hostile.

characters.name: Tanktop Black Hole
characters.native_name: タンクトップブラックホール
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: __Race:__ Human __Alias:__ Tanktop Black Hole __Occupation:__ Superhero __Level:__ B-Class __Affiliation:__ The Heroes Association __Partner:__ Tanktop Tiger Tanktop Black Hole is a B-Class hero and the older brother of Tanktop Tiger. Tanktop Black Hole is a large, well-built man with short black hair. He wears a very simple costume of pants and a black tanktop. He has a rather confident and stubborn personality. He refuses to believe a C-Class hero could ever be capable of destroying the meteor. He is also a rather charismatic person, shown by his ability to bend a crowd to his will.

characters.name: Melzargard
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: __Race__: Alien Melzalgald was one of the Alien Invaders who attacked A-City. Its body is able to change shape and It has multiple heads, each of which is able to separate and form its own body.

characters.name: Sitch
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: Sitch (シッチ, Shicchi) is the Minister Officer of Justice for the Hero Association.

characters.name: Exma
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: Executive for the Hero Association. She is the deputy chief of the Hero Disciplinary Supervision Division

characters.name: Juu Ou
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: Artificial mutant created by Dr. Genus of the House of Evolution. Beast King is the leader of Dr. Genus' strike force and second-strongest specimen in the House of Evolution, exceeded only by Carnage Kabuto.

characters.name: All Back-Man
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: __Rank:__ Class-C

characters.name: Kaeru Otoko
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: Race: Artificial Mutant Abilities: Weapns; Wakizashi Level: Tiger Affiliation: House of Evolution Debut: Chapter 7/Episode 2 Frog-Man was an artificial mutant created by Dr. Genus of the House of Evolution. Appearance: Frog-Man is a humanoid frog. He has large eyes, a white stomach and throat, black spots on his back and arms, and a scar that runs across his face. He wears a wide belt with a tanto stuck through it, black pants, sandals, a pendant necklace and has a kanji tattoo on his left shoulder. Overall, his appearance is that of a yakuza underling. Personality: Nothing is known about Frog-Man's personality due to his quick defeat by Saitama and eventual death at the hands of Beast King.

characters.name: Namekujarasu
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: __Race:__ Artificial Mutant __Abilities:__ Telepathy __Level:__ Tiger __Affiliation:__ House of Evolution __Debut:__ Chapter 7/Episode 2 Slugerous was an artificial mutant created by Dr. Genus of the House of Evolution. Appearance: Slugerous is a humanoid slug. He has a black spotted, very slug-like torso and head with the addition of arms and legs and a nose and mouth. Personality: Nothing is known of Slugerous' personality due death at the hands of Beast King.

characters.name: Zeniru
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: He is a multi-millionaire established in F-City.

characters.name: Fukegao
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: __Occupation:__ Scientist Fukegao was a genius scientist who developed the Biceps Brachii King steroid, which turned his brother Marugori into a mutated giant.

characters.name: Blue Fire
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: Blue Fire is an A-Class Rank 6 professional hero for the Hero Association.

characters.name: Kamakyuri
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: __Race:__ Artificial Mutant __Abilities:__ Weapons; Insect Fangs __Level:__ Tiger __Affiliation:__ House of Evolution __Debut:__ Chapter 7/Episode 2 Kamakyuri was an artificial mutant created by Dr. Genus. He is an advanced form of praying mantis, and purported to be among the stronger specimens of the House of Evolution. Appearance: Kamakyuri is a tall humanoid creature with many insect-like qualities. He is encased in a segmented, thorny exoskeleton, with clawed feet and serrated, scythe-like forelegs, similar to those of a praying mantis. Mandibles protrude on each side of his mouth, and the top of his skull is transparent and reflective, revealing his brain. Personality: Nothing is known of Kamakyuri's personality due to his defeat by Saitama.

characters.name: Chitei Ou
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: __Race:__ Mysterious Being __Location:__ Under the earth's crust __Abilities:__ Superhuman Strength __Weapons:__ Lava Swords __Affiliation:__ Mother Earth __Debut:__ Chapter 4/Episode 1 The Subterranean King is the king of the Subterranean People. He led his people from below the surface to conquer the area on it.

characters.name: Smile Man
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: Smile Man is a A-Class Rank 27 professional hero for the Hero Association.

characters.name: Shibabawa
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: __Race:__ Human __Occupation:__ Fortune Teller Shibabawa was a renowned fortune teller that resided in G-City. Shibabawa is an old woman with white hair, long fingernails, very thin eyebrows and many wrinkles. She has sunken cheeks and very few teeth. She wears a pearl necklace and earrings. Not much is known of her personality, but she seems to fear a 'great disaster' she foretold.

characters.name: Denchi Man
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: Denchi Man is a C-Class Rank 85 professional hero for the Hero Association.

characters.name: Marugori
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: Marugori also called Beefcake, was a human who drank the Biceps Brachii King steroid developed by Fukegao, which turned him into a mutated giant.

characters.name: Chitei Hito
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: __Race:__ Mysterious Being __Location:__ Under the earth's crust __Abilities:__ Immense Strength __Affiliation:__ Mother Earth __Debut:__ Chapter 4/Episode 1 The Subterranean People are the self-proclaimed "True People of the Earth". They are ruled by the Subterranean King and live under the earth's crust, but grew too numerous in numbers and planned to take over the surface.

characters.name: Super Custom YO649Z Mk. II
characters.native_name: バリカスタムよ649ZマークⅡ
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: Mysterious being.

characters.name: Suiryu
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: Suiryu is a Martial Artist and user of the Void Fist. He is said to be a top contender in the Super Fight tournament. Suiryu is an easygoing and carefree man usually seen smiling and is a notorious playboy, who would rather spend time with women than training. He is also very eager to fight strong opponents and believes the reason for fighting is to live an easy life without worry. During fights, Suiryu holds back in an effort to make any fight more interesting, only using his legs during his fights and later defeating his opponents with one kick. While fighting he tries to make small talk and after he defeats his opponents, he sarcastically apologizes to them for being too strong. Suiryu is a martial arts prodigy. Despite having spent most of his time goofing off or not taking his lessons seriously, he still ultimately became one of the most revered martial artists in the world, considered a legend for winning four Super Fight tournaments in a row.

characters.name: Lily
alt_names: Sansetsukon no Lily (三節棍のリリー)
Lily of the Three Section Staff
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: The Class B Rank 74 hero who is the personal assistant of Fubuki of the Blizzard Bunch. She uses a staff as her fighting weapon.

characters.name: Sekingar
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: Executive in the Hero Association. He commands the mission to rescue Waganma.

characters.name: Agoni
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: Race: Human Location: A-City Occupation: Founder of The Heroes Association Affiliation: The Heroes Association Agoni is a multi-millionaire and the founder of The Heroes Association. He had the idea for said group when his grandson was attacked by a Mysterious Being 3 years prior to the time One Punch-Man is set.

characters.name: Hero Kyoukai Shokuin
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: A currently unnamed Z Branch Operator for the Hero Association.

characters.name: Jet Nice Guy
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: Class B Superhero.

characters.name: Hige Shokuin
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization

characters.name: Matsuge
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization

characters.name: Megane Shokuin
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization

characters.name: Armored Kakarichou
characters.energy_system: Broken Biological Limiter, Martial Arts & Monsterization
characters.description: He is one of the C class hero.

characters.name: Aki Hayakawa
characters.energy_system: Devil Contracts, Blood Drinking & Devil Hybrid Physiology
characters.description: __Height:__ 182 cm (6'0") __Devil Contracts:__ Fox Devil, Curse Devil, __Relatives:__ Hahaoya Hayakawa (Mother), Chichioya Hayakawa (Father), Taiyou Hayakawa (Younger Brother). A Public Safety Devil Hunter working under Makima as a member of Tokyo Special Division 4. He is partnered with Himeno and tasked with supervising both Power and Denji. Aki Hayakawa generally appears to be a very stoic person. He acts mature and dependable when he's with his fellow Devil hunters but is actually very soft when he is alone. He has a tendency to get attached to others easily, and hates to see people get hurt, especially his close friends. Aki's primary goal and reasoning for becoming a Devil Hunter is to kill the Gun Devil to get revenge for his family.

characters.name: Pochita
alt_names: Chainsaw no Akuma (チェンソーの悪魔)
characters.energy_system: Devil Contracts, Blood Drinking & Devil Hybrid Physiology
characters.description: Pochita appears to be a small red canine with a chainsaw like appendage protruding from the center of his head. Handles emerge from his body allowing him to be wielded like a chainsaw and his short tail is in the shape of a chainsaw's pull cord. Unlike most devils, Pochita communicated solely through barks and whines like an actual dog.

characters.name: Kobeni Higashiyama
characters.energy_system: Devil Contracts, Blood Drinking & Devil Hybrid Physiology
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm A Public Safety Devil Hunter, she is a new recruit working under Makima as a member of Tokyo Special Division 4. She is partnered with Hirokazu Arai. She is not very courageous and gets scared easily by devils. Kobeni is shown to easily crack under pressure and break into tears during serious moments. Even though Kobeni is timid, she is pretty talented as a devil hunter. When Kobeni gets into action, she has proven to be cool-headed and efficient in battle, only breaking down in a panic once the fighting is over. Kobeni chooses to keep her devil contract a secret.

characters.name: Tenshi no Akuma
characters.energy_system: Devil Contracts, Blood Drinking & Devil Hybrid Physiology
characters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm Angel Devil is a devil who embodies the fear of angels, and a Public Safety Devil Hunter from Special Division 4. The Angel Devil is a unique case among devils having virtually no hostility towards humans. He dislikes being ordered around and doesn't seem inclined towards combat. His extreme laziness holds him back from being a strong fighter and he often refuses to work, even claiming to prefer dying to working.

characters.name: Himeno
characters.energy_system: Devil Contracts, Blood Drinking & Devil Hybrid Physiology
characters.description: __Height:__ 175 cm (5'9") __Devil Contract:__ Ghost Devil __Relatives:__ Unnamed Younger Sister A Public Safety Devil Hunter, working under Makima as a member of Tokyo Special Division 4. She is partnered with Aki Hayakawa, whom she shares a close personal bond with. Himeno is shown to be a mature and experienced superior to the new recruits working under her. She generally carries herself with an upbeat body language and is capable of staying calm under extremely stressful situations. Himeno is very efficient and blunt in her duty as a Devil Hunter. Himeno is also shown to be a rather caring and empathetic person, however she does have a sterner side and little tolerance for behavior from new recruits that would endanger or harm her subordinates. Himeno holds an extremely pessimistic worldview as a result of having witnessed multiple partners die suddenly in her line of work. Her knowledge that Devil Hunters typically die as a result of their career combined with the teachings of her master eventually lead to her developing a nicotine addiction as a coping mechanism. She also tends to acts extremely aloof and sexual, enjoying a hedonistic lifestyle. However, similarly to her smoking addiction, her hedonistic ways are not used as pleasure, but rather as another defense mechanism.

characters.name: Kishibe
characters.energy_system: Devil Contracts, Blood Drinking & Devil Hybrid Physiology
characters.description: __Height:__ 194 cm __Devil Contracts:__ A Public Safety Devil Hunter from Special Division 1. Kishibe is a grizzled man with scraggly facial hair and a stitched scar running across his left cheek from his mouth. He normally wears the standard Public Safety devil hunter uniform with a large overcoat. He has two piercings on his left ear, and one on his right ear. He is often seen with a hip flask which he frequently drinks from. Kishibe is a stoic, straightforward individual. Due to his immense strength and skill, he often undertakes his work with a calm formality, displaying little emotion as he does so. Though he tends to speak in a relaxed, polite manner, his actions often showcase an immense brutality garnered through many years of Devil Hunting. Though he sometimes expresses emotions such as surprise and sadness at certain events, his face and voice remain entirely neutral. Kishibe has been hunting devils for a long time, making him somewhat insane. He espouses a belief that the most fearsome devil hunters to devils isn't the brave or the strong, but the craziest as they are the ones without fear. He admits that he enjoys booze, women and killing devils.

characters.name: Beam
characters.energy_system: Devil Contracts, Blood Drinking & Devil Hybrid Physiology
characters.description: __Height:__ 165 cm (With fin: 176 cm) He is a Shark Fiend and a Public Safety Devil Hunter from Special Division 4. Beam is very eccentric. He often goes along with Denji's plans no matter how crazy they are due to having a lot of respect for the Chainsaw Devil.

characters.name: Bouryoku no Majin
characters.energy_system: Devil Contracts, Blood Drinking & Devil Hybrid Physiology
characters.description: He is a Fiend and Public Safety Devil Hunter from Special Division 4. Despite his moniker as the Violence Fiend, he is extremely polite and straightforward.
