characters.name: Rem
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm (5'1") Rem is one of the twin maids working for Roswaal L Mathers. She looks nearly identical to her sister Ram apart from her hair, eyes, and ribbon coloring. Rem tends to speak in a superficially polite manner and sometimes acts without thinking. She holds both respect to the point of worship and guilt toward her sister for an incident in the past. Because of her respect and guilt toward her sister, she used to think of herself as inferior.

characters.name: Ram
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: __Height:__ 154 cm (5'1") Ram is one of the twin maids working for Roswaal L Mathers. She looks nearly identical to her sister Rem apart from her hair, eyes, and ribbon coloring. Ram is seemingly self-centered and does things at her own pace, however in actuality she maintains a distance from people to ascertain them. She believes that Roswaal is the greatest and no one else is as precious except for her sister Rem. She is slightly more outgoing in comparison to the generally taciturn Rem, who generally allows Ram to take the lead in their sisterly bond.

characters.name: Beatrice
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: __Height:__ 140 cm (4'7") __Age:__ The caretaker of the library in Roswaal's mansion. She has a distinct way of speaking, adding "I suppose" and "in fact" at the end of some of her sentences.

characters.name: Otto Suwen
characters.native_name: オットー・スーウェン
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Otto Suwen is a merchant appearing in Re:Zero. His remarkable misfortune always takes him to dangerous situations, from which he escapes thanks to his wit. Otto has gray hair that is mentioned to be as long as a gal game protagonist. He is said to be somewhat handsome if he has a serious expression. However, he is usually either retorting, shouting, or panicking, ruining his looks. He has a medium build, but has trained himself since he used to work as a merchant.

characters.name: Reinhard van Astrea
characters.native_name: ラインハルト・ヴァン・アストレア
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: __Height__: 184 cm (6'0") Reinhard van Astrea is the current Sword Saint and a member of the Royal Guard, currently acting as Felt's knight. As the Sword Saint and the Knight of the Royal Guard, Reinhard embodies chivalry and elegance, treating everyone with exceptional respect. He is fair, brave, and always acts in the name of justice, whether on duty or simply strolling through the Royal Capital. As a knight, Reinhard only uses his sword when necessary, since, in addition to being a rule, his iron-clad rule is to not inflict pain to others if not absolutely necessary, be it a normal thug or a member of the Witch Cult.

characters.name: Felix Argyle
characters.native_name: フェリックス・アーガイル
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Felix Argyle commonly known as Ferris, is Crusch Karsten's knight. He is a beast human (demi-human).

characters.name: Crusch Karsten
characters.native_name: クルシュ・カルステン
alt_names: Goddess of War (戦争の女神; Sensou no Megami)
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Crusch Karsten is the Matriarch of House Karsten and a candidate to become the 42nd King of Lugnica. While normally calm and serious, Crusch is honest, sincere, right, being a type of person who is destined to stand above others, though she has talent and has worked hard to reach where she is now. She is already the head of her family, finishing her work better than her father. She prefers to act herself and has the pride of a warrior. Crusch is also gentle, often believing the false knowledge jokingly told to her by Ferris, and sometimes displays an airheaded side. Like her mother Helena Karsten, she is shown to be ruthless and reckless.

characters.name: Puck
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: __Height:__ 7 cm Puck is an Artificial Spirit that Emilia was formerly contracted with. He is the current Great Spirit of Fire. Puck can be described as cute or adorable, thus his skin being pink around his cheeks. His fur is mostly grey with silver in certain spots (i.e. tip of the tail). His eyebrows are pretty small and rhombus-shaped. He also has a gold earring on his left ear. Sometimes, he carries a purple bag. Puck is generally a nice spirit. He is very happy and stays at Emilia's side to protect her, affectionately calling her "Lia". He occasionally goofs around and gets along especially well with Beatrice.

characters.name: Julius Euclius
characters.native_name: ユリウス・ユークリウス
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: __Height:__ 179 cm (5'10") Julius Euclius is Anastasia Hoshin's knight and a member of the Royal Guard. Julius lived with his family at the Euclius House. After his father, Klein Euclius died, he started to live with his uncle Alviero and he started to take care of Julius and became his adoptive father. As a member of Lugnica's nobility, Julius acts in a proper fashion, always having an air of nobility and conviction. He is also considerate and doesn't forget to show care toward others. He also shows a strict side, giving out accurate assessments of others whether they're good or bad, which is a result of his upbringing as an elite, and in actuality, he believes that he and others can do better than they currently are. Julius doesn't like those who forget their place, leading him to have bad relations with Subaru for a while. While both have apologized to each other after the battle with the Hakugei, Subaru told him he still hated him. Julius said he didn't intend to be friends. They both became very intimate very quickly during the planning and attacking the Witch Cult. In the end, Julius directly considered Subaru as his friend.

characters.name: Wilhelm van Astrea
characters.native_name: ヴィルヘルム・ヴァン・アストレア
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: __Height:__ 178 cm (5'10") Wilhelm van Astrea né Trias, is a member of the Crusch Camp and was Theresia van Astrea's husband. Wilhelm is a refined man with a highly gentle and humble demeanor. However unearth that even temperament belied a fierce warrior who often is the first to help when something happens. However this wasn't always the case as in youth, Wilhelm was very opposite of who he was in his later years. Brash, afoot, short tempered, lonely and often cold with others. He was a troubled individual who devoted himself wholly to the sword and cared for little else. Even so, he knew how to analyze a situation, always finding a way out. Nonetheless, Theresia greatly influenced his personality, becoming increasingly sociable and protective, achieving more results during the Demi-human War. It was through her most of all that he would become the person he is today.

characters.name: Roswaal Mathers
characters.native_name: ロズワール・Ｌ・メイザース
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: The lord of the Roswaal Mansion and a descendant of the original Roswaal. He comes across as an eccentric due to his flamboyant appearance and odd speaking style, the latter which he shares with his grandmother. However, he harbors a more calculating and reserved side with a sharp political mind and gaze that reads others quite well.

characters.name: Petelgeuse Romanee-Conti
characters.native_name: ペテルギウス・ロマネコンティ
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Sin Archbishop of the Witch Cult, representing sloth.

characters.name: Priscilla Barielle
characters.native_name: プリシラ・バーリエル
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: The matriarch of House Barielle and a candidate to become the 42nd King of Lugunica. Her knight is Al.

characters.name: Felt
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: **Height:** 150 cm (4'11") A thief that lives in the slums. Felt stole Emilia's insignia, hoping for quick, easy cash. Though Felt can usually handle her own, she does consider Rom to be like family.

characters.name: Aldebaran
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: **Height:** 173 cm (5'8") Aldebaran, commonly known as Al, is Priscilla Barielle's knight, though he claims to just be a subordinate. He has a frivolous personality and acts aloof, but shows insecurity regarding his disfigured face and wears a helmet to conceal it. Due to that, he is a man of both eccentric appearance and behavior.

characters.name: Elsa Granhiert
characters.native_name: エルザ・グランヒルテ
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: An assassin-for-hire from the Northernmost nation, the Holy Kingdom of Gusteko, known as "The Bowel Hunter". Elsa wishes to make a trade for an insignia, as her client's wishes.

characters.name: Patrasche
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Subaru's Earth Dragon that he officially received from Crusch Karsten for his efforts in the Hakugei battle. Despite being of a species known for being feisty, Patrasche is extremely loyal to Subaru, as she is willing to put her life on the line for him.

characters.name: Anastasia Hoshin
characters.native_name: アナスタシア・ホーシン
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Anastasia Hoshin is the head of the Hoshin Trading Company and a candidate to become the 42nd King of Lugunica. Her knight is Julius Juukulius. Despite her surname being "Hoshin", she's not directly related to Hoshin of the Wilderness. She chose the name because she was inspired by his legacy.

characters.name: Petra Leyte
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Petra is a bright and kind girl from Irlam Village. She likes Subaru very much after he saved her from the Wolgarm incident.

characters.name: Theresia van Astrea
characters.native_name: テレシア・ヴァン・アストレア
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Theresia was the former Sword Saint/Master Swordsman, Wilhelm's wife and Reinhard's grandmother.

characters.name: Meili Portroute
characters.native_name: メィリィ・ポートルート
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: One of the children that lives in the village within Roswaal's region. She's timid, though is friendly, such as when she introduces a small dog to Subaru.

characters.name: Mimi Pearlbaton
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: __Height:__ 135 cm (4'5") Mimi is one of Anastasia Hoshin's followers and is one of three vice-captains of the mercenary group Fang of Steel.

characters.name: Rom
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Rom, commonly known as Grandpa or Old Man Rom, is a member of the Felt Camp and the former owner of the Stolen Goods Warehouse.

characters.name: Ricardo Welkin
characters.native_name: リカード・ウェルキン
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Ricardo Welkin is one of Anastasia Hoshin's followers and the captain of the mercenary group: Fang of Iron.

characters.name: Kadomon Risch
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Kadomon is a fruit seller in the royal capital.

characters.name: Hetaro Pearlbaton
characters.native_name: ヘータロー・パールバトン
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Hetaro Pearlbaton is one of Anastasia Hoshin's followers and is one of the three vice captains of the mercenary group Fang of Iron.

characters.name: Tivey Pearlbaton
characters.native_name: ティビー・パールバトン
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: One of Anastasia Hoshin's followers and is one of the three vice captains of the mercenary group Fang of Iron.

characters.name: Rachins Hoffman
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: One of the three thugs that attacked Subaru at the very start of Arc 1.

characters.name: Plum Risch
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Plum is the daughter of Kadomon Risch

characters.name: Russell Fellow
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic

characters.name: Kan
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: __Height:__ 130 cm (4'3") Camberley, commonly known as Kan, is one of the three thugs that attacked Subaru.

characters.name: Raksha Risch
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Wife of Kadomon Risch.

characters.name: Gaston
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Gaston, commonly known as Ton, is one of the three thugs that attacked Subaru.

characters.name: Quark
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Quark was Ram and Rem's father.

characters.name: Lucas
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Citizen of Irlam Village.

characters.name: Temae
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Temae was Ram and Rem's mother.

characters.name: Bordeaux Zellgef
characters.native_name: ボルドー・ツェルゲフ
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Bordeaux Zellgef is a member of the Sage Council. During the Demi-Human war, he acted as the captain of the Zellgef Squadron. Four decades ago during the Demi-Human War, Bordeaux was a tall, muscular and somewhat frightening man, usually donned in heavy iron armour and wielding a massive battle axe. He had short and spiky light blue hair, and equally blue and thick eyebrows. His eyes radiated a strong fighting spirit.

characters.name: Ketty Muttart
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Was a merchant and a member of the Witch Cult.

characters.name: Marcos Gildark
characters.native_name: マーコス・ギルダーク
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Marcos Gildark is the captain of the Royal Guard and Knight Commander.

characters.name: Setanta
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Setanta was the chief of the Oni Village Ram and Rem lived at when they were young.

characters.name: Hitosashiyubi
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic

characters.name: Rickert Hoffman
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic

characters.name: Miklotov McMahon
characters.native_name: マイクロトフ・マクマホン
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: The representative of the Council of Wise Men who are currently ruling over the Dragon Kingdom of Lugunica. Many have considered Miklotov to be the true brains of the Kingdom who, in the event that the royal family were to disappear, would be a suitable replacement ruler.

characters.name: Satella
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Satella is one of the Witches of Sin, being the Witch of Envy.

characters.name: Frederica Baumann
characters.native_name: フレデリカ・バウマン
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Frederica Baumann is a maid working for Roswaal L. Mathers and a member of the Emilia Camp. She quit her job as a maid a few months before Subaru's appearance, but returned after Ram couldn't manage the mansion

characters.name: Schult
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Schult is a member of the Priscilla Camp. Though not much is known about him, he's extremely loyal to his mistress and is one of her closest attendants.

characters.name: Chamov
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Chamov is a puppy demihuman, with white hair, blue eyes, and an amiable puppy face. He typically likes to wear a hat.

characters.name: Echidna
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Echidna is one of the Witches of Sin, being the Witch of Greed. She has a strong thirst for knowledge along with a curiosity for the unknown, which defines her behavior. Echidna is described as black hearted, being unable to empathize with others and their feelings due to a lack of understanding. She will do anything to gain knowledge, be it deceit or employed sophistry.

characters.name: Garfiel Tinsel
characters.native_name: ガーフィール・ティンゼル
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Garfiel Tinsel is the former guardian of the Sanctuary and a member of the Emilia Camp. Introduced during Arc 4, he became one of the main supporting characters of the season. He's a half-beast human and Frederica Baumann's half-brother. He can transform himself in a giant golden tiger that can deal powerful attacks but with a cost of losing his reason, so he uses this ability when he's pushed to the limit.

characters.name: Regulus Corneas
characters.native_name: レグルス・コルニアス
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Regulus is a young man of a medium height. He has gold eyes, white hair and a middle to skinny build. Regulus Is a part of the Sin Archbishops of the Witch Cult and represents greed. Regulus is known for being very talkative and calls himself unselfish, while in fact he is very prideful and likes to act above others and reference himself as above others.

characters.name: Minerva
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Minerva is one of the Witches of Sin, being the Witch of Wrath. Minerva dislikes conflict and wishes for all to be well. She also only cares about what's directly in front of her, not worrying about things she cannot see. Minerva has some history with the elves as she cares deeply for Emilia, along with the other elves.

characters.name: Ryuuzu Meyer
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Ryuuzu was a half-elf who lived in the Sanctuary during the era of the witches, 400 years ago. She was used by Echidna in order to activate the Sanctuary's barrier. During Echidna's immortality experiments, she created copies of Ryuzu and tasked them with protecting the Sanctuary.

characters.name: Carmilla
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Carmilla is one of the Witches of Sin, being the Witch of Lust. She has no self confidence, being timid, and tends to have downcast eyes. Despite this, others find her similar to a scared animal, making them attracted to her.

characters.name: Sekhmet
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Sekhmet is one of the Witches of Sin, being the Witch of Sloth. As her position suggests, she can be summed up to being extremely lazy, enough that she finds breathing to be a pain.

characters.name: Daphne
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Daphne is one of the Witches of Sin, being the Witch of Gluttony. All she wants is to be full, it's her reason for living. Daphne enjoys giving people nicknames, such as Subarun for Subaru.

characters.name: Typhon
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Typhon is one of the Witches of Sin, being the Witch of Pride. She is said to judge people with the innocence and ruthlessness of a young girl.

characters.name: Kenichi Natsuki
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Subaru's father. Subaru idolized his father and wanted to be like him. However, after this proved to be impossible, he went through a downward spiral that ultimately resulted in him becoming a shut-in. Kenichi is hard-working, diligent, and loved by all, which led to a huge amount of expectations being put on Subaru by his surroundings as he is "Kenichi's Son", which furthermore increased the burden on him. He was shown to be a very supportive dad which, although always trying to get his son to go out of the house or go back to school, never forgets to put his son's emotional state before it all through physical bonding and father-to-son talks.

characters.name: Naoko Natsuki
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Subaru's mother.

characters.name: Rye Batenkaitos
characters.native_name: ライ・バテンカイトス
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Rye Batenkaitos is a Sin Archbishop of the Witch Cult, representing the gourmet aspect of gluttony.

characters.name: Rigel Natsuki
characters.energy_system: Return by Death, Witch Factors, Divine Protections & Elemental Magic
characters.description: Natsuki Rigel is the non canon son of Natsuki Subaru and Rem.

characters.name: Kaguya Shinomiya
characters.energy_system: Genius Psychological Warfare, Strategy & Social Machinations
characters.description: __Height:__ 158 cm The vice president of the student council of Shuchiin Academy, member of the wealthy Shinomiya family, she is a multi-talented genius who can do anything if she sets her mind to it. Due to the way she was raised, she instinctively looks down on others and thinks of ways to use them for her own benefit. Kaguya rarely interacted with other people before she joined the student council, but that has begun to change. She is an incredibly sheltered girl, resulting in her lacking in several pieces of what might be considered common sense. She still doesn’t understand love very well, and her main objective is to make Miyuki Shirogane fall in love and confess to her. Later in the series:

characters.name: Yuu Ishigami
characters.energy_system: Genius Psychological Warfare, Strategy & Social Machinations
characters.description: The treasurer of the student council of the Shuchiin Academy. He's extremely valued by Miyuki, given that he single-handedly manages all the school's funds. He's also terrified of Kaguya, though no one else is sure why that is. Yuu keeps to himself and rarely speaks up, often getting into trouble when he does. He has a depressed outlook on life while having an inferiority complex. In contrast to his attitude, he is willing to help those in need and will sacrifice his pride if need be. Unlike his high school self, he had a much different outlook and demeanor during middle school. Later in the series:

characters.name: Miyuki Shirogane
characters.energy_system: Genius Psychological Warfare, Strategy & Social Machinations
characters.description: __Height:__ 175 cm He is a second year student at Shuchi'in Academy and the president of the student council. Miyuki is a handsome young man with blond hair and blue eyes. Due to his constant sleep deprivation and nearsightedness, his eyes appear to glare. He usually wears the regular Shuchi'in Academy black male uniform adorned with the Aiguilette, the golden chain-like accessory around his neck. The Aiguilette symbolizes his authority as student council president. Shirogane is a diligent student who, despite his underprivileged background, climbed his way to the top of his class through hard work and determination. Shirogane holds himself in high regard, consistently working to maintain his perfect image. He is textbook workaholic, enjoying his part-time job and often putting his own health at risk for the sake of his work. Due to his poor background, Shirogane values money greatly and goes to great lengths to not be wasteful, and generally dislikes expensive gifts. Even though he is obviously in love with Kaguya Shinomiya, her wealth and talents greatly intimidates him, leaving him utterly terrified at the idea of confessing to her. He fears that all of his actions will lead Kaguya to look down him, causing him to overthink in many situations. Shirogane has never had a girlfriend and thus is actually quite clueless when it comes to romance, though his dignified demeanor leaves most of the students to think otherwise. Although he excels at studying, Shirogane has proven to be painfully talentless in a variety of other activities, such as sports, singing, dancing and more. Despite this, Shirogane is unwaveringly kind and virtuous, never putting any of his goals above the well-being of others. He is extremely supportive and generous, willing to help any students with their problems, and will put aside his quest to get Kaguya to confess if it even has a chance of hurting someone else.

characters.name: Ai Hayasaka
characters.energy_system: Genius Psychological Warfare, Strategy & Social Machinations
characters.description: Ai Hayasaka is a second-year student at Shuchiin Academy and a valet of the Shinomiya family. She is a member of the Hayasaka family, who have served the Shinomiya family for generations, gaining their trust. Having been personally assigned to enter Shuchiin Academy with her, Ai supports Kaguya Shinomiya in her high school life and has been a part of Kaguya's life for ten years. Because of their close relationship, Ai is one of the few people around to which Kaguya's amiability is not an act. Even if she demonstrates maturity as a valet, Ai still has the concerns of a young girl, such as caring to be in fashion and going out with friends, even if she does not have much time for herself due to work. Ai helps Kaguya with the struggles about her feelings for Shirogane.

characters.name: Kei Shirogane
characters.energy_system: Genius Psychological Warfare, Strategy & Social Machinations
characters.description: Kei Shirogane is Miyuki Shirogane's little sister. She attends Shuchiin middle school and is the treasurer for the middle school student council. She is a hard worker just like her brother and can be very prideful at times. She also inherited his sense of righteousness and hates it when someone doesn't do the right thing in a given situation. Like her brother, she likes helping out those who are in trouble even if it means going out of her way to do it. Since she grew up in a family that places emphasis on saving money, she normally carries coupons and works hard for the things she wants to buy. She developed a prickly attitude towards her brother due to his over protectiveness. She's also entered a rebellious phase and due to her pride and she cannot get herself to have a lighthearted conversation with Miyuki, leading into the similar mind games that Miyuki and Kaguya play against each other, but her objective is to talk to Miyuki without making it look like she has a brother complex. She rarely speaks and most of the time it is only when she exchanges formalities at school or when she hurls abuses at her brother.

characters.name: Shirogane no Chichi
characters.energy_system: Genius Psychological Warfare, Strategy & Social Machinations
characters.description: Father of Miyuki and Kei Shirogane.

characters.name: Nagisa Kashiwagi
characters.energy_system: Genius Psychological Warfare, Strategy & Social Machinations
characters.description: Nagisa is a classmate who occasionally asks Kaguya about what to do in her relationships. Tsubasa's girlfriend.

characters.name: Moeha Fujiwara
characters.energy_system: Genius Psychological Warfare, Strategy & Social Machinations
characters.description: Moeha is Chika's little sister who is in junior high. She is the student council vice-president at the junior high. She admires Miyuki as well and hopes to confess someday. She has a habit of voicing dark ideas, which unnerve Kaguya a great deal.

characters.name: Adolphe Pescarolo
characters.native_name: アドルフ・ペスカローロ
characters.energy_system: Genius Psychological Warfare, Strategy & Social Machinations
characters.description: The Principal of Shuchi'in Academy He's strict regarding school regulations, but knows how to garner the favor of students nonetheless. He helped Yu Ishigami get enrolled to Shuchi'in despite not finishing his task of making an apology letter. Despite being an authority figure within the school, he has shown comical disregard for school rules and discipline when it comes to his own actions, having been openly caught playing Pokemon Go on more than one occasion on school grounds while chastising nearby students for doing the same.

characters.name: Tsubasa Tanuma
characters.energy_system: Genius Psychological Warfare, Strategy & Social Machinations
characters.description: He is a student in Shuchi'in highschool and always asks Miyuki Shirogane for advice about love. Kashiwagi's boyfriend.

characters.name: Saburo Odajima
characters.energy_system: Genius Psychological Warfare, Strategy & Social Machinations
characters.description: One of the Four Ramen Emperors of Tokyo. In the past, Saburo was in a relationship with The Glutton Girl of Jinbocho, but he broke up with her over their polar opposite ramen styles, believing they'll eventually end up at each other's throats.

characters.name: J Suzuki
characters.energy_system: Genius Psychological Warfare, Strategy & Social Machinations
characters.description: A taxi driver and one of the Four Ramen Emperors of Tokyo.

characters.name: Shitsuji
characters.energy_system: Genius Psychological Warfare, Strategy & Social Machinations
characters.description: One of the butler's assigned to Kaguya

characters.name: Miki
characters.energy_system: Genius Psychological Warfare, Strategy & Social Machinations
characters.description: An elementary school student

characters.name: Miko Iino
characters.energy_system: Genius Psychological Warfare, Strategy & Social Machinations
characters.description: __Height:__ 147 cm (4'7") She is a freshman at Shuchiin Private Academy and the Auditor of the Student Council. Miko has a strong sense of justice and will correct others on what's right and wrong. Unfortunately, this led to her being bullied, though she still continues to uphold her idea of "right". She idolizes Chika Fujiwara, listening to anything she says, even if it's for Chika's enjoyment.

characters.name: Maki Shijo
characters.energy_system: Genius Psychological Warfare, Strategy & Social Machinations
characters.description: Maki is a classmate and friend of Nagisa. She has short hair styled in short pigtails. She is friends with Nagisa and is secretly jealous of Nagisa's relationship with her boyfriend, as she too liked Kashiwagi's Boyfriend, but could not confess before. As a branch member of the Shinomiya clan, she is Kaguya's second cousin twice removed so she sometimes refers to Kaguya as "Auntie". Miyuki and Yuu observe she acts very tsundere (cold on the outside but wanting to be affectionate), and similar to Kaguya in personality. She declares Yuu and Miyuki as her friends, due to their support in helping her process her failed romance, much to Kaguya's horror

characters.name: Kobachi Osaragi
characters.energy_system: Genius Psychological Warfare, Strategy & Social Machinations
characters.description: Kobachi is Miko's classmate with the glasses and a member of the disciplinary committee. She has been looking after Miko for over 10 years.

characters.name: Toyomi Fujiwara
characters.energy_system: Genius Psychological Warfare, Strategy & Social Machinations
characters.description: Toyomi Fujiwara is Chika Fujiwara and Moeha Fujiwara's eldest sister. Toyomi is a girl that likes to wear revealing outfits, her hair is similar to Chika's except that she tied hers with a flower shaped clip to go down on her left shoulder. She usually wears an aloof expression on her face. Toyomi is the laid back older sister type, who is very seductive and does whatever she likes, even against her own parents wishes.

characters.name: Karen Kino
characters.energy_system: Genius Psychological Warfare, Strategy & Social Machinations
characters.description: She is a member of the mass media club at Shuchi'in Academy.

characters.name: Erika Kose
characters.energy_system: Genius Psychological Warfare, Strategy & Social Machinations
characters.description: She is a member of the mass media club at Shuchi'in Academy.

characters.name: Pes
characters.energy_system: Genius Psychological Warfare, Strategy & Social Machinations
characters.description: Pes is the beloved pet dog of Chika Fujiwara. He is quite a large dog, with golden fur and floppy ears. He has piercing eyes like the president

characters.name: Betsy Beltoise
characters.native_name: べルトクーズ・べツィー
characters.energy_system: Genius Psychological Warfare, Strategy & Social Machinations
characters.description: The vice president of Shuchi'in Academy's sister school in France.

characters.name: Mirin Hinokuchi
characters.energy_system: Genius Psychological Warfare, Strategy & Social Machinations
characters.description: One of Ai Hayasaka's closest friends. She wears her Shuchi'in Academy school uniform modified to match up with kogal fashion. She is the daughter of an advertising executive.

characters.name: Kozue Makihara
characters.energy_system: Genius Psychological Warfare, Strategy & Social Machinations
characters.description: Makkii-senhai is a first-year high school student at Shuchi'in Academy and the president of the Tabletop Gaming Club, As the president of the Tabletop Gaming Club, Kozue loves games. She also has a somewhat sadistic sense of humor, as shown by her cheerfully torturing Miko while gathering audio for their class' event during the culture festival. She is shown to be very intelligent, regularly ranking among the top ten students in the freshman class during the end of semester exams.

characters.name: Terashima
characters.energy_system: Genius Psychological Warfare, Strategy & Social Machinations
characters.description: She's a third-year high school student at Shuchi'in Academy and a member of the Tabletop Gaming Club which Chika Fujiwara is also a part of. Terashima, being demoted from Terako to Gigako, is a pun on metric prefixes

characters.name: Subaru Suruga
characters.energy_system: Genius Psychological Warfare, Strategy & Social Machinations
characters.description: One of Ai Hayasaka's closest friends. She wears her Shuchi'in Academy school uniform modified to match up with kogal fashion. She is the daughter of the president of an IT company.

characters.name: Nayotake Shimizu
characters.energy_system: Genius Psychological Warfare, Strategy & Social Machinations

characters.name: Mayuri Shiina
characters.energy_system: Worldline Divergence, Time Leap Technology & Reading Steiner
characters.description: __Height:__ 151 cm (4'11") Second year in Kasensou Private Prepatory Academy. Childhood friend of Rintarou's, and slow by nature. Speaks in a very wavy manner, and seems to always be smiling and having fun. She's quite the optimist. She has trouble understanding complicated theories, but doesn't mind as long as it's enjoyable. Doesn't like people arguing, and is depressed when things are unpleasant. Though she'd like to ease the situation in such cases, she's not really good at reading between the lines. She often went with her grandmother to see the stars on her grandmother's back. Because of that, she has a habit of reaching her arm out to the sky at times, which has led Rintarou to naming it the "Stardust Shakehand". She abruptly does this (even if she's talking with someone), which surprises everyone around her.

characters.name: Suzuha Amane
characters.energy_system: Worldline Divergence, Time Leap Technology & Reading Steiner
characters.description: __Height__: 163 cm (5'4") A girl that really likes riding bicycles, and is quite energetic, though a little crude. If you stick around her, she's surprisingly cautious. Very helpful. A little too familiar with things, but doesn't dig too deep. Not quite comfortable with having other people help her. For that reason, she spends as little time as possible. Her personality drastically changes when it comes to her own interests. Proactive. Has a habit of using strange and difficult vocabulary at times, but somehow you can tell she's purposely doing so. Ended up hanging out with the Future Gadget Laboratory since she started working at the CRT TV Workshop.

characters.name: Itaru Hashida
characters.energy_system: Worldline Divergence, Time Leap Technology & Reading Steiner
characters.description: __Height:__ 164 cm (5'5") First-year student at Tokyo Denki University. Pro-active otaku, who's got a thing for both 2-D and 3-D girls. Plenty of statements he makes could be taken as sexual harassment. He and Rintarou have known each other since high school. He usually dismissed Rintarou's ridiculous requests as "annoying", but actually completes them well, and trusts Rintarou as a friend. Has great confidence in his programming and hacking abilities (he doesn't mind being called a Super Hacker, but doesn't like it when people call him Super Haker). He's always in front of the computer.

characters.name: Luka Urushibara
characters.energy_system: Worldline Divergence, Time Leap Technology & Reading Steiner
characters.description: __Height:__ 161 cm (5'3") Second year in Kasensou Private Prepatory Academy. Mayuri's classmate. Luka has the personality of a polite, well-groomed, and justified kind of person. Uses honorifics specifically with Rintarou. Luka doesn't push their opinions much upon others, but when they do they become quite bashful and blush quite a bit. Because they're quite serious by nature, they simply believe what others say. Thanks to that, Luka thinks all the ridiculous stuff Rintarou talks about is real. Rintarou makes them out to be his student on their own, and is currently in the middle of brainwashing them. A very shy person, Luka often turns down Mayuri's requests to cosplay.

characters.name: Rumiho Akiha
characters.energy_system: Worldline Divergence, Time Leap Technology & Reading Steiner
characters.description: __Height:__ 143 cm (4'8") Second year in Kanaria Private Academy. Faris is someone who works part-time at a maid cafe called "MayQueen+Nyan2". Mayuri works with her. She's quite child-like. Acts like a childish devil towards men. Also adds embarrassing "meows" to her speech. Has an ability to see into people's hearts just by looking into their eyes (which she calls the "Cheshire Break").

characters.name: Moeka Kiryuu
characters.energy_system: Worldline Divergence, Time Leap Technology & Reading Steiner
characters.description: __Height:__ 167 cm (5'6") A tall girl that Rintarou bumps into in Akihabara and is on a search for the IBN 5100 personal computer. Moeka is extremely protective of her mobile phone and becomes agitated if someone tries to take it from her hands. She is very shy and prefers to talk to someone by sending them a text message instead of speaking.

characters.name: Yuugo Tennouji
characters.energy_system: Worldline Divergence, Time Leap Technology & Reading Steiner
characters.description: Owner of the CRT TV Workshop set up in the first floor of the Oohiyama building. Also the landlord. Widower. Has an only daughter by the name of Nae, though he's the only one who loves CRTs. Hates LCDs with a passion, and perhaps anarchic. Though he's not quite enthusiastic in the CRT TV Workshop, for some reason he doesn't seem like he'd go bankrupt anytime soon. Nicknamed "Mr. Brown" by Rintarou, due to the loan word "Braun" used in the Japanese term for CRTs (ブラウン管).

characters.name: Nae Tennouji
characters.energy_system: Worldline Divergence, Time Leap Technology & Reading Steiner
characters.description: Tennouji Yuugo's only daughter, in grade school. Really loves her father, and often shows up at the CRT TV Workshop on the way home from school. She's a bit docile. Thinks of Mayuri as her "older sister", but is often frightened by Itaru and Rintarou. On __Robotics;Notes__ Nae returns in Robotics;Notes as an important member of the cast and while not part of the Robot Research Club she provides assistance to them via ties at her job at JAXA (Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency)

characters.name: John Titor
characters.energy_system: Worldline Divergence, Time Leap Technology & Reading Steiner
characters.description: Based on a 'real' person, John Titor is the name used on several bulletin boards during 2000 and 2001 by a poster claiming to be a time traveler from the year 2036. In these posts he made numerous predictions (a number of them vague, some quite specific) about events in the near future, starting with events in 2004.

characters.name: Yukitaka Akiha
characters.energy_system: Worldline Divergence, Time Leap Technology & Reading Steiner
characters.description: Feiris's father.

characters.name: Dr. Nakabachi
characters.energy_system: Worldline Divergence, Time Leap Technology & Reading Steiner
characters.description: He is the professor who gives the lecture about time travels in Episode 1.

characters.name: Eisuke Urushibara
characters.energy_system: Worldline Divergence, Time Leap Technology & Reading Steiner
characters.description: Ruka's father.

characters.name: Maho Hiyajou
characters.energy_system: Worldline Divergence, Time Leap Technology & Reading Steiner
characters.description: __Height:__ 140 cm (4’7”) Another researcher at Victor Concordia University's Neuroscience Lab, similar to Kurisu. She attends a lecture at Okabe's university as Professor Leskinen's assistant.

characters.name: Kagari Shiina
characters.energy_system: Worldline Divergence, Time Leap Technology & Reading Steiner

characters.name: Alexis Leskinen
characters.native_name: アレクシス・レスキネン
characters.energy_system: Worldline Divergence, Time Leap Technology & Reading Steiner
characters.description: An American professor and senior researcher at Victor Chondria University's Brain Research Institute. He serves as a mentor to Kurisu Makise and Maho Hiyajo. He is well respected in his field and is often described as childlike and friendly by Maho Hiyajo.

characters.name: Yuki Amane
characters.energy_system: Worldline Divergence, Time Leap Technology & Reading Steiner

characters.name: Kaede Kurushima
characters.energy_system: Worldline Divergence, Time Leap Technology & Reading Steiner
characters.description: A fellow cosplayer of Mayuri Shiina; she goes by the cosplay name "Kaede." She is a female college student, three years older than her friends Mayuri and Katsumi Nakase. Yuki Amane is a senior student at the same university. She has a fondness for "cool" aesthetics and is a proponent of Fubuki doing cross-dressing cosplay (specifically, dressing as a male character).

characters.name: Judy Reyes
characters.energy_system: Worldline Divergence, Time Leap Technology & Reading Steiner
characters.description: A Colleague of Leskinen, also a scientist.

characters.name: Katsumi Nakase
characters.energy_system: Worldline Divergence, Time Leap Technology & Reading Steiner
characters.description: One of Mayuri's cosplayer friends. Her stage name is "Fubuki". She's popular for her boyish charms.
